860910.short_description: Hentai 3018 - is casual puzzle game. You play as a girl that need to get out of the room. Try to find the exit door and not be caught by the enemy or die in the trap.

860950.name: Mark of the Ninja: Remastered
860950.short_description: In Mark of the Ninja, you'll know what it is to truly be a ninja. You must be silent, agile and clever to outwit your opponents in a world of gorgeous scenery and flowing animation.

861250.name: Cyber Shadow
861250.short_description: The world has been taken over by synthetic lifeforms. A desperate plea for help sets Shadow, the sole survivor of his clan, on one last mission to uncover what started the path to perpetual ruin.

861270.name: Sudoku Killer
861270.short_description: Killer Sudoku (Sumdoku/Mathdoku/Addoku) puzzles include all the rules of regular Sudoku, but add in dashed-line 'cages', which must sum to given values. This great brain exerciser will provide you many hours of new Sudoku experience and be nice addition to your puzzle collection.

872670.name: SCP: 5K (Alpha Testing)
872670.short_description: SCP: 5K is a co-op or singleplayer tactical horror FPS project that puts players in the midst of a conspiracy where the SCP Foundation has turned on humanity. Enjoy Early Access as we continue to work towards a completed full release of the project!

872680.name: Z Dawn
872680.short_description: Z Dawn is a survival RPG that takes place in a post-apocalyptic world in which you get to manage a group of survivors to fight for their life, level up their skills, help fight off different breeds of zombies, build and upgrade camp, face hundreds of thrilling events and much more!

872750.name: Guard Duty
872750.short_description: Guard Duty is a comedy adventure about love, loss and the end of the world. Experience an unforgettable story spanning across two radically different time periods.

872790.name: Football Manager 2019
872790.short_description: Simulation gaming perfected. Create your unique footballing story by taking charge of the club you love. Complete control of this stunningly realistic game world is yours - every decision in your hands, or yours to delegate. Your call, your way, your story. Everything you've ever dreamed of!

872820.name: Football Manager 2019 Touch
872820.short_description: Handle only the managerial essentials in Football Manager 2019 Touch, the slick and nimble alternate to the world’s favourite football management simulation.

873200.name: Teleportals. I swear it's a nice game
873200.short_description: I swear it's a nice puzzle game.

873220.name: SurvivalZ Battlegrounds
873220.short_description: SurvivalZ Battlegrounds is a mini Battle Royale in a cubic world!

873270.name: Rolled Out!
873270.short_description: Get ready to tilt and bounce your way through Rolled Out!, a marble-rolling game with charming characters and precise controls. All you need is one joystick to roll to the goal; with over 150 hand-crafted stages to tackle, there's always a new challenge around the corner!

873840.name: Truck and Logistics Simulator
873840.short_description: Load, drive, and deliver through a huge open world with up to 24 players in cross-platform multiplayer. Join your friends in exciting heavy transport convoys. Jump into the driver's seat of more than 30 unique vehicles and carry out complex loading tasks to deliver a variety of cargo.

873890.name: Legends of Amberland
873890.short_description: Legends of Amberland: The Forgotten Crown is a classic western RPG inspired by the games from the 90s. Basically, it’s the kind of game I personally find missing nowadays. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous and without the need of endless grind to progress.

873940.name: Crying Suns
873940.short_description: Crying Suns is a tactical rogue-lite that puts you in the role of a space fleet commander as you explore a mysteriously fallen empire. In this story rich experience inspired by Dune and Foundation, each successful run will uncover the truth about the Empire... and yourself as well.

873980.name: Isle of Skye
873980.short_description: Five clans are fighting to rule over the Isle of Skye. Only the chieftain who develops the best clan territory and trades wisely will be king!

874040.name: Ministry of Broadcast
874040.short_description: Ministry of Broadcast is a narrative-driven single player cinematic platformer mixing Orwell’s 1984 with modern reality TV. A country divided by The Wall; to cross it and reach your family, you must compete on - and win - a reality TV show broadcast by the Regime.

874260.name: The Forgotten City
874260.short_description: The Forgotten City is a narrative-driven time loop adventure in ancient Rome. Discover the ruins of an ancient underground city, travel 2000 years into the past, and unravel the mystery of who destroyed it by cleverly exploiting the power to wind back time. The fate of the city is in your hands.

874390.name: The Battle of Polytopia
874390.short_description: Welcome to the unique, turn-based strategy game set in the strange, flat world of the Square. Lead one of 16 distinct civilizations to victory by expanding your empire, researching technologies, and ultimately become ruler of the world! Play in single-player or multiplayer mode for up to 16 players.

874400.name: Dinosaur Hunt Puzzle
874400.short_description: Dinosaur Hunt Puzzle is a sliding puzzle game based on the artwork from original Dinosaur Hunt game.

874460.name: Achtung! Cthulhu Tactics
874460.short_description: Challenge the horrifying reign of Nazi terror and battle an immortal evil in Achtung! Cthulhu Tactics; a turn-based tactical strategy game set in the award-winning Achtung! Cthulhu universe.

875210.name: 三国群英传8 Kingdom Heroes 8
875210.short_description: The " Kingdom Heroes" series is a classic horizontal battle single-player game developed by Userjoy, which has been released seven generations since 1998. The latest sequel, " Kingdom Heroes 8", will feature a new look and exciting battles, interpreting the magnificent era of the Three Kingdoms.

875240.name: Tree.Bonsai
875240.short_description: An artistic bonsai tree simulation game that follows the life cycle of a plum tree. You can cut branches, add nutrients, and graft while the seasons pass and your tree grows. You can finally fulfill your dreams of a digital bonsai.

875310.name: LIBERATED
875310.short_description: Lock, load, and get ready for a new kind of action adventure! Immerse yourself in a noir rain-soaked city inside a paperback comic. Uncover a cyberpunk conspiracy against human rights. THIS is the revolution.

1007810.name: 重明鸟 Bright Bird
1007810.short_description: Bright Bird is designed to be a seamless side-scrolling world full of challenging puzzles. Begin your exciting journey, find the bright bird to save the world!

1007840.name: Wanking Simulator
1007840.short_description: The best wanking experience known to mankind, from the comfort of your home. Visit Gay Bay and deliver some delightful changes to the town's community.

1008020.name: Lust Epidemic
1008020.short_description: A student of East State University named Brad finds himself stranded at a rival college Saint Dame University during a hurricane that has unexpectedly changed course and struck the town. Explore the ancient and creepy campus grounds to uncover many mysteries and secrets... as well as some sexy fun!

1008510.name: Who Is This Man
1008510.short_description: Who is This Man is an spy game with privacy and hiding. Secretly infiltrate his target's house and miss his stuff. Report them later. Buy new agent equipment

1008710.name: Wet Girl
1008710.short_description: This is a unique first-person spraying game. Take a water gun and spray the hot dancing girls, and when you wet their clothes completely, you win. When you see their angry expressions or hear them panting, don't stop spraying just for the sake of your pity on them.

1008800.name: Shards of Infinity
1008800.short_description: Shards of Infinity is the follow-up to the award winning deckbuilding game, Ascension. Build your armies by recruiting allies and champions from four unique factions. Launch surprise attacks on your foes by instantly deploying mercenaries. Unlock limitless power by mastering the Shard of Infinity.

1008860.name: Repella Fella
1008860.short_description: Repella Fella is an interactive, point and click, choose your own adventure. This cinematic tale is set in a post-apocalyptic, futuristic Australia. Alternate between 3 intertwining stories. Replay the game multiple times to attempt different solutions and achieve every possible ending.

1008920.name: Photographs
1008920.short_description: Photographs is a Narrative Tragedy Puzzle Game? What the hell does that mean

1009290.name: SWORD ART ONLINE Alicization Lycoris
1009290.short_description: Enjoy seamless, action-packed real-time battles using a combination of sword skills, sacred arts, and your favorite SAO characters!

1009450.name: Sankaku Renai: Love Triangle Trouble
1009450.short_description: Meet Sousuke. He's just your average student, living in a rural town. Ever since his father remarried when he was young, he's been living together with his little sister Nanaru. Together with his childhood friend Maho and their other friends, they have fun geeking out in the Otaku Club.

1009560.name: The Tenants
1009560.short_description: Become a landlord and deal with problematic tenants as you build your rental property empire. Decide how to react to annoyed neighbors or police interventions. Will you design your apartment for a group of gamer friends or an aspiring musician looking for a new home?

1009750.name: Flappatron
1009750.short_description: Flappatron - A Quirky Action Game/Visual Novel Hybrid Flappatron combines fast, arcade action alongside a fully voice acted visual novel narrative from creative mind, Dexter Manning!

1009850.name: OVR Advanced Settings
1009850.short_description: OVR Advanced Settings is a Dashboard Application for VR, that allows you to access many settings. OVRAS also has a myriad of utility features such as: simulated movement, adding smooth/snap turn to any game, video controls for the headset such as brightness, per-app bindings and much more.

1010240.name: Changeling
1010240.short_description: A dark, fantastical romantic comedy that focuses not just on falling in love, but rediscovering your past and the dangers of a supernatural world - where what's at stake is not just your heart, but also your life.

1010270.name: Nether: The Untold Chapter
1010270.short_description: Spawn in to and explore a post-apocalyptic Chicago whose once mighty silhouette has been plundered and turned into ruins. The streets that used to be filled with life are now full of abandoned cars and buildings and are surrounded by creepy creatures called “Nethers”.

1010600.name: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart
1010600.short_description: Once upon a time, after his mother passed away, a boy called Nora felt all alone in the world. He spent every day with his unique and kind hearted friends until one fateful day, he had a chance encounter with a princess from the Netherworld.

1021070.name: Spaceland
1021070.short_description: Incredibly dynamic turn-based strategy, reviving the traditions of the old school tactics. Lead a team of the most desperate fighters, destroy alien monsters and uncover the secrets of the lost planet.

1021100.name: Aircraft Carrier Survival
1021100.short_description: When the harshness of the sea meets the cruelties of war, a challenge for perseverance makes itself known. Welcome to Aircraft Carrier Survival, a strategy game set in the Pacific Theater of World War II, where your prowess as a commander decides the fate of a naval behemoth.

1021210.name: Cyber Knights: Flashpoint
1021210.short_description: Cyberpunk mercenaries RPG! Turn-based squad tactics with unique heist-planning strategy. Build your crew wisely; their stories will become interwoven with your own. Pull off heists with powerful cyberware, faction connections, multiclassing, weapon modding, stealth, hacking, and more!

1021770.name: Wanba Warriors
1021770.short_description: Have you got what it takes to be a Wanba Warrior? Step into the absurd world of calligraphy combat and prepare to lay the smackdown upon all who dare to oppose you, dishing out damage with your chosen ink brush of brutality! highly recommend playing with controllers.

1022230.name: Magic Borderless
1022230.short_description: This must-have, ultimate gamer app is more than an automatic borderless tool. Magic Borderless auto detects any games & applies your preferences. It also includes mouse locks, multi-monitor & widescreen goodies, volume manager, multitasking assistance, and privacy features like Ninja Mode *wink wink*.

1022310.name: Warhammer Underworlds - Shadespire Edition
1022310.short_description: Lead your fighters to Glory in the ultimate PvP dice-and-cards strategy combat game. Warhammer Underworlds - Shadespire Edition pits mighty warbands against one another in an eternal battle for glory in the realms of the Age of Sigmar.

1022480.name: KAMIKO
1022480.short_description: Wield your weapon bestowed by the gods, and open the gates between worlds!

1022710.name: Conglomerate 451
1022710.short_description: Conglomerate 451 is a grid-based, dungeon crawling first-person RPG with roguelike elements set in a cyberpunk world.

1022780.name: Animal Fight Club
1022780.short_description: Invent new creatures by mixing real or legendary animals in thousands of possible combinations, create an army and fight in the singleplayer campaign or in online multiplayer against friends or random challengers!

1033880.name: Press F to pay respects
1033880.short_description: Press F to pay respects is the simple clicker game

1033950.name: Lamentum
1033950.short_description: Lamentum is a pixel art survival horror game, set in New England in the mid-nineteenth century.

1034060.name: Samosbor
1034060.short_description: The player will take the role of a liquidator destroying the consequences of Samosbor in the narrow corridors of Gigakhrushchevka.

1034140.name: Subverse
1034140.short_description: A sexy new sci-fi parody where you command your own starship filled with the hottest babes in the galaxy, who are ready to bring your fantasies to life in fully animated love scenes!

1034700.name: GRAY
1034700.short_description: This story is about a man that somehow wakes in the body of a little robot. GRAY is a platform-puzzle game combined with an erotic visual novel.

1034750.name: The Flower Collectors
1034750.short_description: Barcelona, 1977. An ex-cop in a wheelchair witnesses a murder, and teams up with a young ambitious journalist to bring the truth to light. With camera, binoculars and transmitter in hand, uncover the town’s secrets from your balcony in this soul-searching detective mystery.

1034850.name: Best Friend Forever
1034850.short_description: Pat the dogs... and then their owners. Step into the world of Rainbow Bay in Best Friend Forever, a dating sim-meets-dog care sim where you pat, pamper and train your pup while you search for your own forever friend.

1034860.name: GRANDIA HD Remaster
1034860.short_description: GRANDIA HD Remaster brings enhanced visuals to both gameplay and cinematic videos.

1034900.name: Blaster Master Zero
1034900.short_description: Mutant scum never learn! Blaster Master Zero makes its Steam debut! Blaster Master Zero is a 8-bit style top-down & sideview 2D action-adventure game that hearkens back to the golden age of the NES. The game features new gameplay elements such as improved gameplay, and a more robust scenario.

1034910.name: Blaster Master Zero 2
1034910.short_description: Join Jason, Eve, and Fred on an intergalactic journey! The side-scrolling/top-down hybrid action adventure title "Blaster Master Zero" returns with its long-awaited sequel! Experience the yet-untold story of Jason and Eve after defeating Earth's mutant scourge in "Blaster Master Zero".

1034940.name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.7 Minagoroshi
1034940.short_description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

1035050.name: Alt-Frequencies
1035050.short_description: An audio mystery set in a time loop. Record, rewind time and broadcast snippets of radio shows to expose radio hosts, conspiracy theorists and politicians.

1035120.name: Lust from Beyond
1035120.short_description: A Victorian mansion. A cult worshipping an otherworldly erotic deity. Among all that - you. Explore a world inspired by the works of Lovecraft, Giger, and Beksiński. See for yourself that there are no limits to dark ecstasy.

1035510.name: Ultimate Zombie Defense
1035510.short_description: Team up or face it alone in this top down zombie slaying defense adventure! Featuring up to 4 player online co-op, cleanse the infected wave by wave and upgrade your base with traps & defenses to build the Ultimate Zombie Defense. Can YOU stop them?

1035560.name: Struggling
1035560.short_description: Struggling is a physics-based co-op platformer with a twisted spin on teamwork. Control the arms of a squishy abomination and lead it through a deranged world.

1035610.name: Hentai Mosaique Vip Room
1035610.short_description: Beautiful anime girls + scrambled mosaiques. Who knew both of those things come together so smoothly

1035660.name: Chromosome Evil
1035660.short_description: Dive deep into this Lovecraft-inspired RTS survival. Assemble your team using different classes, skills, and weaponry. It's up to your squad to survive the onslaught of nightmares that are surely coming your way. Will you find the source of the darkness?

1035760.name: Glimmer in Mirror
1035760.short_description: Glimmer in Mirror is a 2D story-rich action shooting game. Play as Shiro in a collapsed world, to meet various unique NPCs and monsters, and gradually uncover the truth of the world through a gripping story.

1035930.name: Nyasha
1035930.short_description: The game is a classic puzzle with three levels of difficulty.

1035990.name: Dialtown: Phone Dating Sim
1035990.short_description: If you've ever wanted to romantically pursue a phone, then hot DARN, do I have just the game for you.

1036240.name: Definitely Not Fried Chicken
1036240.short_description: Definitely Not Fried Chicken is a business management sim with a Twist! Grow your drugs trade through legitimate fronts by managing both sides of the business. Acquire new "businesses", meet new clientele, Develop more potent narcotics, make lots of money and leave a city in ruin!

1036440.name: Kingdom Wars 2: Definitive Edition
1036440.short_description: An intense real-time strategy game set in a dark fantasy world of Orcs, Elves and Dragons. Kingdom Wars 2 combines the best of Zombie survival and crafting with complex fast-paced city building. Fight massive siege battles that turn beautiful landscapes into gory blood-soaked battlefields.

1036580.name: National Park Girls: Love Our Parks Edition
1036580.short_description: The complete edition of National Park Girls! After five years of being a ranger in Yosemite National Park, Eve is just about ready to throw in the towel. However, things start to change when she meets three spritely girls who claim to be manifestations of the National Parks.

1048100.name: Peekaboo
1048100.short_description: Peekaboo — Hide & Seek Online. Players are divided into two teams: props and hunters.Props take the form of objects and adopt their physical properties, and hunters are trying with all their might to find them.

1048350.name: Nigate Tale
1048350.short_description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated labyrinthic castle in this rogue-like dungeon crawler, set in a vibrant and colorful anime world. You’re lost in a spiritual realm, but powerful monster girls will help you get back home with new powers and weapons if you bring them the right presents!

1048540.name: Kao the Kangaroo: Round 2
1048540.short_description: Let’s bring back all the good memories of the incredible, brave and lovely Kao the Kangaroo. Immerse yourself in a classic 3D action-adventure platformer where Kao runs, jumps, and fights lots of enemies.

1048660.name: Knight Squad 2
1048660.short_description: Knight Squad 2 is a chaotic arcade multiplayer game for up to 8 players. Pick an eccentric knight and fight for glory with wacky weaponry. Triumph over your friends in a ridiculous amount of game modes, both offline and online.

1048740.name: Half Past Fate
1048740.short_description: Love is in the air, but work, life, and spicy Ramen keep getting in the way! From 8 hours to 8 years, this time-jumping saga will change the way you feel about fate forever.

1048950.name: Desert Skies
1048950.short_description: Desert Skies takes survival to the air! Build an airship and fly on an adventure through the deserts of the Wild West. Look for places to land and scavenge for loot, expand your airship and craft new equipment, but beware the dangers lurking beneath the sands!

1049100.name: Christmas Tina -泡沫冬景-
1049100.short_description: It is the year 1988. Japan is in the midst of the bubble economy. New buildings are sprouting up everywhere, and the people are ecstatic. This is a story of people who live for one year... in such a little corner of the city.

1049280.name: Pilgrims
1049280.short_description: Pilgrims is a playful adventure game, created by the team behind Machinarium and Samorost. Roam the land as you please and make new friends, share a laugh with your fellow travelers and help them complete their little stories, your way. How many different solutions can you find?

1049320.name: River City Girls
1049320.short_description: There's trouble once again in River City, and this time only the girls can save the day! Using a variety of attacks, weapons, and items, these hot-blooded heroines are ready to teach the city’s lowlifes a lesson - either solo or in 2-player co-op! It’s an old-school rumble for a new generation!

1049410.name: Superliminal
1049410.short_description: Perception is reality. In this mind-bending first-person puzzler, you escape a surreal dream world through solving impossible puzzles using the ambiguity of depth and perspective.

1049710.name: Minute of Islands
1049710.short_description: Explore strange and wonderful islands and dark labyrinths below in this narrative puzzle platformer. Guide young mechanic Mo on her quest to repair a world on the brink of collapse. The powerful Omni Switch at your disposal may not be enough to fix the damage that hides beneath the surface...

1049850.name: UFO2: Extraterrestrials
1049850.short_description: Are strategy games with strong RPG elements your cup of tea? Did you enjoy games like Xcom: UFO Defence, the Fallout series, the Civilization series, the Heroes of Might and magic? And now you are looking for something new to satisfy your craving for turn-based fun?

1049890.name: Little Witch Nobeta
1049890.short_description: Control the lovely little witch Nobeta, explore the unknown mysterious castle, and gradually discover the truth!

1050370.name: LUNARK
1050370.short_description: A pixel-art sci-fi adventure set in the midst of a rebellion against a totalitarian regime, LUNARK is a modern take on the 2D cinematic platformer genre of the '90s. Run, jump, hang, climb, roll, and shoot your way through gorgeous and mysterious locations!

1061880.name: Conan Chop Chop
1061880.short_description: Conan Chop Chop is a party roguelite for 1-4 players full of mayhem, loot, and adventure. In this outrageous take on Conan the Barbarian, you are the muscle-bound hero foolish enough to try and stop the evil wizard Thoth-Amon!

1061910.name: Metal: Hellsinger
1061910.short_description: Slay to the rhythm of metal and vengeance on an infernal journey through the eight Hells. Make them fear the beat. Metal: Hellsinger is a rhythm FPS bursting with demons, badass weapons, and heavy metal music.

1061930.name: Cyber City
1061930.short_description: Explore futuristic metropolis, gamble in casinos, take part in illegal racing and robot wrestling, try to survive battles on arena. Earn money and fame so you can become the most influential person in the whole city.

1062000.name: Starmancer
1062000.short_description: From a small 2-man team comes a unique space station management sim. Take on the role of an A.I commanding a lost space ark. Try not to let your crew run amok and wreck the place.

1062040.name: Dragon Star Varnir
1062040.short_description: Fight in 3-tiered battles, devour your enemies, and customize your characters in this epic RPG to end the dragon's curse!

1062090.name: Timberborn
1062090.short_description: Humans are long gone. In a world struck by droughts and toxic waste, will your lumberpunk beavers do any better? A city-building game featuring ingenious animals, vertical architecture, water physics, and terraforming. Contains high amounts of wood.

1062110.name: UNSIGHTED
1062110.short_description: EXPLORE YOUR WAY. Awoken to a world ruined by war, Alma must traverse the vast city of Arcadia before the life force of her friends and herself withers away. Time is ticking, and every moment matters. Who will you save, and who will you leave to turn UNSIGHTED?

1062140.name: Garden Story
1062140.short_description: Embark on a wholesome adventure to save The Grove! Forage resources, combat the invasive Rot, and restore the community. Relax and enjoy the fruits of your labor in this charming action-RPG starring a grape.

1062160.name: Poly Bridge 2
1062160.short_description: The acclaimed bridge-building indie-hit is back! More levels, more features, more physics fun!

1062340.name: KATANA KAMI: A Way of the Samurai Story
1062340.short_description: The Way of the Samurai is forged in battle! Help the swordsmith Dojima pay off his debt after his beautiful daughter is taken as collateral by crafting swords by day and exploring mysterious, twisting dungeons for valuable materials at night.

1062520.name: Dinkum
1062520.short_description: G'Day there! Get ready to start a new fair Dinkum life. Explore an island inspired by the wild Australian outback, featuring tropical eucalyptus forests, scorching deserts, and cool billabongs.

1062810.name: Inkbound
1062810.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelike from the creators of Monster Train. Play solo or co-op, create powerful builds, and save the Atheneum.

1062830.name: Embr
1062830.short_description: Fight fires for fun and profit in this unpredictable and frantic multiplayer game. Team up with friends, take on daily challenges and climb to the top of the corporate firefighting ladder. More than one way to become a hero!

1062960.name: UNDER the SAND
1062960.short_description: You. Your car. And world under the sand.

1063040.name: Ben 10: Power Trip
1063040.short_description: Evil Hex has cursed Europe – and only Ben 10 can stop him! Explore a 3D world filled with combat, puzzles and secrets as you save the day!

1063310.name: Vane
1063310.short_description: In a ruined desert, a strange golden dust transforms a free-spirited bird into a determined young child, setting off a chain of events that will reshape the world itself.

1063420.name: Void Crew
1063420.short_description: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 4 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

1063490.name: Still There
1063490.short_description: Every day is the same on the faraway Bento space-lighthouse - until a mysterious radio message breaks through. Evade the past, welcome oblivion, make the perfect Italian coffee. Still There is a psychological adventure game about grief, technical puzzles, wacky AIs and dark humour. How far is far enough?

1063540.name: Space Wreck
1063540.short_description: The biggest little RPG in the world. Post-apocalyptic retro space adventure with an extreme focus on role-playing and replayability. Inch wide, miles deep - intentionally short yet surprisingly deep.

1063580.name: Aeon's End
1063580.short_description: Deck building with a twist! Lead a team of mages against the Nameless in this magic-based card battle game and save the city of Gravehold!

1063590.name: Rogue Masters
1063590.short_description: Rogue Masters is a 6 player co-op horde survival game with souls-like combat and extensive character customization where you fight Entropy in long-lost civilizations.

1063660.name: Bendy and the Dark Revival
1063660.short_description: Bendy and the Dark Revival® is a first-person survival horror game set in the creepiest cartoon studio to ever exist. Discover the truth. Escape the studio. Above all, fear the Ink Demon…and survive.

1063730.name: New World: Aeternum
1063730.short_description: Experience a thrilling action RPG set on the supernatural island of Aeternum. Forge your destiny on an adventure filled with danger and opportunity.

1063790.name: Citizen of Rome - Dynasty Ascendant
1063790.short_description: Life sim set in the Ancient Roman Republic. Experience life and events in Ancient Rome through multiple generations of a family, helping them grow from lowly commoners to mighty Senators. Long live the Republic!

1063980.name: Hell Architect
1063980.short_description: Hell Architect is a game about building and managing your own hell. You take on a role of a hell manager and are tasked with developing the underworld in a way that would make Lucifer himself fall off his chair.

1064010.name: Escape until friday
1064010.short_description: You are kidnapped by a maniac who keeps you locked up in his basement. You have to get out of the kidnapper's house at any cost until Friday.

1064130.name: Sakura MMO 3
1064130.short_description: The final part of the Sakura MMO series. Viola and her party embark on their most dangerous quest yet, as they face off against an evil goddess to save all of Asaph.

1074610.name: COLLAPSED
1074610.short_description: Collapsed is a post-apocalyptic roguelike action-platformer. Hunt your prey through vast procedurally-generated levels filled with tough enemies, useful loot and experience points. Fight alone or with a friend – either way, it won’t be easy!

1074620.name: Adore
1074620.short_description: Adore is an action creature-collecting game where you build your team of unique creatures and go on a journey to resurrect the God of the Creatures.

1074630.name: Call Of Unity
1074630.short_description: Soldier Unity prepare for battle! Grab a weapon from the arsenal and go conquer Unity's battlefields!

1075080.name: Falcon Age
1075080.short_description: Bond with a baby falcon and go on an adventure. Falcon Age is a first-person, single-player action adventure where you’ll play as Ara in her fight to reclaim her cultural legacy in the lost art of falcon hunting against a force of automated colonizers.

1075190.name: A Game of Thrones: The Board Game
1075190.short_description: A Game of Thrones: The Board Game – Digital Edition is the digital adaptation of the top-selling strategy board game from Fantasy Flight Games.

1075200.name: TOHU
1075200.short_description: Experience a brand new adventure game set amongst a world of weird and wonderful fish planets. Explore beautiful environments, solve intricate puzzles and discover the truth about a mysterious little girl and her mechanical alter-ego, Cubus.

1075400.name: Doctor Who: The Edge Of Time
1075400.short_description: A new mysterious enemy threatens to tear apart the universe and only you can stop them! Doctor Who: The Edge Of Time lets players embark on an adventure through space and time. Travel across the universe, visit alien locations, pilot the TARDIS and solve the mystery of the controlling force behind the Reality Virus.

1075740.name: Banners of Ruin
1075740.short_description: Assemble your party. Answer the call. Win the war. Build a deck and fight a series of turn-based combats with up to 6 party characters through the city of Dawn's Point. Each character can unlock a set of unique cards and abilities that can augment your deck in powerful, exciting ways.

1075980.name: NinNinDays
1075980.short_description: A sullen main character and a clumsy female ninja living together?! In this romantic adventure game set in Akihabara, you'll laugh and you'll cry over the entertaining lifetyle of a slightly erotic female ninja and the main character's cohabitation!

1076160.name: Command: Modern Operations
1076160.short_description: Command: Modern Operations is the next generation in cross-domain modern wargaming. It enables you to simulate every military engagement from post World War II to the present day and beyond. The scale is primarily tactical/operational, although strategic scale operations are also possible.

1076200.name: Roguebook
1076200.short_description: Embrace the challenge of a roguelike deckbuilder with unique mechanics from the developers of Faeria and Richard Garfield, creator of Magic: The Gathering™. Build a team of two heroes, unleash powerful combos and defeat the legends of the Roguebook!

1076210.name: WWTSTB: Streamer
1076210.short_description: The combination of the well-known TV show with the best genre of games on earth.

1076230.name: OmniFootman
1076230.short_description: OmniFootman is a rogue-lite action game with souls-like combat system. Take your adventure in this cursed, ever-changing kingdom and beat your enemies with different ability combinations. Be careful as your death is permanent.

1076550.name: SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL / サムライスピリッツ零スペシャル
1076550.short_description: SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL, which was the last game made for SNK’s NEOGEO back in 2004, finally makes its way onto Steam. It features everything fans expect from a fighting game such as training mode, online matches, etc.

1076620.name: Svoboda 1945: Liberation
1076620.short_description: Svoboda 1945: Liberation is a unique adventure game featuring dialogues with real actors. Talk to witnesses of the chaotic aftermath of World War 2 and discover the secret history of your own family in a captivating story about reconciliation with the dark past.

1076750.name: Dream Engines: Nomad Cities
1076750.short_description: A survival city-building game with flying cities. Build, automate, and defend a flying city that travels between procedurally generated maps to survive in a wacky, nightmare-infested, post-apocalyptic world full of strange science and dreams.

1076880.name: Air Marty
1076880.short_description: Experience 64 endings in a web of insane mini games and hand drawn artwork as Marty tries his dang ol' best to enjoy his family vacation.

1076920.name: Generals & Rulers
1076920.short_description: What will be the strategy game if you throw out all the grind from it, all the boring annoying actions and leave only strategy and tactics? It became interesting to us and as a result we received Generals & Rulers. Try it now!

1082930.name: The Signifier Director's Cut
1082930.short_description: This story-driven adventure follows a mystery of death and despair from reality into the surreal realms of objective memories and subjective experiences. Search the mind, solve puzzles, and unravel the dark truth in this psychological thriller.

1082970.name: Archaelund
1082970.short_description: Explore a vast open world and crawl through dungeons in first person, then fight tactical turn-based battles from a top-down perspective. Guide your adventuring party through Archaelund, mankind's last frontier, and uncover its many secrets.

1083190.name: Disc Creatures
1083190.short_description: Humans live alongside creatures, each with different personalities, abilities, and moral codes. The invention of the DiscKid has changed life for everyone. Humans can copy creatures and use their power to help others and solve mysteries around the world.

1083210.name: 符文女孩/Rune Girl
1083210.short_description: This is a "leisure" game with a fine style and a mysterious world following the plot. In this world, there will be a variety of girls, cute cats who have lost their way, and docile maids who have done something wrong. Slavery your evil little witch, what choices should you make in the face of their challenges?

1083310.name: OUTBUDDIES DX
1083310.short_description: Run, gun and explore an open undercity in this otherworldly non-linear Metroidvania adventure about the Old Gods, strange creatures and the remnants of a lost world!

1083650.name: Super Naughty Maid
1083650.short_description: Leona is your cute and lewd maid who will do anything for her master. Join her as she teaches her master everything there is to know about love making.

1083790.name: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
1083790.short_description: A party-based RPG about a 3-piece band of dysfunctional friends who, upon signing up to a perfectly normal battle of the bands contest, become cursed with an unusual power.

1083870.name: CountryBalls Heroes
1083870.short_description: CountryBalls Heroes is a game where you get to play as your favorite Countryball. Become a legend by leading massive Countryball armies. Create your forces, build master-planned cities, gather powerful artifacts and prove that your Countryball is the most powerful.

1084020.name: TheoTown
1084020.short_description: Build and manage your dream city in this captivating simulation game. Create unique urban landscapes and enjoy compatibility with the mobile versions. Unleash your creativity and shape the metropolis of your dreams.

1084160.name: Jagged Alliance 3
1084160.short_description: The country of Grand Chien is thrown into chaos when the elected president goes missing and the paramilitary force known as “the Legion” seizes control. Hire mercs, meet interesting characters, and fight in tactically deep turn-based combat in this true successor to a beloved franchise.

1089310.name: Nordlicht
1089310.short_description: Nordlicht is an adventure-game where you accompany an unusual family on its fascinating journey to the cold north. During the journey, they encounter mysterious star-signs of the polar night, and have to overcome nature's dangers to confront their fears.

1089630.name: 奇迹一刻 Surmount
1089630.short_description: Surmount is a simulation game which is involved with moderate strategy on the subject of E-sports. You'll play as a college student who choose to return back to the league and win the competition as a coach. Those members can not only be your teammate, but also close friends or lovers.

1089780.name: Tales Of Glory 2 - Retaliation
1089780.short_description: Follow the adventure of Andrew "Dog" Carter, a former SAS operative and his International Task Force squad as they fight against a global terrorist organization called Quantum in Tales Of Glory 2 - Retaliation, a VR tactical shooter adventure mixing huge immersive battles against hundreds of NPCs and infiltration missions.

1089790.name: Winter Resort Simulator
1089790.short_description: Are you ready for the winter? Winter Resort simulator lets you operate detailed Doppelmayr cable cars and snow vehicles such as Pistenbully snowcats. Set in a realistic alpine landscape, you are responsible for managing your ski resort and keeping your guests happy.

1089820.name: Reanimation Inc.
1089820.short_description: Reanimation inc is a completely realistic simulation - real urgent conditions and diseases, real protocols of care used in an ambulance, realistic simulation of the body! Do you like realistic games about medicine and simulators, games you need to think about? You 'll be happy!

1089830.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 3
1089830.short_description: New ground and in-air physics, new rider models and new animations will create a more immersive experience and enable you to enjoy the Supercross world at its best!

1089840.name: Armored Brigade
1089840.short_description: Armored Brigade is a real-time tactical wargame, focusing on realism and playability. In Armored Brigade the Cold War has turned hot, and Europe is once again torn apart by conflict. An "Iron Curtain" divides the Western Powers gathered together under the NATO banner from the Soviet Union

1089980.name: The Henry Stickmin Collection
1089980.short_description: A choose-your-own-path where failing is more fun than succeeding.

1096060.name: Teenage Blob
1096060.short_description: Half game. Half album. All awesome! A colourful art-punk adventure towards the best night of your life. Guaranteed to cheer you up in half an hour or your money back!

1096140.name: Timemelters
1096140.short_description: Prevent Doomsday AFTER it happened! Designed by the co-creator of Sang-Froid - Tales of Werewolves and featuring both a single-player and co-op campaign, TimeMelters is a strategy hero defense where you go back in time and fight alongside your past selves.

1096180.name: Ato
1096180.short_description: A world of Beauty and Mystery, Emotive Animations, Atmospheric Environments, Visually Driven Story, Metroidvania Exploration and Memorable Sword Duels.

1096410.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York
1096410.short_description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York is a narrative experience set in the rich universe of Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition. It presents the struggle for power between two vampiric factions - the Camarilla and the Anarchs - bathed in the night lights of the Big Apple.

1096520.name: Venture Seas
1096520.short_description: A kinky strategic adventure game, where you can manage a fantasy trade ship and your rowdy crew! Experience a buoyant story supported by ambitious gameplay systems, sexual content and expansive modding features.

1096530.name: Solasta: Crown of the Magister
1096530.short_description: Roll for initiative, take attacks of opportunity, manage player location and the verticality of the battle field in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5.1 Ruleset. In Solasta, you make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

1096550.name: Desktop Magic Engine
1096550.short_description: DesktopMagicEngine is the second generation of DMMD,With the help of new AI Technology, you can now have a living and dancing cute girl with amazing effects on your desktop! She will always be with you, even while having other windows open. Supports STEAM workshop.

1096560.name: Windy Kingdom
1096560.short_description: This is a Sandbox game project, the simulation farm combined with defense is inspired by "Harvest moon" and "Plant vs zombie". The gameplay of Windykingdom in the top-down perspective, Player will play a character from the future and is trying to survive in a kingdom full of women and monsters.

1096570.name: SONG OF HORROR
1096570.short_description: A 3rd person, fixed-camera survival horror adventure. Fear the Presence, a mysterious entity you cannot fight: stay alert, hide, breathe slowly... Explore cursed places where unseen spirits and lost souls linger in a true horror story for the ages.

1096720.name: CATGIRL LOVER
1096720.short_description: Flashy and juicy anime girls are waiting for you! Yes, you! Join the Golden Shower Order and undress 'em all! A simple but fascinating game with a mixture of Visual Novel and Match3. Easy to dig in and impossible to resist.

1096730.name: Hot & Steamy Knights
1096730.short_description: Our hero's quest to grow his harem appears to be thwarted after his ship is sunk and he washes up on a mysterious island with nothing but his "sword" to keep him safe. Luckily for him he soon encounters mature & beautiful knights who make perfect candidates to spend some hot and steamy nights with!

1096900.name: RPG Maker MZ
1096900.short_description: You want to create an RPG, but every game making tool you have found was either too complex or too limited? RPG Maker MZ empowers you with simple tools to create your RPG right out of the box, yet is customizable enough to make the exact RPG you want!

1096930.name: Strategic Command: World War I
1096930.short_description: Strategic Command: World War I is a new chapter in the Strategic Command Franchise. Relive this momentous conflict from the opening shots of 1914 to the final offensives. Strategic Command: World War I covers all the main aspects and theatres of the war.

1097100.name: Please, Touch The Artwork
1097100.short_description: A cozy puzzler with story. Recreate paintings by applying lines & colors in a specific order. Explore beautiful mazes & collect letters of a poem. Help two sweethearts find a path towards each other. Three games in one. Hints when stuck. 160+ paintings, 3~4 hours, set to a chill soundtrack.

1097110.name: Willy Morgan
1097110.short_description: A letter from 10 years ago, an intricate web of lies to unravel and a mystery to solve. Explore an unconventional town of pirates, dive into the past, collect items and look for clues to help Willy find out what happened to his father...

1097130.name: Circuit Superstars
1097130.short_description: Circuit Superstars is a top down racing game with a tactile arcade physics model, pitstops, and a pure motorsport approach. It includes 16 categories that span different styles and eras of motorsport.

1101360.name: Rock of Ages 3: Make & Break
1101360.short_description: Competitive tower defense meets arcade action and gets rolled up with ACE Team's quirky, Monty Python-esque humor into one giant, creative game for the ages. This time around, you can even make your own levels!

1101400.name: Rune Knights
1101400.short_description: Rune Knights is a cooperative action RPG focused on customization, crafting, and combat. Customize your character's aesthetics, stats, gameplay, and gear as you battle through procedurally generated and hand-crafted levels with your allies.

1101450.name: Miss Neko
1101450.short_description: Together the full picture of all the lovely beast ladies with your own hands, play Yakyuken with them, collect their portraits. Hope you have a relaxing and enjoyable game time:)

1101580.name: Spooky Starlets
1101580.short_description: A card-based porn simulator that tasks you with producing hardcore monstergirl smut! Play your cards right and uncover the intimate escapades of the underworld!

1101790.name: War Mongrels
1101790.short_description: War Mongrels is an isometric real-time tactics game that takes place on the eastern front of World War II. Dynamic and tactical gameplay with stealth elements, tightly packed into a dark, fascinating story! Play on your own or in online co-op (PC).

1101930.name: Monsters of Little Haven
1101930.short_description: At the heart of the action are a twelve-year-old Kenneth and his younger sister Esme, children of the Murphy family, who hit the trail of a mysterious monster following series of entangled events.

1102100.name: TINY METAL: FULL METAL RUMBLE
1102100.short_description: Craft unique strategies and outmanoeuvre your foes in TINY METAL: FULL METAL RUMBLE, a turn-based Japanese wargame! With new tactical options, command over 23 uniquely diverse units - flank, assault, deploy heroes from orbital dropships, and focus the firepower of multiple units to even out otherwise disastrous odds.

1102130.name: Florence
1102130.short_description: Florence Yeoh feels a little... stuck. Her life is an endless routine of work, sleep, and spending too much time on social media. Then one day, she meets a cello player named Krish who changes everything about how she sees the world and herself.

1102190.name: Monster Train
1102190.short_description: Monster Train is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist. Set on a train to hell, you’ll use tactical decision making to defend multiple vertical battlegrounds. With real time competitive multiplayer and endless replayability, Monster Train is always on time.

1102780.name: Desert Of The Dead
1102780.short_description: You are a mysterious wanderer traveling through the wilderness of the wild west. In cities and towns, people began to disappear, as in many cities the population became infected with a virus which turns people into zombies, and it is rumored that people from the government are behind this.

1102880.name: Kawaii Deathu Desu
1102880.short_description: In Kawaii Deathu Desu, supernatural beings find themselves incarnated as cute japanese idols! Pick a supernatural idol and beat the hell out of - no pun intended - as many overzealous fans as you can in this addictive beat'em up as you work your way up to claim the throne of the underworld!

1112620.name: Isles of Adalar
1112620.short_description: Isles of Adalar is an open world single player/co-op fantasy RPG that can be played in first or third person. The game is one part RPG one part RPG maker as it ships with an integrated level editor and Steam Workshop support. Users can mod the existing content or create their own.

1112790.name: Automation Empire
1112790.short_description: Build and manage a massive industrial network of factories, mines, and farms. Employ a fleet of trains, trucks, and robotic drones. In the age of automation, efficiency is survival!

1112830.name: The Watchers
1112830.short_description: The Watchers is a haunting co-op stealth game in which 2 players take control of a brother and sister trying to uncover the truth behind their mother’s disappearance. Explore the sinister compound of a local cult and work together to evade brutal enemies. But be careful. You’re being watched.

1112890.name: Calico
1112890.short_description: Calico is a day-in-the-life community sim game where you are given an important and adorable task: rebuild the town’s cat café and fill it with cute and cuddly creatures! Build up your café by filling it with cute furniture, fun decorations, yummy pastries, and get it bustling with animals again!

1112930.name: Dredgers
1112930.short_description: Based on traditional rogue-likes, Dredgers is a real-time dungeon crawler where you can play as 30 different races, each having their own stats and skills. With the unique class system you can mix and match classes as you desire, anything from an Archer-Knight to a Berserker-Summoner-Priest is possible!

1113000.name: Persona 4 Golden
1113000.short_description: A coming of age story that sets the protagonist and his friends on a journey kickstarted by a chain of serial murders.

1113010.name: Chornobyl Liquidators
1113010.short_description: Chornobyl Liquidators is not a fantastic tale of exploring the Zone. It's a story about real people facing a real threat — the CNPP disaster. Invisible radiation, KGB, difficult moral choices... Do you have enough courage and strength to take on this challenge?

1113030.name: Stellar Warfare
1113030.short_description: Space RTS with base building and ship customization. Personal passion project. More than 200 available ships, weapons and modules to design your fleet with. Contains a small campaign, several single and multiplayer game modes and a coop game mode. Also contains Wave defense!

1113120.name: IXION
1113120.short_description: IXION is an unrelenting, city-building odyssey across the stars. As Administrator of the Tiqqun, DOLOS’ prototype space station, you are tasked with balancing preservation and exploration as you manage infrastructure, resources and crew. Can you keep the flame of humanity alight in the cold dark?

1113560.name: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139...
1113560.short_description: The upgraded prequel of NieR:Automata. A kind young man sets out with Grimoire Weiss, a strange talking book, to search for the "Sealed verses" in order to save his sister Yonah, who fell terminally ill to the Black Scrawl.

1113570.name: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars
1113570.short_description: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is an RPG set in a world of swords and sorcery, told entirely through the medium of cards.

1113620.name: Transparent Taskbar
1113620.short_description: Transparent Taskbar is an application that sets the computer taskbar to blur glass and fully transparent, as well as transparency (from solid to full transparency).

1113680.name: Hentai Girl Division
1113680.short_description: As supreme military general, lead your girls to against enemy and take back freedom for your planet...

1113780.name: Uncharted Tides: Port Royal
1113780.short_description: Dead men tell no tales! And tales about an infamous ship - The Cursed Rose - probably cost renowned sailor Mason Owens his life. As his daughter you can do only one thing - find the damned ship and learn your father's fate.

1114130.name: My Koi
1114130.short_description: My Koi, number 1 hit on the Mac App Store (Games), is a beautiful and relaxing fish pond app. Customise and name each fish. Feed them daily. Watch them grow. Collect new fish. Escape and Relax.

1114150.name: CarX Street
1114150.short_description: Conquer mountain roads, highways, and city streets. Build your dream car with detailed tuning that unleashes the potential of “CarX Technology”© physics. Take part in thrilling races, enjoying realistic gameplay and dynamic driving.

1114220.name: Gedonia
1114220.short_description: Gedonia is a classic open world rpg, featuring a complete freedom of building your character, exploring a huge world and completing quests.

1114290.name: Windjammers 2
1114290.short_description: The best flying disc game of all time is back, with amazing hand-drawn graphics, crazy new moves, gameplay mechanics and awesome characters and stages! New update brings new playable characters, new training mode, full crossplay support and more.

1114430.name: Ballex
1114430.short_description: In Ver.1.1 update, Ballex has added a new chapter: Chapter3, including new levels(13 to 17), with difficulty and challenges. We have optimized a lot of problems, added new screen Settings and so on. Go ahead and update it! Come and experience this difficult game! XD

1114530.name: TTV3
1114530.short_description: TTV3 is the third volume of the retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame series Trip to Vinelands

1114650.name: HorrorVale
1114650.short_description: HorrorVale: A spooky, horror themed RPG adventure!

1114830.name: Armor Clash 3
1114830.short_description: Armor Clash 3 is an old-school modern warfare RTS game with base building and navies. There are 3 factions with unique units, buildings and technology systems. There are both skirmish and challenge modes. The battle is fast-paced, with realistic graphics and physical effects, and the performance is also optimized.

1114870.name: Lenna's Inception
1114870.short_description: The legendary hero is dead, and a strange glitch is spreading across the kingdom. Explore dangerous dungeons, and defeat the eight archangels to restore order to an unraveling world in this epic action-adventure RPG.

1114950.name: Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech
1114950.short_description: Dialogue changes from English to Japanese as you learn and progress in this comedic RPG backed by professional Japanese voice acting. This is a full introductory Japanese course and adventure all in one. Master hiragana, basic grammar, and over 240 common words used in anime!

1115050.name: Will You Snail?
1115050.short_description: A unique platformer where an evil AI predicts your movement. Dodge AI-spawned traps, solve optional puzzles and uncover the dark secrets of the simulation. Now with a level editor and infinite community-made content!

1123030.name: WHO IS AWESOME
1123030.short_description: A singleplayer mini-game collection, in which the most awesome character that you choose competes with the characters that you didn’t.

1123050.name: GRIME
1123050.short_description: Destroy... Absorb... Grow... GRIME is a fast and unforgiving Action-Adventure RPG in which you crush your foes with living weapons that mutate form and function, and then consume their remains with a black hole to strengthen your vessel as you break apart a world of anatomical horror and intrigue.

1123450.name: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
1123450.short_description: A top-down adventure game in a coloring book world full of vibrant characters. Use painting powers to explore, solve puzzles, make friends, and draw on anything! From creators on Wandersong + Celeste.

1123770.name: Curse of the Dead Gods
1123770.short_description: You seek untold riches, eternal life, divine powers - it leads to this accursed temple, a seemingly-infinite labyrinth of bottomless pits, deadly traps, and monsters.

1123830.name: Farm Manager 2021
1123830.short_description: Farm Manager 2021 is an indie game that lets you relax and immerse yourself in farm management. A casual but grounded builder game that combines management and farm maintenance in one package. Grow and expand your farm into a thriving estate or enjoy it as a delightful escape from everyday life.

1124060.name: Touhou Shoujo Tale of Beautiful Memories / 東方少女綺想譚
1124060.short_description: Journey through a pixelated, isometric version of Gensoukyou in this quasi-3D action RPG! Dash and jump to avoid enemies, or shoot them down from far! Hit the right buttons at the right time to accumulate power and battle efficiently! Play as Reimu and friends and get to the bottom of the incident!

1124080.name: Brave's Rage
1124080.short_description: Brave's Rage is a challenging roguelite deckbuilding game that features an ATB combat system. Players will have to think critically to build their decks and make strategic decisions in the nick of time. Create your dynamic duo from a total of 9 playable Braves and face 20 different challenge tiers!

1124160.name: VR Giants
1124160.short_description: VR Giants is a local coop VR game in which one VR player and one gamepad player work together. The VR player controls a giant and must protect and support the tiny player who is controlled by the screen player. The tiny player can use the body of the giant as an extension of the level.

1124180.name: Rail Route
1124180.short_description: In Rail Route, you will design, construct, upgrade, and automate your railway network in one of the many maps based on real-life cities worldwide. Dispatch the trains to make the traffic flow and the network grow!

1124260.name: Snowtopia
1124260.short_description: Build your ideal ski resort. Keep skiers smiling with fresh pistes and fine facilities. Ski, build and chill in the wintry world of Snowtopia where everyone is welcome!

1124300.name: HUMANKIND™
1124300.short_description: Rewrite history by shaping a civilization as unique as you are. Combine 60 cultures from the Ancient Era to the Modern Age to lead your empire to victory. Build thriving cities, outsmart rivals in epic battles, spread your influence and leave your mark on HUMANKIND™.

1124560.name: Fallen Angel
1124560.short_description: Tossed aside and cast out. It's time to claim your birthright. Rise as Lucifer and battle the armies of the afterlife and ascend through the weird and warped realms of heaven and claim vengeance.

1124660.name: STORM AREA 51: AYY LMAO EDITION
1124660.short_description: STORM AREA 51: AYY LMAO EDITION - it's time to Storm AREA 51, and see them aliens. If we Naruto Run, we can move faster than their bullets. Rock Throwers will throw pebbles (to annoy them enough to not shoot the Kyles as often). They can't stop all of us...

1124830.name: 东方华彩乱战 ~ Touhou Blooming Chaos
1124830.short_description: Touhou Blooming Chaos is a shooting game, Reimu Hakurei and Marisa, fighting enemies with barrages and spell cards. Unlike general shooting games, the operation is more flexible and there are more areas to explore. A gorgeous game experience is irresistible!

1125110.name: Obsurity
1125110.short_description: Discover all the secrets of two completely different worlds.

1125240.name: Ancient Dungeon VR
1125240.short_description: Ancient Dungeon VR is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with randomly generated dungeons. Uncover its secrets and challenge powerful bosses.

1125330.name: Griefhelm
1125330.short_description: Griefhelm is an award-winning party game with lethal medieval weaponry. Skewer your friends, deflect their blows, and push your advantage in local and online multiplayer. Find some friends and cut off their heads!

1137300.name: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One
1137300.short_description: In this story-driven detective thriller, a young Sherlock Holmes struggles to prove himself as he navigates an exotic, dangerous island in the Mediterranean to investigate the mystery of his mother’s death.

1137350.name: Filament
1137350.short_description: Solve challenging cable-based puzzles and uncover what really happened to the crew of The Alabaster. Now with Hint System (for those ultra tricky puzzles).

1137410.name: Depraved Awakening
1137410.short_description: You are a private eye in Free City. Your latest client has found himself dead. As for how, many suspect suicide, though you're smarter than that. But poking around may get you in some hot water, but then again why would you be a private eye if you couldn't take the heat?

1137450.name: Encodya
1137450.short_description: Neo Berlin 2062. Tina – a nine-year-old orphan – lives with SAM-53 – her big clumsy robot guardian –in a rooftop makeshift shelter in Neo-Berlin, a dark megalopolis controlled by corporations.

1137460.name: ALTF4
1137460.short_description: [3D 3rd Person Perma-Death Runner Game]Try to overcome various obstacles until the end.

1137490.name: Invasion 2037
1137490.short_description: Become a survival scientist in a savage post-apocalyptic world where aliens have the control of the world and find a cure, manage your shelter and fight to survive

1137750.name: Farmer's Life
1137750.short_description: 🌾Unleash the Farmer within. 🚜 Dive into the rustic charm of rural living in "Farmer's Life," where you'll experience the joy and challenges of life on a vibrant farmstead. Plant, grow, and embrace a country living in a vast open world. You choose from diverse mechanics and endless possibilities.

1137970.name: Zombies Ate My Neighbors and Ghoul Patrol
1137970.short_description: Enjoy 16-bit console gaming with the cult classic Zombies Ate My Neighbors and its sequel, Ghoul Patrol!

1138100.name: Touhou Ibunseki - Ayaria Dawn: ReCreation
1138100.short_description: (English Version Available) A classical Monopoly-like game with 20+ Touhou characters and 10+ official maps. Custom level editor, double resource system (money & crystal), electric dispatching, SP required dice throwing and weather system bring you a whole different game experience. Original characters are waiting for your challenge!

1138410.name: Demons Never Lie
1138410.short_description: Demons Never Lie is a creepy graphic adventure made with voxel and low-poly where even your soul is at stake! An incredible and dark story with elements of the classic point&click and visual novels. An exciting interactive experience with a unique atmosphere.

1138440.name: Galactic Ruler
1138440.short_description: Galactic Ruler offers real time strategy game play at both planetary level and in space! Lead your faction in diplomacy or conquest across a procedurally generated galactic map where any system might hold hostile enemies or resource riches. Develop advanced technologies to rule the galaxy!

1138580.name: Farmington County
1138580.short_description: Farming & town living sim. Develop the farm of your dreams using tools, tractors, trucks & other vehicles. Build cabins, sheds, barns, and more! Hire workers to help out in your farm. Grow thousands of crops, raise hundreds of livestock and explore the world of Farmington County!

1138640.name: Hometopia
1138640.short_description: Hometopia is the ultimate home design and building game, offering unmatched customization and stunning graphics. Design and construct your dream homes or entire neighborhoods, solo or with friends. Bring your architectural visions to life exactly as you imagine.

1138660.name: Black Book
1138660.short_description: “Black Book” is a dark RPG Adventure, based on Slavic myths, in which you play as a young sorceress. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures.

1138850.name: Heavenly Bodies
1138850.short_description: Wrangle the hands and arms of a 1970s space cosmonaut and push, pull and twist your way through an increasingly precarious range of physically simulated stellar scenarios, where without gravity, nothing is still, nothing is secure, and nothing is simple.

1138910.name: Escape Mind
1138910.short_description: Discover the mysteries and challenging puzzles of Escape Mind. A brief Adventure in Point & Click in Escape Room style. With average play time of 30min.

1139160.name: Divided Reigns
1139160.short_description: The full-scale, epic fantasy role-playing experience you've wanted for decades--Divided Reigns retains what made the JRPG classics so fantastic while still feeling fresh. Expect strategic battles, an epic scale, well-developed characters, and a deep and emotional story. Perfect for your Steam Deck!

1139280.name: The Big Con
1139280.short_description: Hustle your way across ‘90s America as a runaway teen con artist. Choose how to make your scratch as you don disguises, pick pockets, and rip people off in this comedic crime-filled adventure. Experience the totally rad '90s in all its plaid and payphone glory!

1139800.name: Chinatris
1139800.short_description: Chinatris is a Tetris-like game about Chinese characters where different charactersfall to create new ones. To win, you must create the target characters from each stage. You’ll be having fun while learning Chinese!

1139870.name: The Dark Eye : Book of Heroes
1139870.short_description: Experience classical role-playing together with your friends in a co-op multiplayer RPG based on THE DARK EYE license that lets you engage in party-based adventures in the fantasy world of Aventuria.

1139890.name: Dictators:No Peace Countryballs
1139890.short_description: Dictators : No Peace Countryballs is a war simulation and dictator game. This is a fun,simple and some say a funny countryballs game. If you like simulation games, you will love playing Dictators : No Peace. Play as a dictator of your favourite country and colonize the world.

1139900.name: Ghostrunner
1139900.short_description: Ghostrunner offers a unique single-player experience: fast-paced, violent combat, and an original setting that blends science fiction with post-apocalyptic themes. It tells the story of a world that has already ended and its inhabitants who fight to survive.

1139940.name: ATOM RPG Trudograd
1139940.short_description: ATOM RPG: Trudograd is a turn-based post-apocalyptic roleplaying game, which continues the story of ATOM RPG as a stand-alone sequel/expansion, and follows the traditions set by classic cRPGs such as the early Fallout and Wasteland titles.

1139980.name: Travellers Rest
1139980.short_description: Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters.

1140100.name: The Persistence
1140100.short_description: Survive aboard a doomed deep space colony starship, overrun with horrific and murderous aberrations. Explore, evade and fight your way through the depths to bring the ship back to Earth. Gather resources, upgrade abilities and fabricate an arsenal of weapons in this sci-fi horror roguelite.

1140150.name: 东方光耀夜 ~ Lost Branch of Legend
1140150.short_description: Welcome to Eientei, combine multiple colors of mana to build your ideal deck, duel with gensokyo girls, and chase back the mysterious moon treasure. Also, enjoy the unpredictable Roguelike with fantasy Danmaku!

1140170.name: Arietta of Spirits
1140170.short_description: Arietta of Spirits is a story-driven action-adventure game, with easy to approach game mechanics. Follow Arietta on her journey to unveil the mysteries of the Spirit Realm and immerse yourself in a story filled with emotion and surprising turns.

1474200.name: Sudoku RPG
1474200.short_description: Sudoku RPG is a new style of game that combines Sudoku Puzzle and RPG genres. The only thing that can help a miner who has been named a hero by God's mistake is your excellent brain and concentration.

1474740.name: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
1474740.short_description: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

1474930.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator
1474930.short_description: Transport oversized cargo in a variety of missions across a 175km² open world. Drive customisable, highly detailed trucks through dynamic weather and day and night. The official cooperation with Gruber Logistics allows you to get behind the wheel of real-life heavy cargo transports.

1475460.name: 3 Minute Heroes
1475460.short_description: 3 Minute Heroes is a real-time strategy game that combines tower defense, deck building, and rogue-like genres. Place your champions, use cards, and keep your home safe for 3 minutes!

1475810.name: Ghostwire: Tokyo
1475810.short_description: Tokyo's population has vanished, and deadly supernatural forces prowl the streets. Use an arsenal of elemental abilities to unravel the truth behind the disappearance and save Tokyo.

1475840.name: RHYTHM SPROUT
1475840.short_description: Enjoy chill Lo-fi walks and fight bosses to K-POP, EDM and Hip-Hop inspired tracks. Features a quirky story, 30 handcrafted levels and various EX-modes to refresh your gameplay.

1475850.name: Rugby 22
1475850.short_description: Crouch, bind, set! Discover the true rugby experience. Play with best clubs and top nations, enjoy dynamic gameplay that stays faithful to the sport, and experience the intensity of big matches.

1476170.name: Godstrike
1476170.short_description: Godstrike is a twin-stick shooter where time is your health and currency. Face off against ruthless bosses in tense, 1v1 showdowns as Talaal, the last Herald.

1476340.name: The Adventure of NAYU
1476340.short_description: Nayu is a fox who lives in a strangely cozy world.Go on a little adventure with Nayu ♪ in this adorable clicker-like game for everyone to enjoy.

1487680.name: Broken Universe - Tower Defense
1487680.short_description: Get ready to rethink all your defense strategies! Build barricades to stop monsters, or lure them into a maze and attack. A variety of stages that change each time depending on how you play them.

1488100.name: IncrediMarble
1488100.short_description: Build amazing marble contraptions with IncrediMarble! Enjoy idle incremental tycoon sandbox simulation gameplay with the best physics Unity can offer. It's like that old toy you had as a kid!

1488200.name: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga
1488200.short_description: Enter Tahnra, a land savaged by war. You, a fresh academy graduate with humble beginnings, will grow to lead a grand army against a corrupt adversary. Gather heroes, form bonds, and lead your force in turn-based battles. Make use of tactics, terrain, morale and more to bring peace to the land!

1488560.name: Football Simulator
1488560.short_description: Step onto the gridiron with Football Simulator and experience the most dynamic and physics-driven football game ever made. Break through tackles, juggle tipped passes, and dive for interceptions to lead your team to victory. Features a fully moddable environment.

1488810.name: Rabbit Hole
1488810.short_description: An ancient evil has descended upon the rural town of Rabbit Hole. Now Shaun Turner not only has to untangle a twisted web of supernatural events and mysteries to save his family but also escape from the hellish remains of his hometown.

1489410.name: Alice Escaped!
1489410.short_description: Explore the stylish world of Wonderland with Usada and Kotora as they search for a mysterious girl named Alice! A Metroidvania action game with a rich, exhilarating battle system all wrapped up in cuteness!

1489590.name: Astronite
1489590.short_description: Astronite is a 1bit metroidvania that combines action, exploration, puzzles and platforms. Recover the planet where you and yours lived before it was invaded by strange creatures.

1489630.name: Carrier Command 2
1489630.short_description: Carrier Command 2 is the real-time strategy game that puts you in command of a futuristic carrier capable of deploying a vast array of aircraft and amphibious units. Compete against AI or human players and hop into every single vehicle to take matters into your own hands!

1489970.name: Highrise City
1489970.short_description: Highrise City offers a new spin on City Simulations & Tycoon games expanding the economy and resource management aspect. Experience a modern take on the genre enriched with a complex resource based economy system.

1490060.name: Disillusion
1490060.short_description: A mysterious muse calls upon you to investigate a Large tower in an oneiric land.

1490130.name: CrashMetal Cyberpunk
1490130.short_description: CrashMetal - Cyberpunk The Hokuta City streets await your engine rev. Can you beat everyone in this race for first place? Upgrade your car, take care of its appearance and defeat everyone on the streets of the Hokuta City.

1490250.name: Harem Hunter: Sex-ray Vision
1490250.short_description: Instead of X-Ray vision, our hero has unlocked the power of Sex-Ray vision! At a glance, see all of a girl’s dirty little secrets: their kinks, sensitive spots, and anything else you'll need to know to get them to leave their adventuring party and join your harem!

1490340.name: We Are OFK
1490340.short_description: Pop. Love. Panic! Start a band in this dreamy, musical journey from indiepop cuties OFK. Cry, skate, date, and run for your life in 5 interactive music videos, across a heartfelt story of what you risk to chase your dreams.

1490410.name: The fairy tale you don't know
1490410.short_description: 《Little Red Riding Hood》，《Snow White》，《Alice in Wonderland》，《Thumbelina》……， Let's travel to these well-known fairy tales' world, and play hide and seek with the heroines! In this game, you can rewrite the ending of these well-known fairy tales.
developers: Flying Panjandrum / ふらいんぐパンジャンドラム

1490460.name: 玄女诛魔录
1490460.short_description: The player will play the role of nine JiuTianXuannu, who will fight with many demons, meet and help the innocent in six different and interconnected worlds, and finally go deep into the hinterland of magic city to uncover the truth of the ancient mystery between magic seal city and Xuannu family.

1490610.name: METALLIC CHILD
1490610.short_description: “Grab, hurl, and eliminate” Rogue-lite Core-Action!! A large-scale rebellion erupts within the spacecraft “Life Stream.” With the help of you, Rona, an android known as “Metallic Child,” stands up against a fleet of massive robots to stop the plot devised by her own creator, Doctor Irene.

1490840.name: Bloodshore
1490840.short_description: Bloodshore is an interactive action movie about a televised battle royale between high-profile streamers, entertainers and death row inmates. You control the fate of Nick, a washed-up actor who fights for a life-changing cash prize.

1501410.name: Dwarf Journey
1501410.short_description: Dwarf Journey is an action roguelite platformer with randomly generated levels. Defeat enemies, level up, assemble your rune build and collect minerals to forge better equipment on an epic journey in search of immortality.

1501490.name: Ship Handling Simulator
1501490.short_description: Ship handling, maneuvering and mooring with tugboats simulator. Feel like the captain of a passenger ships, cruise liners, cargo ships, battleships or aircraft carrier.

1501610.name: Nova Lands
1501610.short_description: Nova Lands is a factory building, exploration, and island management game. Explore, engage in combat, and automate your industry. The planet you’re on is full of mysteries, creatures, people, and things to do. Welcome to your new home amongst the stars!

1501690.name: Dice Kingdoms
1501690.short_description: Compete against friends in games filled with unpredictable twists and turns. Roll the dice to gather resources and test your adaptability. Lead your kingdom to success through military power, religious knowledge, or architectural ingenuity.

1501750.name: Lords of the Fallen
1501750.short_description: A vast world awaits in the medieval, dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen. As a fabled Dark Crusader, embark on an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the demon God. Now includes significant performance improvements & custom difficulty modifiers.

1502080.name: ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos
1502080.short_description: A sci-fi adventure full of robot battles, pop music, and emotion. Featuring one of the largest branching storylines ever in a VR game with 15-20 hours of gameplay, Altdeus will place you in the shoes of Chloe, a pilot in humanity's forces fighting massive hostile organisms known as the Meteora.

1502190.name: From Space
1502190.short_description: From Space is a solo and co-op action-shooter for squads up to four players. Take on the challenge of liberating the earth from an alien infestation with your friends, using over-the-top weaponry in a post-apocalyptic world with awesomely stylized graphics. The apocalypse has never been so much fun!

1502230.name: Tower of Waifus
1502230.short_description: Tower of Waifu is a Tactical match 3 puzzle game. Learning spells, upgrading your stats and creating your own tactics, conquer the tower, defeat bosses.

1502380.name: Combat Mission Black Sea
1502380.short_description: Combat Mission Black Sea is a military grade simulation depicting a fictional series of escalations between Russian and Ukraine which results in open conflict in the summer of 2017

1502560.name: The Smurfs - Mission Vileaf
1502560.short_description: Go on an adventure to save your forest! Gargamel, the evil sorcerer just created the VILEAF, a plant that has the ability to attract and capture the Smurfs... but it's also TOXIC! Embody 4 iconic Smurfs and heal the plants on your way to Gargamel's hovel: the whole forest depends on you!

1502970.name: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book DX
1502970.short_description: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Sophie" is the 1st instalment: a chance encounter between Sophie and a sentient book Plachta takes them on an adventure to recover Plachta's memories.

1502980.name: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey DX
1502980.short_description: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Firis" is the 2nd instalment: after Firis encounters alchemy and is able to leave town, she is taken on a magical journey that has no limits.

1502990.name: Atelier Lydie & Suelle: The Alchemists and the Mysterious Paintings DX
1502990.short_description: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Lydie & Suelle" is the 3rd instalment: after discovering a mysterious painting, Lydie & Suelle get closer to their dream of running the best atelier.

1503040.name: Purplis Sandbox
1503040.short_description: Create your own worlds, build interesting mechanisms and just beautiful buildings, everything depends on your imagination.

1503530.name: Minit Fun Racer
