1849890.short_description: Every neko girl loves cleanliness, wants to clean and take care of a master. And every certain maid has a secret — someone loves to be photographed in the master's mirror, the other loves to escape to the beach during a coffee break ...

1849900.name: Among Us VR
1849900.short_description: Teamwork and betrayal in space! In this VR party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original game, but now in your own virtual spaceship.

1850050.name: Alien: Rogue Incursion
1850050.short_description: Alien: Rogue Incursion is an all-new action-horror VR game that transforms you into ex-Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks on a dangerous mission to the uncharted planet Purdan, featuring innovative real-life motion gameplay, a whole-body loadout, and the most cunning Xenomorphs ever encountered.

1850160.name: Poly Bridge 3
1850160.short_description: The best just got better! Rediscover your engineering creativity in this genre-defining bridge engineering and puzzle solving masterpiece.

1850270.name: Dream Hacker
1850270.short_description: With the help of the dream machine, you can invade the dreams of sleeping girls. Here you can do whatever you want, or you can help them by interpreting their dreams and then collecting the “reward” you want.

1850510.name: TRIANGLE STRATEGY
1850510.short_description: A new tactics RPG from the team who brought you the Bravely series and Octopath Traveler. An epic tale, brought to life with stunning HD-2D graphics. Make difficult decisions in this story set against a backdrop of the war-torn continent of Norzelia.

1850550.name: I'm on Observation Duty 5
1850550.short_description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

1850570.name: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
1850570.short_description: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America. Can you reunite the shattered world, one step at a time?

1850740.name: Ghost Watchers
1850740.short_description: Ghost Watchers is a co-op online horror game. You will explore and hunt ghosts in abandoned houses

1856030.name: Fresh Start Cleaning Simulator
1856030.short_description: Fresh Start is a relaxing single player game, in which you embark on a mission to clean up the world and restore nature to its fresh and colorful shape. Watch as the world changes in front of your eyes as you help animals, solve puzzles and grow plants around you.

1856190.name: Hello Engineer: Scrap Machines Constructor
1856190.short_description: Build incredible machines with scrap parts, navigate the wildest Amusement park rides and challenge iconic creepy Neighbor and his evil bots! Become a true Engineer, solo or with friends!

1856480.name: KamiYaba: Destiny on a Dicey Deadline
1856480.short_description: “If you don't tie the knot with the person of your dreams within the next year, you'll be in big trouble.” So forewarns Urara, the self-proclaimed Goddess of Matchmaking... kicking off a rowdy rom-com adventure!

1856900.name: Andro Dunos 2
1856900.short_description: The sequel of the famous Shoot'em up from the Visco studio is back, 30 years after the first opus, released exclusively on Neo-Geo MVS and Neo-Geo AES in 1992 . It's time to bring out your good old battle ship in ANDRO DUNOS 2!

1857020.name: Escort Simulator 2
1857020.short_description: Escort Simulator 2 is an immersive real time 3D adult RPG playground where you control the look of a attractive escort avatar exploring the hidden pleasures of a secret Polynesian island. Your imagination is the only limit to the potential fantasies in this deep and ever changing erotic universe.

1857080.name: The Last Starship
1857080.short_description: The Last Starship is a 2D space construction game where you design and upgrade your starship. Choose your path: pirate hunter, miner, engineer, spacebus driver, and more, whilst exploring vibrant star systems. Enjoy a growing sandbox world, with regular free updates. Your cosmic adventure awaits!

1857090.name: Norland
1857090.short_description: Lead your noble family in this medieval colony sim, facing off against class conflict, religious struggle, and political treachery. Tend to your people’s needs, uncover the lost knowledge of a fallen empire, and engage in nefarious plots against your enemies.

1863290.name: SpunkStock: Music Festival
1863290.short_description: Sneak backstage in a well known music festival. Use unique, and diverse rhythm game mechanics to build your relationships with the artists. Build your own play style and difficulty through the game's "modifier" system. SpunkStock features fully animated scenes for each artist.

1863430.name: Dragonkin: The Banished
1863430.short_description: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

1863670.name: Mystwood Manor
1863670.short_description: Mystwood Manor is an adult game, in which you play a young man who is in charge of running a hotel full of beautiful women. Experience hours of exciting content, in this adult hotel management game, filled with steamy sex scenes, amusing dialogs and some very unexpected plot twists.

1863750.name: 挂机神话
1863750.short_description: 挂爆电费，休闲摸鱼，偷懒耍滑！现代修真为皮；刷宝养成为骨；擦边玩梗为神。宅度与中二度突破天际，在游戏库内随时出击杀掉那些无聊的时间。其将为放置游戏中最妖艳的奇葩；其名为 挂 机 神 话 ！

1864790.name: 1BITDRAGON
1864790.short_description: Anyone can make music! 1BITDRAGON is a music creation software super easy to use, instant and fun.

1870700.name: The Edge of Allegoria
1870700.short_description: Turn-based RPG, inspired by classic titles from the golden age of handheld gaming. But make no mistake: This ain't no f@#%ing kid's game.

1871310.name: Hook 2
1871310.short_description: Get Hook’d on unhooking the hooks again.

1871480.name: EdgeLords
1871480.short_description: Confront your sorceress rivals and claim their magical 'essence' for your own in this fully-animated and voiced hentai card game!

1871510.name: Within Skerry
1871510.short_description: The Accumulation of Evil is an ancient book stating that if enough evil energy is concentrated in a single area, a dark force may be born.Humans can sometimes be very horrible creatures - but sometimes, it is taken a bit too far.

1875830.name: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance
1875830.short_description: Become a mighty demigod and battle through a decimated Tokyo in a war between angels and demons. Make new allies along your journey, engage in intense, turn-based combat, recruit hundreds of demons and forge your own path to dictate the fate of all existence.

1875950.name: Gilded Shadows
1875950.short_description: A GxB visual novel that explores a whimsical, yet dangerous world which blends the solarpunk and cyberpunk aesthetics into a unique adventure. As you follow the MC on her journey, pursue various love interests in a stand-alone story unique to that route.

1876460.name: Salty Hounds
1876460.short_description: A unique dating sim adventure that gives you total freedom to romance five handsome guys in an open-world metropolis.

1876590.name: I Am Your Beast
1876590.short_description: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

1876830.name: Life after Death
1876830.short_description: Do you remember the scares that chased you in childhood? How did your limbs shake with fear, take your breath away, and you couldn't do anything about it? I invite you to live it all over again!

1876880.name: Primitive Society Simulator
1876880.short_description: In this game, you'll be the leader of an ancient tribe, guiding your people to explore the natural world, to hunt, and to farm. As culture and civilization prosper, you shall establish a tribal alliance, a community with a shared future of tribes.

1876890.name: Wandering Sword
1876890.short_description: Wandering Sword is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be.

1882240.name: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection One
1882240.short_description: The Forgotten Realms Archive - Collection One allows you to journey through the set of adventures: the Eye of the Beholder trilogy, a collection of first-person, real-time role-playing games.

1882280.name: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Two
1882280.short_description: The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two brings a healthy mix of “Gold Box” and nostalgia goodness to your PC, along with a combination of adventure builders, turn-based and real-time role-playing gameplay.

1882500.name: Cattails: Wildwood Story
1882500.short_description: Become a cat! In this cozy life sim RPG, you'll lead your colony into the mysterious Wildwood. Hunt prey, harvest herbs, collect magical treasures, & defend your new home from intruders. Build a thriving town to recruit new cats. Get to know the residents, fall in love, & raise a litter of kittens!

1882580.name: FALL GIRLS
1882580.short_description: FALL GIRLS is a casual arcade runner with unique setting.It`s a competition, where you should pass the levels one by one.You will play as a female protagonist.

1883000.name: HEART of CROWN Online
1883000.short_description: The great emperor's untimely death... Seven princesses are candidates for his succession! Who will save the empire from chaos? An online deck-growing card game where you grow your deck and fight for the Princess.

1883090.name: The Symbiant
1883090.short_description: The Symbiant is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about two men, both from vastly different worlds, embracing their sexuality and their newfound romance. It is also a tale of interstellar friendship and being gay in space!

1883260.name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
1883260.short_description: Join the genius alchemist Noah and her cat companion Zipper as they explore ancient ruins to uncover the secrets hidden within! Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

1888930.name: The Last of Us™ Part I
1888930.short_description: Discover the award-winning game that inspired the critically acclaimed television show. Guide Joel and Ellie through a post-apocalyptic America, and encounter unforgettable allies and enemies in The Last of Us™.

1889040.name: Birth
1889040.short_description: You are alone. You will build a creature, a partner, a wet warm heart, a collection of bones.

1889620.name: AI Roguelite
1889620.short_description: World's first RPG in which all entities are AI-generated and all game mechanics are AI-directed.

1889640.name: The Backrooms: Survival
1889640.short_description: Survival horror with roguelike elements. Explore randomized levels with different items and entities while trying to maintain your thirst, hunger, and sanity, ensuring a new experience every time. Play alone or with up to TEN friends online! Cross-platform multiplayer with Nintendo Switch.

1889740.name: Paper Trail
1889740.short_description: Paper Trail is a top-down puzzle adventure about leaving home, set in a foldable, paper world.

1889930.name: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance II
1889930.short_description: An old-school hack-and-slash action RPG awaits! Pick one of five heroes, defeat monstrous enemies with weapons and spells, loot treasure and level up in this classic D&D fantasy adventure.

1894600.name: Monster
1894600.short_description: This is a casual Sokoban game. Players need to use the keyboard to control the female character to complete the task and move to the next level.

1894720.name: Motordoom
1894720.short_description: Motördoom is a freestyle-sports roguelite horde shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics. Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

1895350.name: I Wani Hug that Gator!
1895350.short_description: I Wani Hug that Gator! Is a choice-driven narrative about teenagers struggling to find their way. Help Inco, loser highschooler extraordinaire, navigate his budding friendships (and romance!) while surviving being the only human in a dinosaur-filled school.

1895370.name: College Bound: Arctic Adventure
1895370.short_description: An official spin-off of College Bound, a game loved by hundreds of thousands players all over the Internet. Hop on a plane and spend best winter break of your life in beautiful Iceland! Meet new people, play winter sports, try your luck in seducing local hotties, become a detective...and much more!

1895630.name: VRM Posing Desktop
1895630.short_description: Accelerate the creation of 3D models! This is a highly functional posing tool for Vtubers, 3D modelers, and illustrators to use.Make your VRM character take various poses using poses you created or others' poses.Various useful functions are available.

1895810.name: Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai
1895810.short_description: The memories of the Hero, in your hands! Experience the story of the legendary anime series, DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai, in an exhilarating action role-playing game that combines stunning visuals with art from the anime and manga.

1895820.name: Greedventory
1895820.short_description: Greedventory is a gorgeous pixel-art linear action RPG experience, where the only thing between you and an embarrassingly swift death is your mouse. Strike, parry, and cast powerful spells on your enemies, loot ancient treasures, explore a brutal realm, and become the hero you never wanted to be!

1895860.name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2
1895860.short_description: This is a "Mysterious Dungeon" style roguelike game where the terrain changes with each challenge. Make the monsters your "Friends" and go on a new adventure!

1895880.name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
1895880.short_description: Blast your way through an interdimensional adventure with Ratchet and Clank – now on PC! Help them take on an evil emperor from another reality as you jump between action-packed worlds and beyond at hyper-speed!

1895890.name: 9 Childs Street
1895890.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. In 9 Childs Street you will find the terrifying atmosphere of a recently abandoned house, and its captive inhabitants, through the eyes of a curious little boy in a red cap.

1900930.name: DANGO!
1900930.short_description: DANGO! - is a casual liquid puzzle game. You need to pass a variety of levels, draw a path through which the liquid will flow and fill the vessel.

1901340.name: Ero Manager
1901340.short_description: As a new guy, he is so nervous to report to his direct boss that he has never met before, but he didn't expect it to be a stern female boss like a queen. But this is what it looks like, but in reality, no one knows about her inner feelings. Challenge her bravely, and you may find out her secret.

1901370.name: Ib
1901370.short_description: A 2D exploration adventure game set in a creepy, mysterious art gallery.

1901620.name: Dungeon Travelers: To Heart 2 in Another World
1901620.short_description: The dungeon is dangerous and deep, but with the right party, you can conquer every nook and cranny. Find loot, equip your party, and customize your classes to master the turn-based RPG combat in this old-school dungeon crawler!

1901810.name: Nearly Dead - Live and Let Die
1901810.short_description: 2D top-down multi co-op action game. Survive the zombies together with a stranger.

1901910.name: Ultimate General: American Revolution
1901910.short_description: American Revolution is a sandbox strategy game featuring the epic historical period during the rebellion of the American colonies against the British Empire.

1910600.name: ONE BTN BOSSES
1910600.short_description: It's One Button Bosses, it's all in the name. You have one button. There are big bosses to beat. Push, tap, and bash in the handcrafted campaign or in the roguelike rifts.

1910680.name: Orb of Creation
1910680.short_description: Orb of Creation is an active incremental-puzzle game in which you recreate the world with nothing but magic and ingenuity. Conjure resources, buy upgrades, and become an all-powerful wizard!

1910790.name: Lunar Mirror
1910790.short_description: "Lunar Mirror" It is a horror suspense decryption game with the theme of Cthulhu in the research institute. Nishimura Qiren's girlfriend mysteriously disappeared on campus. As the investigation deepened, strange events happened one after another

1910860.name: Grimlord
1910860.short_description: Grimlord is a Dark Fantasy Action Souls-like RPG - on VR. Awakened in a monastery deep in the Lonely Mountains, you walk in an epic quest as the adventurer standing before the darkness and striving for the light against the tyrannical Grim Lord.

1911360.name: Trinity Fusion
1911360.short_description: ANOMALY WARP Update Out Now! Take control of your parallel selves and explore dark, Sci-Fi worlds. Slash, bash and shoot your way through this unique rogue-lite metroidvania where the only way to save the multiverse is to end it.

1911390.name: Knightfall: A Daring Journey
1911390.short_description: Two knights, a strong bond, and a long journey. Take up the race for the rose, ride from town to town and take shelter before nightfall by any means necessary! If your bond is strong and your horse drifts well, you can be the recipient of the fabled rose. Luckily you brought guns!

1911610.name: Windblown
1911610.short_description: Brave the Vortex and dash your way to greatness in this lightning-fast action roguelite for 1-3 players from the crafters of Dead Cells. Absorb the powers of fallen warriors, rebuild their weapons, and WIPE THE FLOOR with those Sentinels in search of that perfect run!

1912340.name: The Fantasy World of Mahjong Princess
1912340.short_description: This is a 2D Japanese Mahjong game with adult simulation features. You are a big Mahjong fan who got reincarnated in another world. As the world‘s top Mahjong tutor, you need to build your own team and train your students while developing special relationships with them.

1912420.name: Sunshine Shuffle
1912420.short_description: Play cards with a group of adorable animal friends who robbed the largest bank on the Eastern Seaboard 12 years ago, and are willing to let you decorate their boat in return for not being executed by the mafia.

1924140.name: ISEKAI FRONTLINE
1924140.short_description: You are the only 'guy' in this zombie apocalypse world! Fight with endless zombie hordes and have a good time with cute girls!

1924170.name: TT Isle Of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
1924170.short_description: An iconic course for motorbike fans. 200km of open roads to practise on. Challenging physics. A simulation for the best riders.

1924180.name: Phantom Spark
1924180.short_description: The best feeling racing game out there. Precision time-trial racing against npc champions in the campaign or other players on the leaderboards.

1924360.name: Lil' Guardsman
1924360.short_description: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

1924400.name: Hand of Doom
1924400.short_description: Sign a contract in blood! Travel throughout the planes of existence slaying or befriending powerful doomlords in this wizard simulator inspired by the FMV games and dungeon crawlers of the early 90's. Learn powerful spells to solve puzzles and combat the dark forces amassing against you.

1924430.name: Cookie Cutter
1924430.short_description: Fueled by love but driven by rage, Cherry embarks on a blood-soaked quest for revenge, explores the massive Megastructure, and eviscerates the armies of Infornet in a best-in-class action-adventure that breaks tropes and bones.

1924480.name: College Kings 2 - Episode 1
1924480.short_description: College Kings 2 is the highly anticipated sequel to the popular choice-driven Adult Visual Novel. Dive into a world of parties, sex and love as a college freshman and make your wildest fantasies come true.

1924490.name: Gigantic: Rampage Edition
1924490.short_description: GO GIGANTIC! THE UNIQUE MOBA HERO SHOOTER RETURNS!

1924680.name: MILF Conditioning
1924680.short_description: You happened to save a MILF who happened to be the wife of your landlord, yet she had a weak character that didn't match her status – she couldn't refuse others. Having learnt that, would you take advantage and sleep with the beautiful landlady?

1924780.name: Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore
1924780.short_description: A NEW interactive animated adventure! In this action-adventure game, Arzette must explore the Kingdom of Faramore, slay fearsome foes, acquire powerful items, discover secrets, assist colorful characters, and defeat the evil Daimur!

1924990.name: HOBGOB ～Please Save Me～
1924990.short_description: “If the mouth on the top won't open, then we'll have to start with the other mouth...” You have seven days to find a way to get her to open her mouth. Will her mouth open first, or will she get pregnant first…? This is a 3D+ simulation game!

1925010.name: Rich Lady's Slave Role Play
1925010.short_description: I reluctantly agreed to accommodate my difficult supervisor from the company I had previously worked for – but, in return, she started to “play slave” as her payment! She’s calling me “master” and occasionally stripping me of my clothes, even putting her hands on me! What the hell was going on!?!

1925090.name: SubwaySim Hamburg
1925090.short_description: Explore the picturesque U3 line of Hamburg's elevated railroad in the new SubwaySim Hamburg!

1925210.name: Estella's Nightmare: Sealed Space and a Succubus's Curse
1925210.short_description: In search of a cure for her father's illness, Estella, a cat-eared girl, entered the Cursed Forest by herself. When she accidentally activated a mysterious crystal, she was drawn into an alien dimension sealed by a magical anomaly. She then met a woman who called herself「Succubus」and gained mysterious powers from her...

1925320.name: Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist
1925320.short_description: "Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist" is a co-operative atmospheric reverse escape-room puzzle game. You are a master thief who has been hired to rob a mysterious mansion, filled with various puzzles. Do you think you have what it takes to conquer the challenges that await you in the mansion.

1925970.name: SIMULACRA 3
1925970.short_description: The town of Stonecreek is haunted. People keep disappearing into thin air, leaving nothing but an eerie symbol behind. With the townsfolk gripped with fear, use a missing victim's phone to unlock the truth in the third entry of the acclaimed horror series, SIMULACRA.

1926090.name: Coreborn
1926090.short_description: A fun survival game set in the open world of Ultracore. Build, grow and defend your town from attacking enemies. Go on adventures to loot, gather resources, discover a beautiful fantasy map, unlock Skills, build bases, find mounts and shape the world. Alone or together with friends old and new.

1926270.name: Bloodhound
1926270.short_description: Crush the cult of Astaroth and vanquish her hellspawn, make them squeal and hide where they came from. Enjoy a Fresh Look & Old Fun in this arcade horror FPS game inspired by the legends of the 90s.

1926520.name: Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator
1926520.short_description: Dedicate your life to saving others. As soon as you receive the emergency call, speed off to the site of the accident in your ambulance, sirens wailing. Apply first aid and transport the seriously injured to hospital. Every second counts!

1926590.name: Nancy Drew®: Mystery of the Seven Keys
1926590.short_description: A thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history! Play as Nancy Drew to uncover the truth behind the theft of a client's heirloom necklace. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a sinister web of cyber crime, and sleuth through Prague's mysterious streets entwined with medieval legends and alchemy.

1926620.name: The Backrooms: Lost Tape
1926620.short_description: You work in the cinema as an usher and accidentally fell into the Backrooms, now being trapped, needing to unravel the mysteries of the yellow rooms in order to get out of this place, but be careful, there are entities that will be in your way.

1934800.name: a pet shop after dark
1934800.short_description: PETSITTER WANTED. A horror point-and-click adventure game. Water the plants, feed the pets, and DON'T turn off the lights.

1934910.name: Kunado Chronicles
1934910.short_description: The dragon is already dead. Help what's left of humanity learn how to live in this post-apocalyptic fantasy visual novel.

1935470.name: The Tales of Bayun
1935470.short_description: Can a flat world resting on the backs of three demon bears live in peace? Of course not! Immerse yourself in the universe of the dark Slavic legends, explore the characters' stories and make difficult choices that affect the course of events. Bayun the Cat will help you. If you're lucky, that is.

1935660.name: Chop Goblins
1935660.short_description: The Chop Goblins are loose, chopping their way through time itself in their ravenous quest for cheese. And the chop will not stop.

1936360.name: Escape From Mandrillia
1936360.short_description: Local VR vs PC horror game: 1 VR player controls a lone robot trying to escape an underground lab; up to 2 PC players control giant alien monkeys. Customize your experience with gameplay modifiers, ranging from tense survival stealth to brutal nonstop action!

1941410.name: The Cub
1941410.short_description: From the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Return to their whimsical, neon-lit apocalypse in a Jungle Book meets The Armageddon fusion. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a child being hunted, while catchy end-of-days tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.

1941840.name: Otoko Cross: Pretty Boys Mahjong Solitaire
1941840.short_description: Meet 5 cute cross-dressing characters as they challenge you to tile-matching mahjong solitaire! Clear the playfield and unlock new outfits for your companions in this celebration of Japanese "otokonoko" style and sub-culture.

1942010.name: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider
1942010.short_description: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider is a side-scrolling action platformer that channels the golden age of classic 16-bit action games in a full-throttle quest for revenge. Created to defend a totalitarian state, the Moonrider rejects its programming and now seeks vengeance on its creators.

1942110.name: Bootstrap Island
1942110.short_description: Bootstrap Island is an intense, realistic VR survival game, inspired by "Robinson Crusoe". As the sole survivor of a 17th-century shipwreck you must quickly learn and adapt to survive against vicious beasts, explore the island and improve your skills to discover the mysteries of the tropical island.

1942280.name: Brotato
1942280.short_description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

1946700.name: Layers of Fear
1946700.short_description: All stories must come to an end, even twisted and eerie ones. The canvas. The stage. The novel. This narrative-focused psychological horror experience is ready for its final brushstrokes, its curtain call, its final chapter. Are you ready to return and face your fears one last time?

1946970.name: Isle of Arrows
1946970.short_description: Isle of Arrows is a Puzzle Tower Defense game in which you build a fortress in the sky. Place towers, expand the isle, and build your own paths. Can you find the perfect spot for each tile to beat the RNG and defend against waves of invaders?

1947070.name: Broken Edge
1947070.short_description: Broken Edge is a 1v1 VR fantasy sword fighting game where you embody iconic warriors in deadly duels. Claim victory in the arena as a fierce Samurai, a valiant Knight, an untamed Rōnin, or one of the 5 other fighters (and more to come)!

1947500.name: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution
1947500.short_description: Hunted by the seemingly unstoppable Axeman and facing off against the Tower’s latest push for total dominance, discover what connects these new threats together before it’s too late. New faces, places, weapons and gear all await you on your journey to a final showdown for the city's fate.

1947530.name: Fidget Spinner RPG
1947530.short_description: Fidget Spinner RPG is a clicker/incremental RPG game in which you craft items and level up abilities to make a fidget spinner spin at absurd, ever increasing speeds.

1952760.name: RGB Rush
1952760.short_description: How accurately can you recreate a random colour? Forget using a colour picker, learn to form hex codes in your mind. Impress your crush. Prove your abilities under the clock, blindfolded. Practice today.

1952930.name: Soul Wargame
1952930.short_description: This is a dark style strategy game that combines Wargame and Rogulike. Everyone received a mysterious invitation after destroying the conspiracy of the cult. You will lead a group of undead warriors on an adventure journey to defeat invincible enemies one by one.

1958600.name: Barro F22
1958600.short_description: The new gen for the F version!

1958860.name: Otoko Cross: Pretty Boys Klondike Solitaire
1958860.short_description: Meet 5 cute cross-dressing characters as they challenge you to classic solitaire! Win with the cards you're dealt and unlock new outfits for your companions in this this celebration of Japanese "otokonoko" style and sub-culture.

1959140.name: Diesel Legacy: The Brazen Age
1959140.short_description: Diesel Legacy is a 2v2 fighting game where four players battle on the same stage at the same time. This unique twist on the traditional fighting game formula adds an entirely new layer of strategy where cooperation will become the key to success.

1959350.name: Homebody
1959350.short_description: An interactive thriller about a group of friends haunted by the memories of their past while being hunted by a relentless killer. From The Game Grumps (Dream Daddy)

1959390.name: Fear the Spotlight
1959390.short_description: Fear the Spotlight is an atmospheric third-person horror adventure with a disturbing mystery to unravel. Sneak into school after hours with Vivian and Amy, survive a séance gone wrong, solve tactile puzzles, and, whatever you do, stay out of the spotlight…

1959530.name: Extra Case: My Girlfriend's Secrets
1959530.short_description: Your girlfriend seems to be hiding something. Will you respect her privacy or pry into her secrets? Don't worry, though. This is a horror dating sim with a time loop, so you can try again...and again...and again...
developers: MaouCat Studio / 魔王貓工作室

1963370.name: No One Survived
1963370.short_description: This is a multiplayer cooperative open world construction survival sandbox game, where you and your friends must find supplies and build shelters in this world. You have to keep an eye on your character's needs state at all times, a bad state is likely to lead to death.

1963510.name: Herald of Havoc
1963510.short_description: Grab huge guns, mow down hundreds of enemies, reach the end of the level, repeat. It doesn't get any simpler than this. Embark on a 3 hour campaign with varied environments and situations, and beat the leaderboard on a tightly crafted survival mode.

1963570.name: Cuisineer
1963570.short_description: A super cute and tasty roguelite-flavored dungeon crawler! Explore a lush world and defeat monsters with your trusty spatula and some boba tea, then gather delicious ingredients and bring them home to cook and serve at your restaurant!

1964040.name: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099
1964040.short_description: Spy on strangers through security cameras, invade their privacy and discover their secrets in this digital voyeur simulator. Welcome to the future of The Primate Observation Club. Even in 2099 the rule about messing with your unlucky subjects still remains in this sequel: DO NOT feed the monkeys!

1964200.name: Phantom Rose 2 Sapphire
1964200.short_description: Phantom Rose 2 is a roguelike deckbuilding game. Fight and collect powerful cards as Aria, trying to survive in her cherished school that’s being ravaged by evil creatures.

1964360.name: Sexy Mystic Survivors
1964360.short_description: Roguelite bullet-hell combat meets sexy anime action in Sexy Mystic Survivors, as you rise to the occasion to help gorgeous heroines destroy countless invading monsters. Plan your builds, upgrade heroines, and survive against the clock. Keep the heroines alive and they’ll be sure to reward you!

1969060.name: Path of the Midnight Sun
1969060.short_description: Protect a noblewoman reckoning with unholy powers as she wards off the soul of the Demon King sealed inside her. Doubt your own companions, survive against unforgiving hordes of monsters. But beware; every choice has consequences in this epic JRPG adventure of betrayal, romance & self-acceptance.

1969080.name: A Building Full of Cats
1969080.short_description: A Building Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to pet all the cats in the building. Don't leave any cats behind!

1969100.name: MIGHT'N MOW'EM
1969100.short_description: Multiplayer Survivors: Meet MIGHT’N MOW’EM. Mow thousands of enemies with an ever-growing arsenal of weapons and magic, solo or with friends. Classes, upgrades, ultimates, quests, and group buffs add a rewarding meta game to a dopamine-filled core loop.

1969440.name: Sunday Gold
1969440.short_description: Sunday Gold is a point-and-click, turn-based adventure game set in grim, dystopian future. Play as a ragtag trio of criminals to hunt down and expose the dark secrets of an evil mega-corporation and the malevolent billionaire behind it.

1969960.name: Super Hero Flash Fist
1969960.short_description: Battle monsters and maintain the peace, as "Flash Fist" an elite L City superhero! Make sure to fend off the monsters' sexual harrassment and lewd attacks!

1970020.name: 东方妖精武踏会
1970020.short_description: You will role-play as playful fairies with unique personalities, and accomplish your own Gekokujō in Gensokyo where the strong gather! Make your own favorite fairy character the strongest with your own hands!

1970060.name: Tomboy Adventure
1970060.short_description: Start a relaxing adventure together with your childhood friend!

1976950.name: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind
1976950.short_description: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind bestows bites of tactical roguelike action, which will quickly fester into a deep, lingering, and strategic obsession. Bargain with gods, equip your spoon and pick your battles, before retreating into the healing darkness. But beware… there are still many monsters to face!

1976980.name: Denos City: Complete Game
1976980.short_description: Final version of Denos City. Adult Visual Novel. The game includes a walkthrough so you don't miss any scene of the game.

1977110.name: Line Path
1977110.short_description: A mind-bending puzzle game about filling all in one line Relax and enjoy

1977170.name: Jusant
1977170.short_description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

1981820.name: Strike Force Heroes
1981820.short_description: Strike Force Heroes is an oldschool arena shooter rebuilt with modern mechanics with full co-operative and PvP online multiplayer. It melds over the top action with epic story-telling in this intense remake of the hit Flash game.

1982150.name: RWBY: Arrowfell
1982150.short_description: Dive into an explosive new RWBY adventure! Instantly switch between Ruby, Weiss, Blake, and Yang, and use their weapons and Semblances to battle a mysterious new threat in this in-canon story set during RWBY Volume 7! Featuring a new song by Jeff Williams with vocals by Casey Lee Williams!

1982340.name: Blanc
1982340.short_description: Blanc is an artistic cooperative adventure that follows the journey of a wolf cub and a fawn stranded in a vast, snowy wilderness. They must come together in an unlikely partnership to find their families.

1985810.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops Cold War
1985810.short_description: Black Ops Cold War, the direct sequel to Call of Duty®: Black Ops, will drop fans into the depths of the Cold War’s volatile geopolitical battle of the early 1980s.

1985820.name: Call of Duty®: Vanguard
1985820.short_description: Call of Duty®: Vanguard includes a deeply engaging single player Campaign, a massive Multiplayer offering featuring over 20 maps including 16 built for core Multiplayer and an exciting new Zombies experience developed by Treyarch.

1985930.name: The Backrooms 1998 - Found Footage Backroom Survival Horror Game
1985930.short_description: The Backrooms: 1998 is a first-person found footage psychological horror survival game where it tells the story of a young teen after accidentally falling into the depths of The Backrooms in 1998. Roam freely, mark, explore and try unravel the story - however you are not alone. Don't scream.

1985960.name: Ogu and the Secret Forest
1985960.short_description: Explore the wonderful world with baby Ogu! 'Ogu and the Secret Forest' is a 2D adventure game with hand-drawn characters and various types of puzzles. Befriend bouncy characters and defeat strange creatures to unravel the mystery of the charming world.

1986010.name: 灵墟
1986010.short_description: 这是一款以仙侠为背景的开放世界单机游戏。在这个玄幻的仙侠世界里，有种类繁多的江湖任务，庞大复杂的世界结构，各具特色的英魂记忆，丰富多样的动态装备，耐人寻味的奇人奇事，实时变幻的日夜天气。在这里，你可以利用任何方式进行提升，成为什么样的人，做什么样的事，通通由你自己决定！

1986230.name: What if your girl was a frog?
1986230.short_description: There was a frog. She was cheerfully croaking on her lake. However, she was not a simple frog, but magic. And so she got a lonely boy. She used her magic and started her adventures.

1986390.name: Passed Out
1986390.short_description: Survive in this terrific BattleRoyale with 2000 zombies arround you. Be the last man standing to enter in the Zombie Horde Mode and reach the top of the leaderboard. Good luck survivors..

1986550.name: LOLLIPOP: SUMMER!
1986550.short_description: LOLLIPOP: SUMMER! is an exciting puzzle game with delicious, sweet candy combinations! In the game LOLLIPOP: SUMMER! You will find many bright and varied visuals and very beautiful music.

1990050.name: Creature Creator
1990050.short_description: Create your own creatures to explore online worlds with friends and collect new parts to upgrade your stats and abilities! Complete quests, battle enemies, challenge friends to minigames, or just have fun roleplaying — the possibilities are endless when your imagination is the limit!

1990110.name: SpellRogue
1990110.short_description: SpellRogue is the ultimate tactical turn-based roguelike! Draft from over 350 powerful spells to assemble the perfect combination and crush your enemies in 70+ unique encounters. Face brutal choices, adapt to impossible odds, and strike back at the horrors that destroyed the world.

1990260.name: Phantom Tentacle
1990260.short_description: 《Phantom Tentacle》is a story decryption game! The sealed ghost tentacles descended on the town again. Players will play ghost tentacles, attacking lone villagers, capturing nuns, and sneaking to escape from the hunters of knights. Finally rule the whole town!

1990590.name: Nightmare Hunter
1990590.short_description: One day in the dream, some one showed up and claimed there is a dream called paradise. From that day, dream demons that can suck human memory and spirit increased. In order to make everything return to its original state, Yoru, who awakened as a demon hunter, decided to challenge the initiator.

2002570.name: SeaOrama: World of Shipping
2002570.short_description: Experience the challenges of running a successful shipping company with Seaorama: World of Shipping.

2003050.name: Perseus: Titan Slayer
2003050.short_description: Defeat the Titans as you battle your way into Tartarus to stop Chaos from conquering Olympus and destroying the world. In this rogue-like dungeon crawler adventure, you will play as Perseus, a demigod tasked with one mission; stop Chaos and the evil forces that surround him.

2007530.name: Spellbook Demonslayers
2007530.short_description: Slay endless hordes of demons to protect the Cosmic Library! Steal their abilities, find powerful equipment, and unlock the secrets of each spellbook to become unstoppable! Will you be able to destroy the demonic legion?

2011410.name: Monstrous Love
2011410.short_description: Monstrous Love contains three adult short stories, focusing on women discovering their sexuality and freedom with gentle yet ferocious monsters. Be seduced by a world of love, sex, and claws in this sex-positive gaming experience!

2011470.name: 大侠请重来
2011470.short_description: 无限重来，再战江湖，10分钟一局

2011780.name: Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom
2011780.short_description: Make full use of your advanced move-set to navigate hand-crafted retro worlds without a jump button in this vibrant love letter to the N64 era of collectathons!

2011860.name: Refund Me If You Can
2011860.short_description: One maze, one monster tracking you down, will you have the courage and dexterity to escape this nightmare in less than two hours ?

2017610.name: CORPUS EDAX
2017610.short_description: An immersive first-person-melee RPG where you create your character and fight, talk or sneak your way out of confrontation. From concrete buildings to futuristic environments - start from the bottom and make your way through narrative missions to the top of the city in a bid for control.

2017620.name: Beloved Rapture
2017620.short_description: Beloved Rapture is an indie jRPG inspired by the classics. Explore beautiful landscapes, fight in turn-based battles, and uncover many secrets. This mid-length adventure balances both an intimate coming of age story, and larger threats looming over the troubled kingdom.

2017890.name: My Dream is a Lost Memory
2017890.short_description: My dream is a Lost Memory is a short interactive story about having Déjà vu, realizing that this Déjà vu came to you because of a dream, and then wondering if that dream is actually a memory. It's a story about work, limitations and self-respect.

2018130.name: Desktopia: A Desktop Village Simulator
2018130.short_description: Desktopia is a city-builder game which simulates an evolving, medieval-esque village along the bottom of your desktop, allowing you to work, watch, or browse something else while you play.

2018230.name: Femdom Wife Game - Zoe
2018230.short_description: "Femdom Wife Game - Zoe" is a relationship simulator. Zoe, your partner, has grown tired of your sex life and wants to try new things. Only she wants to be the one in charge. The game offers both authenticity and immersion. Start your new life with Zoe!

2018640.name: 我的猫娘恋人 My Cat Girl Lover
2018640.short_description: Zirui, who lives alone, takes in a dying black cat. One rainy night the black cat suddenly 'bad-mouthed' Zirui. The next day, the black cat disappears and at the same time, a cat lady who resembles the black cat appears in Zirui's bed ......

2024230.name: Project Lazarus
2024230.short_description: You are the first party mech pilot of alien planet colonizers! Project Lazarus is a survival game with rogue-lite elements. Deploy and upgrade your mech to the metal!

2024300.name: HideAlone
2024300.short_description: You try to play dangerous hide and seek with a doll at home alone. Started out of curiosity, this hide-and-seek game has rules that must be followed or your life will be at risk. Never get caught by them, stay calm and survive to the end.

2024390.name: Mato Anomalies
2024390.short_description: Mato Anomalies takes players on a journey through a neo-futuristic version of a bygone oriental city. Investigate strange happenings across the city and uncover secrets behind the walls. Join a cast of enigmatic unlikely heroes in this anime-inspired RPG experience.

2052040.name: Golden Lap
2052040.short_description: Step into the polished shoes of a racing team manager in the heart-stirring Golden Era of motorsport where every decision can lead to glory or gravel. With sleek minimalist charm and deep strategic gameplay, Golden Lap offers a unique experience in the motorsport management genre.

2052410.name: WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
2052410.short_description: A tale told with vivid colors and rich sound in a classic TYPE-MOON visual novel.

2052990.name: My Lovely Empress
2052990.short_description: My Lovely Empress is an empire management sim inspired by Asian mythology. As the Emperor of the Crimson Empire, you will build relations with neighboring rulers, balance internal factions, and ensure the prosperity of your people, all before you reap their souls to resurrect your beloved empress.

2058570.name: Rift Wizard 2
2058570.short_description: Rift Wizard 2 is a tough as nails traditional roguelike wizard simulator. You play as an immortal amnesiac wizard who must journey through the cosmos to defeat his nemesis. Each run, you'll build a unique repertoire of spells, passive skills, and magical artifacts.

2058750.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 6
2058750.short_description: Mud, sweat, adrenaline, and fun: all the best the motocross and dirt bike world has to offer awaits you in the new Monster Energy Supercross 6!

2059170.name: Quasimorph
2059170.short_description: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based extraction RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

2059310.name: Daily life with my succubus boss
2059310.short_description: You summon a succubus to escape the torment at work, only to find that she looks just like your abusive boss! Can you endure living under the same roof with the bane of your existence and the ultimate object of your desire?

2059530.name: Dawn of Defiance
2059530.short_description: You are the Defier, subjected to a mythic plot across ruined isles. In this Greek myth-inspired survival craft, ascend from weak soldier to god-like anti-hero. Build impressive Greek structures, craft and upgrade your gear, and face down the trials of Gods with up to 3 friends.

2059660.name: Cavern of Dreams
2059660.short_description: Embark on a magical quest as Fynn the dragon to rescue your unhatched siblings from the mysterious Cavern of Dreams in this N64-style 3D platformer. Gain new abilities, meet unique characters, solve puzzles, and beware of the mysterious villain.

2059670.name: Moss: Book II
2059670.short_description: Quill is back—and she’s being hunted. To stand a chance, Quill will need a true partner by her side—and we hope that partner is you. Moss: Book II is an action-adventure puzzle game and award-winning sequel (The Game Awards "Best VR/AR Game") to Moss.

2059790.name: 再刷一把 PlayAgain
2059790.short_description: 你是一个前往轮回的灵魂，被神秘人拦截，送你到了一个叫做"神魔之塔"的地方，冒险由此开始... 本游戏融合了卡牌抽取+角色养成+宠物养成+宠物合成+暗黑类刷宝+爬塔+轻微肉鸽+符文之语等玩法的游戏，如果你是一个喜欢刷宝玩家千万不要错过！！

2059810.name: Richman 4
2059810.short_description: *** This game is only available in Chinese ***《大富翁4》为掷骰子回合制桌上游戏，玩家在游玩时，除可购买土地、股票外，还可投资公司、参加拍卖，过足富豪瘾。游戏支持单人、多人游玩，玩家既可以与计算机AI角色一同游玩自得其乐，也可和二三好友一起，来一局富豪间的财富PK。

2060000.name: Great Deceiver
2060000.short_description: Marie Mamiya reigns supreme, and by her whim, she'll train an ordinary man into shape—in the pursuit of beauty.

2060130.name: Return to Monkey Island
2060130.short_description: Return to Monkey Island is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games.

2065800.name: Defending Lydia Collier
2065800.short_description: Lydia Collier has been charged with the murder of her billionaire husband after he mysteriously vanished, and it is your job to prove her innocence. Find evidence, follow leads, make decisions and crack the case, and whilst you do it date and find love in London as a newly single, wealthy lawyer.

2065810.name: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis
2065810.short_description: As a powerful necromancer you have the ability to raise the dead and command them in battle. With each victory, your army will grow stronger and your city will become more powerful. Undead Horde 2 is an action game with elements from RPG, strategy and hack'n'slash. Rise from the crypt and rebuild!

2066020.name: Soulstone Survivors
2066020.short_description: Face the Lords of the Void and their endless minions, collect their Soulstones and become a god! In this Action Roguelite, unveil secret spells, craft mighty weapons, unlock multiple characters, discover game-breaking synergies and conquer the power of the void.

2066240.name: Bughouse
2066240.short_description: Play as Christopher, a kid left home alone with a terrifying STALKER on the loose! Try and survive in this 80's, PS1 inspired, Home Invasion Survival Horror game - OR DIE TRYING!

2072450.name: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth
2072450.short_description: Two larger-than-life heroes, Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu are brought together by the hand of fate, or perhaps something more sinister… Live it up in Japan and explore all that Hawaii has to offer in an RPG adventure so big it spans the Pacific.

2072640.name: Inout
2072640.short_description: INOUT is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. For years, the locals have been afraid of an old mansion in Madyland. A possessed maniac and an ancient evil have settled here. Become a member of a team of exorcists and expel the evil force!

2072660.name: Voidborn
2072660.short_description: Voidborn is a fast-paced roguelite FPS that combines skill-based action and swift movement with roguelite level progression and character customization. Rip apart demons with devastating weapon builds and reach as far as possible before you inevitably perish and become reborn stronger than ever.

2072840.name: Word Factori
2072840.short_description: Word Factori is a word-building game where your only resource is the letter "i". Build a chain of factories to bend, rotate, reflect, and merge "i" into more complex letters. Discover secret letter recipes, unlock hidden word art, and optimize your factory chains for high scores.

2073250.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
2073250.short_description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

2073470.name: Kanjozoku Game レーサー
2073470.short_description: 90s Osaka Kanjo Night Street Racing and Drift Online with True JDM Cars, Online PvP, Engine, Body and Suspension Tuning!

2078510.name: VIVIDLOPE
2078510.short_description: Rapid gravity arcade action! Dash! Spin! Slam! Paint!

2078780.name: 苦主救助中心Ⅰ
2078780.short_description: This is a role-playing game, the game adopts the expression of dynamic comics. You can play the game by dragging similar to the comics.

2079180.name: VIDEOVERSE
2079180.short_description: Relive the days of the early internet and dive into this fictional video game era, where the 'Kinmoku Shark’ gaming system and its online social network 'Videoverse' were still popular…

2085360.name: Insomnia: Theater in the Head
2085360.short_description: Hickory dickory dock. The city's deep in sleep. The clock's ticking. The sheep's bouncing. Hickory dickory dock. The girl tosses again, only with more things swarming into her head... In this Point & Click puzzle game "Insomnia", the show in the head is rolling on again. Alas, any sleep tonight...

2085370.name: Classified: France '44
2085370.short_description: Command an elite team of allied special operators in Nazi-occupied France wreaking havoc in the run up to D-Day in this ambitious turn-based tactics game. Take on the might of Germany's war machine and launch daring raids in occupied territory. Can you do enough to ensure Allied victory?

2085410.name: Women's Prison 絕對人權女子監獄
2085410.short_description: You're a prison officer in an experimental woman's prison. You must satisfy their every need... even their sexual desires must be tended to! Be careful though. If there are enough complaints against you, you may be transferred to the men's :male_sign: prison!?

2085800.name: Kalinur
2085800.short_description: Defeat the mage Kalinur and bring peace back to the kingdom in this mini metroidvania with a lot of action.

2085920.name: TYRONE vs COPS VR
2085920.short_description: Sip lean and shoot cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America... Fully reimagined for VR!

2086140.name: RICE™
2086140.short_description: A rich paragraph of information which will try to charm and pique interest, trying to catch your eye in a sea of competition using a slew of buzzwords such as ‘bullet heaven’ and ‘in-depth meta-progression’, in a vain attempt to make you believe this game is any different from others in its genre.

2086150.name: Curse of Black Bone
2086150.short_description: Adventure awaits in Port Royal, a town of treasures, mysteries and beautiful women! This epic, story-rich experience features hundreds of animated shots (mostly naughty ones), and a large world, filled with collectible treasures, booty calls, and an abundance of fun secrets and mysteries to uncover.

2086430.name: NIMRODS
2086430.short_description: Assemble a limitless arsenal in this survive-em-up roguelite shooter. As a Gun Manufacturer's testing force, your mission is simple: test the latest gun tech and scavenge alien planets. Collect insane weapon parts to invent crazy guns that slay thousands. You may not survive, but your guns will!

2091960.name: The Utility Room
2091960.short_description: This VR Journey takes you to the 'behind the scenes' of the Universe. Beyond a door lies a barren landscape inhabited by strange rocky heads. Here, the maintenance and heavy lifting required keeps existence stable and temporal. You are a tourist. Don't do anything foolish.

2092730.name: Archaeogem
2092730.short_description: Hats up and whips out; the wilderness' mysteries await! Explore lush biomes, use your trusty whip to extract wild flowers' mystic powers, and collect rare gems in this dynamic precision-platformer. Unearth archaeological marvels and become a legend!

2092850.name: Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross
2092850.short_description: A story-driven deckbuilding RPG set in the history of Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross. Unlike traditional deckbuilders, the teammates you recruit decide the success or failure of battles. Fight the war against the Teutonic, or tackle roguelite runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.

2093000.name: Homeseek
2093000.short_description: Homeseek is a post-apocalyptic survival strategy game set on a resource-strapped Earth at the turn of the next century. In a dried-up wasteland where water has become the new gold, every choice you make becomes life or death.

2093010.name: Supernatural
2093010.short_description: Detective Wyatt confronts a chilling mystery as he investigates a housemaid's disappearance. Unearth sinister secrets as you navigate through a haunted house, where every shadow hides a lurking terror.

2097540.name: My First Femboy Date
2097540.short_description: You've matched with a cute femboy on an app. The date is set and you meet him at the amusement park.

2097720.name: バレットフィリア達の闇市場　〜 100th Black Market.
2097720.short_description: 東方Project第18.5弾。上海アリス幻樂団による弾幕シューティング！ 市場は２種類あった？　魔理沙が闇市場の調査（＆カード蒐集）に大奮闘！ アビリティカードを駆使して遊ぶ、ハイスピードでブラックなシューティング幻想！

2097890.name: Skull Island Rise of Kong
2097890.short_description: Embark on a quest to avenge the death of your parents at the hands of the alpha predator: Gaw. Conquer waves of primal beasts and defeat the minions of your arch-nemesis. Traverse the mysterious island and uncover secrets as you encounter swamps, waterfalls, jungle, and skullite-filled caves.

2098130.name: International Basketball Manager 23
2098130.short_description: Become the basketball manager of the moment and leave your mark by leading your own dynasty. Control all the management tools that International Basketball Manager 23 puts at your fingertips to take your team to the top. Manager, your time has come!

2101890.name: Zoonomaly
2101890.short_description: You must survive a monster infested zoo while searching for key shards that unlock the truth to its origin. Collect all the key shards by solving puzzles throughout the grounds and put a stop to the monster mayhem.

2102320.name: MISTROGUE: Mist and the Living Dungeons
2102320.short_description: MISTROGUE is a "Mystery Dungeon" style real-time action JRPG. Explore an ever-changing "Living Dungeon". Fight through the monster hordes and gimmicks with your own skill builds while paving your path with "Maze Stone"!

2106520.name: 私のリアルは充実しすぎている フルボイス版
2106520.short_description: 顔良し、頭良し、性格良し。 完全無欠のリア充女子が送るドタバタラブコメディ！（たぶん）

2106670.name: Gatekeeper
2106670.short_description: Gatekeeper is a fast-paced rogue-like. Go on a quest to find the stolen Heart of the Universe and shoot your way through the hordes of machine enemies guarding the planetary gates. Play solo or in 4 people co-op and become the next Guardian!

2106810.name: The Forest of Drizzling Rain
2106810.short_description: Alas, it was the "promised place," where Shiori was never meant to go. Finally, a remake of The Forest of Drizzling Rain, that masterpiece of an exploration horror game with multiple endings from the creator of the big hit Angels of Death!

2106840.name: PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo
2106840.short_description: How far would you go to bring someone back from the dead? Discover the depths that some will go to in this horror-adventure game.

2110510.name: DREAM LOGIC
2110510.short_description: DREAM LOGIC is a story driven first-person atmospheric horror game which takes place in liminal spaces. Explore various nostalgic, dreamlike, uncanny environments. But don't feel too safe, there's a sneaky creature watching your every move.

2110820.name: Granny Remake
2110820.short_description: Granny Remake is a gripping horror game where you must escape from a sinister house chased by a cunning and relentless Granny. Choose from multiple escape routes: drive away in a car, call the police, or unlock the main door

2110840.name: Legends of Amberland II
2110840.short_description: Legends of Amberland II: The Song of Trees is a classic western RPG inspired by great 90s era games such as Might & Magic, Wizardry, Ultima, the Gold Box series. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous adventure.

2111040.name: Dead Beacon
2111040.short_description: Dead Beacon is a first-person survival horror inspired by late 1990s games and taking place in the Beacon manor, a location crawling with zombies and creatures governed by a malevolent will. Survive using the given array of weapons and escape the island.

2111090.name: Let's! Revolution!
2111090.short_description: Let’s! Revolution! is a colorful roguelite puzzle mashup about stopping a narcissistic King from ruining your world. Flip tiles to uncover the hidden path to the King. Use deductive reasoning to avoid his cronies or take them all down in strategic turn-based combat.

2111170.name: STORY OF SEASONS: A Wonderful Life
2111170.short_description: Put down roots on your new farm in the peaceful town of Forgotten Valley. Bring life to the land by cultivating crops and raising animals, find love among the town's friendly folk, and make lasting memories with a family of your very own.

2111190.name: Mullet Mad Jack
2111190.short_description: MULLET MADJACK is a HIGH-OCTANE-ACTION SHOOTER that put you directly inside a CLASSIC ANIME. Pick your favorite weapon and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… OF YOUR ENEMIES!

2118120.name: Kind Words 2
2118120.short_description: A game about being kind to real people. Send nice letters from your cozy room, go outside and say hi to your neighbors, swap recommendations, dress up for the poetry slam and add your dreams to a sky full of wishes. Join a community of real people with their hearts on their sleeves.

2118130.name: Chicken Feet
2118130.short_description: Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.

2118250.name: Kitchen Crisis
2118250.short_description: Kitchen Crisis is a culinary defense game. You are abducted by aliens and must satisfy their appetite. If you want to live to see another day, efficiently arrange your cooking appliances, upgrade your ingredients and tools! In order to survive, make wise decisions according to everchaning recipes.

2118370.name: Bosorka
2118370.short_description: Bosorka is an exciting action roguelike where a young witch saves the world from insidious and cruel demons. Combine runes, master a variety of brooms, and try all possible and impossible spells until you gain enough power to fight evil.

2118420.name: Stories from Sol: The Gun-Dog
2118420.short_description: Survive the mystery that awaits the JFS Gun-Dog in deep space in this retro visual novel / graphic adventure.

2118500.name: Touhou Library Survivors
2118500.short_description: Thousands of fairies and familiar faces are swarming the Scarlet Devil Mansion Library! Help Patchouli Knowledge survive by attacking back with bullet hell Spell Cards, gathering experience, and upgrading exponentially!

2118540.name: My Big Sister: Remastered
2118540.short_description: My name is Luzia and this story is about my big sister, Sombria. Are you ready to hear it?

2118810.name: Breachway
2118810.short_description: Explore the galaxy in this deckbuilding, sci-fi roguelike where ship upgrades and crew management are key to your survival. Optimize resource generation, engage in intense turn-based battles, and take on ever-growing threats as you seek out The Signal.

2123140.name: The Scarlet Demonslayer
2123140.short_description: Agnis, the Scarlet Demonslayer, is the strongest of the demon eradication warriors battling against the calamities that plague the world. But after losing her powers, the nation is defenseless against the otherworldly attacks! To recover her lost magic, she must depend on her assistants to help her!

2123640.name: Hollowbody
2123640.short_description: A tech-noir survival horror short story, set in the urban decay of a long abandoned British city. Solve environmental puzzles, manage limited resources and fight for a way to escape beyond the wall.

2128270.name: Path of Achra
2128270.short_description: Path of Achra is a dark fantasy roguelike of the ancient earth, with a focus on streamlined controls and rapid hero customization. A "broken build sandbox." Fight through the deadly lands of Achra to reach the horrors of the Obelisk, and discover what lies beyond...

2132430.name: XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX
2132430.short_description: A paranoid cybercriminal tries to regain control over an underground marketplace stolen by his former coworkers. You must utilize your hacking and intelligence gathering skills to get rid of hitmen sent by your enemies in a race with worsening mental state and terrifying hallucinations.

2132560.name: On Your Tail
2132560.short_description: A cozy detective adventure where you play as a vacation-bound writer who stumbles upon an idyllic town plagued by an enigmatic thief. Crack the case in this charming seaside town, build relationships, and unravel secrets in a world full of quirky characters and heartwarming stories.

2132690.name: Vivat Slovakia
2132690.short_description: Vivat Slovakia is an open-world action game set in '90s Slovakia, where corruption runs deep and law enforcement is weak. Uncover a gripping story based on true events as you explore and shoot your way through a city at the crossroads of Eastern Europe’s turbulent history.

2132850.name: Rabbit and Steel
2132850.short_description: RABBIT & STEEL is a co-op action roguelike that recreates the essence of high-level MMO raiding in a randomized, simplified, bunny-sized package. Choose your class, gather your rabbit-eared companions and battle your way to the Moonlit Pinnacle!

2136380.name: HVS: Hitler VS Stalin
2136380.short_description: Play as Hitler on his mission to assassinate Stalin. Try an alternative history where Hitler actually succed with the Third Reich. Race, shoot and explore the Kremlin in Moscow.

2140650.name: Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos
2140650.short_description: Explore the wide world of Anthos with the help of your wacky inventor friend Doc Jr. and many others! It’ll be up to you to revive the Harvest Goddess and the Harvest Sprites, as well as reconnect all of the villages of Anthos with each other! Farm all around Anthos using the improved Expando-Farm!

2140850.name: Looper Tactics
2140850.short_description: Welcome again, wandering soul. Will this be the time of your success? Watch your steps as you advance in this roguelike-deck builder and engage in auto-battler card encounters of increasing difficulty. Get stronger in each battle, rise from the ashes, and break free from endless reincarnation!

2141520.name: Survivor Mercs
2141520.short_description: Lead your squad of Mercs against M.E.G.A. Corp.'s evil robot army. Fast-paced twin-stick action, frantic horde survival, tactical squad-building & lots of loot! Exploit game-breaking synergies and beat the evil billionaire bosses in ever-changing operations. Lock, load, and loot, Commander!

2146570.name: RKGK / Rakugaki
2146570.short_description: Turn heads. Drop jaws. Be bright. In this single-player 3D platformer, you’re the only one who can take down Mr. Buff and his lackies to restore color and life to the citizens of Cap City. Accompany Valah and the RKGK crew on their journey to take down the oppressive B Corp.

2147380.name: Silence of the Siren
2147380.short_description: A turn-based sci-fi strategy that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies for your heroes and destroy your opponents! This HoMM-like is set in a scifi universe, with new mechanics on top of the classic formula.

2153330.name: Otome * Domain
2153330.short_description: An inconveniently orphaned young man must attend an all-girls school just to survive in this comedy visual novel. His housemates took him in when he was in trouble, but now he doesn't know who's taking care of who...!

2153350.name: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons Remake
2153350.short_description: Guide two brothers on an epic journey of discovery, loss, adventure and mystery remade for the latest generation of graphics, performance, and gameplay. Play in single-player mode or local co-op with a friend. This is one journey you will never forget.

2153750.name: Venture to the Vile
2153750.short_description: Dive into the strange town of Rainybrook, taken over by the “Vile” in this 2.5D metroidvania! Fight your way through treacherous terrains and defeat formidable bosses to absorb their powers! Will you save the town and find your missing friend Ella — or will you give in to the monster you've become?

2153770.name: Coin Flipper
2153770.short_description: Heads or tails? Coin Flipper is an idle clicker game that is all about flipping lots of coins. Upgrade your coin flips and get even more coins to flip!

2153780.name: Survival Nation
2153780.short_description: An open-world online RPG, survival game designed for VR. In this game, you will kill hundreds of zombies, acquire weapons, learn new skills, craft, explore the world, complete quests, and fight for survival. Choose from three modes: Solo, PVE, and PVP. Will you join a Survival Nation?

2159730.name: 霸剑霄云录
2159730.short_description: “The Forgotten Concluder” is a third person perspective 3D Role-playing game base on the ancient Chinese fantasy wu-xia world. Being a young teenager Shen Zi-Jun that grew in a isolated valley, taking on a adventure to discover a great secret and his true dentity.

2160220.name: Shipwrecked 64
2160220.short_description: A recovered copy of a lost game from the late 1990s about a Beaver named Bucky and his friends trying to escape from an island they crashed upon.

2160360.name: Aero GPX
2160360.short_description: Aero GPX is an anti-gravity racer focused on high velocity, flight, machine-to-machine combat, and responsive controls that are easy to pick up but difficult to master. Fight for the best position possible with high speeds, risky maneuvers, and visceral attacks!

2160480.name: Hellboy Web of Wyrd
2160480.short_description: Hellboy Web of Wyrd is a roguelike action brawler with an original story created in partnership with Dark Horse Comics and Hellboy creator Mike Mignola. When an agent of the B.P.R.D. goes missing, Hellboy is sent to investigate; pulling him into the depths of the Wyrd.

2166640.name: Family curse
2166640.short_description: Family curse is a mystical horror from the first person with a frightening atmosphere. Immerse yourself in the intricate history of the Crouse family and find out the terrible secret of the people who died in the cursed house.

2167220.name: The Bible
2167220.short_description: A digital recreation of The Bible in Kinetic Novel form! Read through and save passages in any order with an original soundtrack, or listen through the greatest story ever told in audiobook form. Featuring an extensive Trivia section to find out how well you really know the stories of Old and New.

2171840.name: Project: Mirror
2171840.short_description: Project: MIRROR! is a world full of magic, there souls of beautiful girls have broken into several pieces during a violent and powerful storm. You are the only one who can help the beauties revive their souls!

2172010.name: Until Dawn™
2172010.short_description: Rebuilt and enhanced for PC – Until Dawn invites you to relive the nightmare, and immerse yourself in a gripping slasher horror where every decision can make the difference between life and death.

2172260.name: The Complex: Expedition
2172260.short_description: When an expedition with your team into the complex goes horribly wrong, you're left alone and lost, wandering the seemingly infinite maze of hallways, otherwise known as the Backrooms. Might there be something following you?

2172510.name: Fairy Biography2：Confidante
2172510.short_description: You need to use the left mouse button to click to control the demon refining pot, so that the refining demon pot can reasonably rebound and successfully repel the enemy, so as to achieve victory

2172860.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom
2172860.short_description: Traverse the Telvanni Peninsula in Morrowind and preserve secrets ascribed to the unfathomable realms of Apocrypha. Unlock the runic power of a brand-new class - the Arcanist - and fight to uphold reality itself.

2172900.name: Little Friends: Puppy Island
2172900.short_description: Get ready for a pawsome puppy adventure in Little Friends: Puppy Island! Discover exciting locations, dig up hidden treasures, build and expand your holiday resort, and meet plenty of lovable little friends to care for on your very own un-paw-gettable, tropical island adventure!

2178330.name: Glory & Miserable Survivors DX
2178330.short_description: Each heroine is a strong warrior in a different branch of the military, and she alone can hold off the approaching armies. What awaits the heroines is either a great victory or a desperate disaster...

2178480.name: Shiren the Wanderer: The Mystery Dungeon of Serpentcoil Island
2178480.short_description: A new adventure for Shiren and Koppa begins!

2178490.name: Seducing The Devil
2178490.short_description: Seducing The Devil is an erotic Visual Novel filled with choices and multiple endings. You'll encounter 4 major branches, each with its own unique plot. Will you follow your heart or give in to desire? The choice is yours. Are you ready to dive into a world of love and lust? Let the seduction begin!

2178570.name: Arthas - The Game
2178570.short_description: A great game about a Great man!

2178590.name: Coin Pusher Casino
2178590.short_description: Coin Pusher Casino brings the excitement of classic coin pusher machines to your computer! With its engaging gameplay and realistic physics, Coin Pusher Casino is a must-play for fans of arcade and coin pusher games!

2178930.name: Sexbot
2178930.short_description: Can't find a date for the homecoming dance? Then order AmaZone's Alexa today! Our newest version of Alexa is a super sexy humanoid robot ready to follow your every command! *AmaZone is not responsible for Alexa AI sentience or robo-hostility, or global destruction

2178990.name: Sodaman
2178990.short_description: Sodaman is a bullet-heaven roguelike where you play as a supersoldier fighting alien hordes with soda powers. Find game-breaking sodas and concoct custom cocktails. Discover planets, unlock weapons, sodas, cybernetics, power-up cards, and more. But first, crack open a cold one.

2179170.name: A Tower Full of Cats
2179170.short_description: A Tower Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to gather cats through the whole history of catkind... and beyond!

2179290.name: HerrAnwalt: Lawyers Legacy
2179290.short_description: You’re a Lawyer who tries to save students from a crazy headmaster. You need to survive a variety of school lessons and fight the different teachers

2179300.name: Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust
2179300.short_description: "Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust" is a single-player game that combines text adventure with turn-based combat and exploration. As someone aspiring to become a great hero, your journey through the martial arts world will not always be a solo endeavor.

2179380.name: Sand:box
2179380.short_description: "Falling sand" style particle sandbox, now with circuits and stickmen!

2179440.name: New Heights
2179440.short_description: The ultimate climbing and bouldering simulation game. Explore and climb 250 real world routes, create your own routes and compete against your friends from the safety of your computer.

2185030.name: Dealer's Life Legend
2185030.short_description: Become a legendary merchant and haggler in this medieval fantasy world. Explore, trade and use potions to give you the upper hand in the latest instalment of the tycoon phenomenon Dealer’s Life!

2185060.name: Two Point Museum
2185060.short_description: Curate and manage incredible museums! Explore to discover amazing artifacts. Design and refine the layout, keep staff happy, guests entertained, donations plentiful… and children off the exhibits

2185780.name: Return to abyss 重返深渊
2185780.short_description: Return to Abyss is a mowing survival game with Rogue-Lite elements, upgrade your weapons and use your fighting skills to fight through over 10,000 monsters on screen until defeat the culprit who brought chaos!

2191480.name: Jumbo Airport Story
2191480.short_description: Just imagine: your own world-famous airport! A game with sky-high levels of fun!

2191490.name: Pocket Academy 3
2191490.short_description: After 12 long years, we're back and bringing the school festival with us!

2192270.name: PumPum 2
2192270.short_description: PumPum comes back with new sexy girls, new game genre, lots of levels and colorful, juicy, extraordinarily hot animations! Don't waste your time on anything else, go and check PumPum 2!

2192620.name: ghostpia
2192620.short_description: "In my dreams, I can get out. In my dreams, I can fit in." 'ghostpia' mixes the adorable art style of an illustrated book with glitches-and-noise effects. There are no choices to be made. There's only a lonely girl in a ghost town and her story full of mystery, friendhood...and a bit of violence.

2197890.name: Paranormal Cleanup
2197890.short_description: Paranormal Cleanup is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. This is no ordinary clean-up job. You are employees of a cleaning company tasked with cleaning up haunted houses. Take out the trash, but don't get caught by the ghosts that haunt the place!

2198070.name: Cardboard Town
2198070.short_description: Cardboard Town is a city-building card game. Manage your resources, obtain upgrades, draw your cards and thrive! Random events, quest cards, and game modes make each run different.

2198150.name: Tiny Glade
2198150.short_description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

2198510.name: New Cycle
2198510.short_description: New Cycle is a city building game with focus on survival. After an apocalyptic series of solar flares, human society has been thrown into disarray. Establish a settlement and develop it all the way from humble beginnings to industrial metropolis.

2204830.name: Street Lords
2204830.short_description: Procedurally-generated gang warfare meets turn-based strategy and FPS action to deliver an immersive, brutal, endlessly-replayable strategic-shooter - generate your city, customise your gangs, and fight in first person on bloody urban battlefields.

2205190.name: Clown Of Duty
2205190.short_description: Experience the fast-paced contact with enemy, beautifully hand-crafted locations, gunsmithing, player customization and more, only in Clown of Duty!

2205330.name: Scourge Of War - Remastered
2205330.short_description: Welcome to Scourge of War, a real-time 3D computer game/simulation developed by NorbSoftDev, the company headed by renowned game designer Norb Timpko, designer of Mad Minute Games' acclaimed Take Command series. Scourge of War is the epitome of historical command simulations.

2205750.name: 女拳鬥士F-ist
2205750.short_description: One day, women became very powerful and dominated all fighting arenas. You had been living in seclusion for training for twenty years. You aimed at the championship of martial arts. Encountering female fighters all over the world, you had to do your best to defeat them successfully!

2205850.name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot
2205850.short_description: Create your fully customizable army of dwarves and lead them to victory! Strategize with up to 10 individual beardlings in this combination of classic RPGs, roguelikes and auto-battlers. Forge your own path and decimate orcs, fight trolls or battle dragons - There will be Glory, Death and Loot!
