1619520.short_description: Cross Blitz is a unique RPG deckbuilder featuring fast-paced tactical combat with loads of cards to collect and synergies to wield. Explore, level up, craft new cards and build the perfect decks as you carve your own path to victory!

1619540.name: Avalon
1619540.short_description: Rediscover love, joy and sex through the life of Avalon. Follow her journey of recovery and uncover the hardships of her Uncle's past in this slice of life adult visual novel.

1619570.name: Death Roads: Tournament
1619570.short_description: Combine deadly racing, deckbuilding, and roguelite style to get car battles unlike anything before! Choose a driver, car, weapons, and sponsors to overcome tactical encounters. Adapt to an ever-changing race to come out on top and earn entry into the last safe haven on the Divided States of America.

1619750.name: Karryn's Prison
1619750.short_description: Control the confident, sexy Karryn as she becomes the new Chief Warden in the notorious all-male prison in this RPG. Go manage the prison and its inmates, but can you also manage Karryn's ever rising desires? Experience the true adult game that fully marries adult elements into all gameplay!

1619790.name: Aggressor
1619790.short_description: Aggressor is a stylized air combat shooter with a physics-based damage model. Fly the greatest planes of the cold war and bring down the enemy with an arsenal of unique weaponry in a spectacular lightshow of force.

1620030.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Quest for Balance
1620030.short_description: Team Avatar is back! Relive the epic adventure of the original Avatar: The Last Airbender series, as you play as Aang and his 8 friends to explore the most unique locations from the series, solve challenging puzzles and experience the most heart touching moments of Aang’s story

1620040.name: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway
1620040.short_description: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway features a cast of over 40 iconic characters; drift, slide and boost your way to the finish line on tracks inspired by legendary Nickelodeon shows!

1630650.name: Neko Beach
1630650.short_description: At Neko Beach girls are hot by the sun and they are waiting for you with attention and shamelessness. And of course, there are the sea and palm trees.

1630910.name: SATANIC PANIC 666
1630910.short_description: Descend into hell and destroy the cursed tapes with occult music known as †HEAVY METAL† to save our children's souls. On your way you will face Satan himself.

1630920.name: Bright Lights of Svetlov
1630920.short_description: Bright Lights of Svetlov is a short, story-focused first person quest about a Soviet family facing harsh trials. Set in a fictional provincial town, it carefuly recreates the atmosphere and vibe of mid 1980s.

1631080.name: HoneySelect2Libido DX
1631080.short_description: The ultimate sex simulator is here! Honey Select 2: Libido Deluxe is a love letter to making love. Engage with high-quality, fully-customizable characters in every imaginable situation. From romantic candlelight sex to the most specific kinks, Honey Select is sure to satisfy you!

1631090.name: Alien maze
1631090.short_description: "Alien Maze" is a puzzle game to explore the maze. Players need to reach the exit in a limited time.

1631210.name: Be My Girlfriends
1631210.short_description: "Be My Girlfriends" is a beauty girl + magic obstacle dodging game + GALGAME combined game. You need to control the chickens, dodge all kinds of obstacles, avoid enemies, and girlfriends together to reach the love gate, so as to trigger the plot level ...

1631470.name: Critter Cove
1631470.short_description: A deep, open world life sim and town building game set in a cozy post-apocalyptic paradise. Restore an old town, sail across a mysterious archipelago. Hunt for relics and farm, fish & craft everything you need. Can you help turn Critter Cove into a thriving tourist town once again?

1631640.name: E.E.R.I.E
1631640.short_description: E.E.R.E.I is a open world TPS.In a modern magic world, play the role of three fully armed spirit girl from the eastern and western mythology, entering the dangerous war zone, using a variety of modern small arms and tactical equipment to complete their respective missions!

1631850.name: PolyClassic: Wild
1631850.short_description: This game is an action game that combines elements of the classic retro shooter and low poly styling. The player's task is to destroy all enemies that come across on the way.

1632490.name: Shashingo: Learn Japanese with Photography
1632490.short_description: Shashingo is an edutainment game that teaches you Japanese through virtual photography. With your trusty camera, take photographs of the fictional streets of Japan to capture new words and images as fully translated flash cards!

1642890.name: Disc Golf Valley
1642890.short_description: Disc Golf Valley is home to some of the most beautiful and challenging disc golf courses in the world. Fill up your disc bag, sign up for tournaments and challenge every course in the Valley.

1643310.name: Dungeons 4
1643310.short_description: The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

1643320.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
1643320.short_description: Discover the vast Chornobyl Exclusion Zone full of dangerous enemies, deadly anomalies and powerful artifacts. Unveil your own epic story as you make your way to the Heart of Chornobyl. Make your choices wisely, as they will determine your fate in the end.

1644320.name: Railway Empire 2
1644320.short_description: Don the coat of a clever entrepreneur, take over a small railway company in the early 1800s and turn your steam engines into the workhorses of the economy. Grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors.

1644490.name: Occult
1644490.short_description: Occult is a dynamic cooperative game with elements of horror and quest. You are waiting for a variety of opponents, puzzles and endings!

1644500.name: Masterplan Tycoon
1644500.short_description: Welcome to the resource management game where your creativity and logistics skills are put to the test! In this minimalistic simulation you will build interconnected chains of products and open new missions by completing various tasks to create the biggest system you can.

1644940.name: Loddlenaut
1644940.short_description: Play as an interstellar custodian sent to clean up a polluted ocean planet. Pick up trash, explore the vibrant waters, and take care of axolotl-like alien creatures!

1645820.name: SurrounDead
1645820.short_description: SurrounDead is an open world survival game. Taking place in a world ravaged by an apocalyptic catastrophe. The dead reign free and will stop at nothing to kill you.

1646030.name: Cat Slide Tiles
1646030.short_description: Move the sliding tiles to unblock a path for the kitten to walk to the exit.

1646580.name: Project Demigod
1646580.short_description: Suit up and save the day in Project Demigod, a physics-driven superhero sandbox with limitless possibilities.

1646850.name: SpaceBourne 2
1646850.short_description: Embark on a journey to greatness. Get ready for adrenaline-fueled battles and a chance to claim your place in the galaxy. Grab the controls of your ship, gear up for the fight, and unleash your ambition to conquer and build a new empire in the vastness of space.

1647190.name: World End Diner
1647190.short_description: Run a diner on the last island in the world after the destruction of humankind! For the cute animals and robots that survived, cook delicious food, run a farm, explore the forest, and create the best diner!

1656640.name: Four color jumps
1656640.short_description: Four color jumps is a leisure jumping game. The ball rises, crosses or touches the springboard, and constantly jumps up. Let's see where the limit of the ball is!

1656780.name: Hero's Hour
1656780.short_description: A fast turn-based strategy RPG with real-time combat. Develop your cities and armies, level up your heroes to gain new, powerful spells and skills, and explore the wonders and dangers of the procedurally generated maps as you aim to conquer your enemies before they do the same to you.

1656930.name: Coridden
1656930.short_description: Become the ultimate shapeshifter in this hack n’ slash ARPG with action-based combat. Transform seamlessly and customize both your human and beast powers as you level up, find new gear and DNA-strands. Venture out solo or in co-op to uncover the secrets sealed inside a legendary city.

1657630.name: Slime Rancher 2
1657630.short_description: Continue the adventures of Beatrix LeBeau as she journeys across the Slime Sea to Rainbow Island, a land brimming with ancient mysteries, and bursting with wiggly, new slimes to wrangle in this sequel to the smash-hit, Slime Rancher.

1658040.name: I Am Future: Cozy Apocalypse Survival
1658040.short_description: I Am Future is a relaxing single-player survival game about building a cozy rooftop camp amid a flooded post-apocalyptic city. Set up a farm, go fishing, tinker with gadgets, craft new tools, manage a team of cute robots to automate and expand your base, explore the mysterious world, and chill out!

1658150.name: Moonstone Island
1658150.short_description: Moonstone Island is a creature-collecting life-sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. Make friends, brew potions, collect Spirits, and test your strength in card-based encounters to complete your Alchemy training!

1658280.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
1658280.short_description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

1658290.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising
1658290.short_description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising is an action RPG set in the same world as Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Features town-upgrading mechanics, fast-paced combat. A prequel to the world of the Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

1658310.name: Wolf of Stock Street
1658310.short_description: New gameplay, fresh style, unique stock market themes, so you can't stop playing! How to combine financial games with adult content? Invite you to experience the unprecedented, ridiculous but unstoppable way of lewd wolves in the stock market!

1658920.name: Crown Wars: The Black Prince
1658920.short_description: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights and brigands run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. From your castle base, rise to become the lord who leads the battle against the forces of evil in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

1658930.name: Blazing Aries
1658930.short_description: The game tells the story of a new adventurer named Aries. She visits all kinds of cities, travels around the unknown world, fights against the "Calamities" that spread all over the world. This game's core is the orthodox action fighting mode!

1659040.name: HITMAN World of Assassination
1659040.short_description: Enter the world of the ultimate assassin. HITMAN World of Assassination delivers the definitive stealth action experience, putting you in the shoes of Agent 47, a master assassin. Explore immersive locations, uncover hidden secrets, and eliminate targets with complete freedom of approach.

1659150.name: SUPER 56
1659150.short_description: SUPER 56 challenges players to overcome 56 genre-bending mini-games with the press of a single button. Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores. Outlandish chaos awaits you in Hell!

1659210.name: Uninvited Guest
1659210.short_description: Uninvited Guest is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1930. You play as a villager who was destined to end up in an old mansion.

1664200.name: Duelists of Eden
1664200.short_description: Build a deck and battle online in real-time action with rollback netcode!

1664220.name: TRAIL OUT
1664220.short_description: Welcome to the festival of explosive races, TRAIL OUT! Reckless racing around the world! Crashes, explosions, destruction, and screaming drivers!

1664670.name: 重构
1664670.short_description: Refactor is a hard-core tower defense game that combines modular building, route planning, and element composition.

1665130.name: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+
1665130.short_description: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+ includes 14 titles from the legendary PAC-MAN series! Play a variety of classic and nostalgic PAC-MAN games across many genres!

1665190.name: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip
1665190.short_description: Embark on a road trip like no other in this co-op narrative survival adventure. Visit fun locations, meet wacky characters, and manage your resources wisely. And yes: you still can date some hot monsters ;)

1665260.name: Beyond Sunset
1665260.short_description: Cyberpunk first-person shooter with a rich story and RPG elements. You are Lucy, an enhanced street samurai searching for lost memories. Fight in large, open, interactive levels overtaken by yakuza, zombies, robots and bosses!

1665280.name: Skábma™ - Snowfall
1665280.short_description: The rhythm of nature is in danger! You are Áilu, a young Sámi whose ordinary reindeer herding day turns into an adventure. Learn the old ways of the Noaidis, Sámi Healers. Harness the powers of the Noaidi Drum and the Familiar Spirits to fight against a disorder spreading across the land!

1669000.name: Age of Wonders 4
1669000.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm of your own design! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn!

1669170.name: Northend Tower Defense
1669170.short_description: Jump into a realtime strategy, action filled battlefield, deploy relentless soldiers, unlock powerful troops and vehicles, upgrade your army, decimate the enemy. If that's not enough, jump into a chaotic Zombie mode, with traps, fun upgrades, and a new gameplay!

1669360.name: Socialism Simulator
1669360.short_description: The civil war is over. To the rapturous cheers of the crowd, you and four of your companions take control of the country. The young socialist state proudly raises its flags, its eyes fixed on a distant, bright future.

1669420.name: Islets
1669420.short_description: Take to the sky and reunite a fragmented world in this surprisingly wholesome metroidvania! Help Iko adventure across beautiful hand-painted islands, receive letters from a quirky cast of characters, and face powerful monstrous adversaries.

1669980.name: Volcano Princess
1669980.short_description: Prepare the next monarch by finding her hobbies, training her for battle, and befriending the citizens she'll one day protect. Dive into an all-new parenting-simulator-RPG adventure, where every decision you make will not only affect the future of your daughter but that of an entire empire!

1675620.name: Last Light
1675620.short_description: En route to a scare game, Lumi realizes that she is suddenly alone. Then, appears the old abandoned hospital... Explore throughout the tragedy-stricken hospital. Search for the student IDs of Lumi's classmates. And find out what really happened. Maybe all you need is the courage to "flee?"

1680880.name: Forspoken
1680880.short_description: Forspoken follows the journey of Frey, a young New Yorker transported to the beautiful and cruel land of Athia. In search of a way home, Frey must use her newfound magical abilities to traverse sprawling landscapes and battle monstrous creatures.

1681060.name: Exogate Initiative
1681060.short_description: Build and manage mankind’s first mission across the universe! Create a sprawling facility underground, recruit a diverse group of specialists from around the globe and explore mysterious new worlds through the Exogate.

1685460.name: A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism
1685460.short_description: In the world of A-Train, people gather around stations, gradually developing the surrounding town. What kind of railroad will you create? How will you develop the town? All these choices and more are yours to make.

1685730.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow
1685730.short_description: Emotional, 3rd-person, story-driven, adventure game focused on solving puzzles and using stealth mechanics. Use your bow to interact with environmental elements. Sneak, climb or distract guards to move further unnoticed. Solve light puzzles alongside your path to rescue your loved one.

1685750.name: Capcom Fighting Collection
1685750.short_description: Ten of Capcom's most popular arcade games in one bumper collection! A wide variety of titles are included from series such as Street Fighter and Darkstalkers, Cyberbots, and the first home console port of Red Earth! And of course, all titles support online play!

1691190.name: Rogue Waters
1691190.short_description: Rogue Waters is a Pirate Tactical Turn-Based Rogue-lite. Play as Captain Cutter, commanding your ship and crew through procedurally generated encounters to seek revenge. Recruit, train, and upgrade crew, use powerful sea creatures, and engage in dynamic naval and melee combat to gain the upper hand.

1691320.name: Hellbreach: Vegas
1691320.short_description: Hellbreach: Vegas is a Wave-based First-Person Shooter for 1-4 players, made with passion by a one man dev team! Set your loadout, kill, and earn cash. Take a spin on the various slot machines and level up to improve your survival chances. Are you ready to try your luck?

1691420.name: START AGAIN: a prologue
1691420.short_description: timeloop depression station ✦ In Stars and Time's prototype-thingy-thing

1691970.name: Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp
1691970.short_description: With an all-star dream lineup of characters from each Danganronpa game, gather Hope Fragments at a tropical resort. Explore Jabberwock Island and develop your Dangan characters. Gather money through battle and upgrade your equipment, then defeat bosses and move on to the next island!

1695670.name: ScrewUp
1695670.short_description: Screwup 1.0 The update includes new features such as a new combat system, official server system, exploring new islands by ship, NPC trading, and rare item trading. There are also new hunting and pet systems, as well as many other features that will be added in future updates.

1695840.name: Fear Therapy
1695840.short_description: Fear Therapy, is a multiplayer(1-4) and single player psychological horror game.Try to complete the quests and leave the horror house before it is too late! Satan getting angrier every second and nothing holding it back.

1699860.name: Parkour Tag
1699860.short_description: Parkour Tag is a platforming PvP game that faces two-players off in a competitive game of movement. Run vertically or horizontally on any wall, jump, double jump, slide, vault and more to outmaneuver your opponent and claim victory!

1704060.name: Vtuber模擬器
1704060.short_description: Customize your own character, streaming, training, and become a famous Vtuber!

1704080.name: Bean Stalker
1704080.short_description: Bean Stalker is a climbing action-adventure game. As a Stalker, you need to craft, loot and fight endless hordes of enemies to finally defeat the greatest one: the spirit of the tree. All of this in a procedurally generated environment with a touch of steampunk style.

1712350.name: Riven
1712350.short_description: Uncover a story of intrigue, betrayal, and a civilization teetering on the brink of collapse as you solve intricate puzzles to unlock the secrets of Riven. Built from the ground-up and expanded from the award-winning original game released in 1997.

1712840.name: Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-shot Adventure
1712840.short_description: Smash skeletons, defeat dragons, and battle giant golems in Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep: A Wonderlands One-Shot Adventure. Experience the acclaimed 2013 quest that started it all in this standalone campaign jam-packed with fantasy, fun, and mountains of magical loot!

1713190.name: Neko Candy Shop
1713190.short_description: Relaxing puzzle game with adorable neko girls.

1713350.name: Project Castaway
1713350.short_description: Project Castaway is a survival crafting title set in the Pacific Ocean. Live the life of a stranded castaway, with only yourself - and the island's inhabitants - for company! Sail the ocean, hunt, explore unique islands and gather resources as you fight for survival.

1725340.name: Elypse
1725340.short_description: Embark upon a tragic tale and discover the ravaged world of Elypse! Fight your destiny in an arduous 2D adventure, story rich platformer, in a mesmerising and mysterious world.

1725440.name: House of Rules
1725440.short_description: Congratulations! You're hired as a new waterer in Black Kiwa. Water the plants, and we'll pay you 30 G per hour. You'll never find any other job this generous. No, we're not hiding anything from you. If you just follow the work protocols and stay out of trouble, everything will be fine.

1725640.name: Sudocats
1725640.short_description: Sudoku for cat people. Cats are wonderful creatures but you better not put them together without proper introduction. So, plan ahead to display them in the right order so they get along!

1726120.name: Cursed to Golf
1726120.short_description: Cursed to Golf is a challenging golf-like adventure where every shot counts. Players are tasked with making it out of Golf Purgatory to become a Golfing Legend. With insane hazards, otherworldly power-ups and tons of replayability, will you make it back alive or will you forever be… Cursed to Golf!?

1726130.name: Pathless Woods
1726130.short_description: Embark on a cozy open-world survival journey inspired by ancient China's heritage. Gather resources, cultivate crops, build your dream home, and defend it from marauders. Team up with friends to explore and uncover a world where adventure meets serenity.

1726190.name: No Straight Roads: Encore Edition
1726190.short_description: Start a rock band & end the EDM empire in NO STRAIGHT ROADS, a rockin' action-adventure that mashes together rhythm-infused third-person combat with a kick-ass soundtrack!

1737100.name: Treasure of Nadia
1737100.short_description: Meet gorgeous women! Find long lost treasure, explore the ancient mysteries that surround the island and build your own harem in Treasure of Nadia!

1737340.name: 通神榜 Noobs Want to Live
1737340.short_description: Noobs Want to Live is a fast-paced roguelike featuring several characters and a large pool of skills to choose from (that synergize with one another, too!) Fight, kill, grow. Each run is a new chance to create a steamrolling build!

1737690.name: Yacht Dice
1737690.short_description: Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.

1737870.name: REKA
1737870.short_description: Channel your inner witch! Build your cozy chicken-legged hut, practice witchcraft, and forage for ingredients in autumnal woodlands. Solve quests & uncover the great mysteries of the legendary witch Baba Jaga…

1748610.name: Evil God Korone
1748610.short_description: An unexpected collaboration from Tsugunohi, the game where horror invades daily life, and VTuber Inugami Korone, from VTuber group hololive. Inugami Korone, who has been live streaming many horror game, has become an evil goddess and taken over Tsugunohi. Now, chop your finger and give it to her.

1748620.name: FlipWitch - Forbidden Sex Hex
1748620.short_description: Use your newly-acquired genderbending abilities as a 'FlipWitch' to conquer evil monsters, giant bosses, and Monster Girls across the land! You'll have to use your wits in this quirky adventure to seduce everyone around you!

1748660.name: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
1748660.short_description: The second game in the unique Voice of Cards series, where all elements are presented entirely through the medium of cards, in the tradition of tabletop RPGs and gamebooks.

1748750.name: Crystarise
1748750.short_description: Explore a vast world, create your own sky island, the island gives the girl the power. An open world-action RPG that you create more and more and become stronger and stronger.

1749350.name: Gobby McGobblenutz Presents: The Art of the Dad Joke: Chapter 1
1749350.short_description: Gobby McGobblenutz is just your run of the mill Goblin trying to make some friends in a dark, lonely world... Will you be his friend? Or will his cringe-inducing jokes push you too far over the edge? Come find out on The Art of the Dad Joke!

1749750.name: Disgaea 6 Complete
1749750.short_description: Join Zed on his quest to destroy the God of Destruction in the newest installment of the SRPG series, Disgaea! Join the zany cast for one HL of an adventure and use specialized abilities like Super Reincarnation to battle your way to victory! Disgaea 6 Complete includes all previously released DLC!

1750110.name: Frenzy VR
1750110.short_description: A destruction and mayhem sandbox playground. Become immersed in the deep story that unfolds before you, with plenty of lore and secrets to uncover along the way. Play around with ragdoll enemies (including unique bosses) and cause chaos wherever you go.

1750200.name: Sex and the Furry Titty 2: Sins of the City
1750200.short_description: Sex and the Furry Titty 2 offers you even sexier stories, more ladies, and more ways to get dirty with them! Experience 6 new stories with an elaborate web of branching paths. Explore each one, win match-3 challenges, and get ready for hot animated VOICED sex scenes!

1750570.name: Subway Midnight
1750570.short_description: Board the train! Run away from a weirdo! Solve some puzzles! Make friends with some ghosts! Try not to become a ghost yourself!

1750710.name: Boxville
1750710.short_description: Boxville is an adventure puzzle game about speechless cans living in the city of boxes and drawing doodles on cardboards to tell the stories. Made in Ukraine.

1750770.name: Starcom: Unknown Space
1750770.short_description: Starcom: Unknown Space is an action RPG of space exploration and adventure. Build your own starship while discovering an epic story in a universe of strange mysteries, alien factions and uncharted worlds.

1761380.name: Otherworld Legends
1761380.short_description: A "blood-pumping, face-bashing" roguelike brawler. Master heroes of your choice, craft uniquely broken builds, and hack & pummel through a myriad of dungeons in a thrilling rampage.

1761390.name: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix+
1761390.short_description: Take center stage in Hatsune Miku’s premier rhythm game starring the world’s #1 virtual pop star! With a stunner setlist and enormous wardrobe to style, it’s Miku’s ultimate tour—all it needs is you.

1761620.name: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale
1761620.short_description: Headbangers is a light-hearted, Rhythm Battle Royale Game where you and 29 other Pigeons compete against each other, all to complete your quest of claiming the title of Master Headbanger!

1761630.name: What's Your Gender?
1761630.short_description: An antichamber inspired educational puzzle game, that allows you to simultaneously explore a non-euclidean maze and concepts and terms related to gender, identity and expression in a playful and reassuring manner.

1761780.name: Creepy Tale 3: Ingrid Penance
1761780.short_description: As punishment for her transgressions, Ingrid is sent to hell. As she struggles through the darkness that hungers to consume her heart, she makes her way toward redemption. Her fate is in your hands.

1761900.name: EXOME
1761900.short_description: EXOME is a co-op survival shooter with a focus on exploration, weapon progression and horde AI. Discover what grim mysteries are hidden in this deep forest. Explore and fight for survival, alone or with your friends.

1762010.name: Wrought Flesh
1762010.short_description: Rip out organs and equip them in your own body. Fight biopunk monsters and drugged-up space bandits. You are a Gajeshian Cultist: A near-mythological being built from the bodies of long-dead saints.

1762270.name: Obama Boss Fight
1762270.short_description: In the world where all answers were told the great enemies confronted each other. The time has come. Time to defeat Obama once and for all. Will the world be free from racism or you will start a new era? It is up to you. But keep in mind... Obama has no chill.

1762550.name: PixelOver
1762550.short_description: PixelOver is a software to transform your arts to pixel arts as best as possible, animate in realtime with pixel perfect transformations, bones and key animation system.

1762570.name: Space Reign
1762570.short_description: An indie space-sim and strategy game featuring ship and fleet combat mixed with RTS elements. Complete contracts and Claim sectors for your faction in the near-future, where resource exploiting corporations are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

1762930.name: Goat Simulator: Remastered
1762930.short_description: Goat Simulator Remastered is the latest in goat simulation technology. Your favorite chaotic sandbox is back and more beautiful than ever, with updated graphics, every DLC, and more bugs that you can shake a goat at. WASD to rewrite history.

1763030.name: Master Key
1763030.short_description: Master Key is a top-down adventure game with a strong focus on item-based exploration and secrets. Embark on a journey to discover what that key could be used for and meet colorful characters!

1763050.name: Fears to Fathom - Episode 2
1763050.short_description: Holly Gardner, a 19 year old on an interstate drive experiences unusual happenings that leads to an unplanned stay at a motel, little did she know what was transpiring down in Norwood Valley.

1763250.name: SWORN
1763250.short_description: SWORN is a 1-4 player co-op action rogue-like. Explore and reclaim a fallen Camelot from the reign of a corrupted Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table.

1763830.name: My Truck Game
1763830.short_description: Physics based, off road truck and bus simulation.

1774580.name: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™
1774580.short_description: The story of Cal Kestis continues in STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™, a galaxy-spanning, third-person, action-adventure game.

1775270.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes - Friend's Pass
1775270.short_description: Don’t play alone – invite a friend and share your House of Ashes experience. The Friends Pass works on a single save game and allows you and a friend one full playthrough of House of Ashes.

1775360.name: Witch and Council : The Card
1775360.short_description: Fight against the Student Council President with ≪Lulu≫! ≪Witch and the Council: The Card≫ is a roguelite deck-building game where you assemble a party with charming characters, build a powerful deck, and defeat your enemies. Experience the thrill of overcoming powerful foes with various strategies!

1775490.name: Slice & Dice
1775490.short_description: Tactical dice-rolling roguelike combat. Take control of 5 heroes, each with their own unique dice. Fight your way through 20 levels of monsters and try to take on the final boss. If you lose a single fight you have to start over so be careful (and lucky!).

1775530.name: Artemis
1775530.short_description: Artemis is a visual novel intended for the adult audience. You begin your road to recovery three years following a traumatic event, where you'll eventually find yourself shaping the technological future.

1775550.name: Gary Grigsby's War in the East 2
1775550.short_description: War in the East 2 is the most comprehensive, most realistic, and most advanced wargame modeling Eastern Front warfare in World War Two.

1785000.name: Mokoko X
1785000.short_description: Nostalgic arcade gameplay remastered! Conquer the bigger portion of the screen and save the unlucky girls from the various absurd troublemakers.

1785120.name: Forsake
1785120.short_description: Forsake is a 1 to 4 player co-op online survival horror game where each player is a member of an urban explorer group. Choose your equipment to explore places full of paranormal and exorcise them, if you think you can handle it!

1785150.name: Friends vs Friends
1785150.short_description: A frantic, online PvP shooter that combines combat and deck building. Choose a character, customize your card-based loadout, and get ready for the fights of your life!

1785300.name: Saint Maker
1785300.short_description: A haunted convent. Statues that move on their own. A buried past. Welcome to Saint Idelora’s convent, where becoming a saint comes with a price.

1785440.name: Russian Train Trip
1785440.short_description: Traveling on passenger trains in Russia. First-person exploration.

1785650.name: TopSpin 2K25
1785650.short_description: TopSpin 2K25 returns as a next-level tennis sim, bringing realistic court physics and challenging skill-based gameplay. Play single or multiplayer locally or online. Build your MyPLAYER or play as icons like Roger Federer and Serena Williams with custom animations mirroring their real-life styles.

1785910.name: SBK™22
1785910.short_description: Saddle up your Superbike and show what you’re made of while racing in the official 2022 WorldSBK™. After ten years, SBK™ returns with a title more immersive and engaging than ever!

1785940.name: COVEN
1785940.short_description: COVEN is a hyper-violent retro FPS where your path of vengeance will take you across time and space. Destroy your enemies and eat their flesh.

1786010.name: AETHERIS
1786010.short_description: Aetheris is a tactical RPG with challenging turn-based battles set in an immersive and vibrant environment. Make the right choices and find the best strategy to survive in the unforgiving Wilderness. Journey alone or as a party of four—the adventure awaits!

1786200.name: Wars and Roses
1786200.short_description: One-of-a-kind intense tactical FPS where you fight battles alongside female officers and interact with those beauties in a 3D dating sim. Rescue captured officers, gain affection by dating in various scenarios to unlock unique interactions, and fight side-by-side on an anti-terrorism campaign.

1786670.name: 仙绣剑缘录
1786670.short_description: 高自由度仙侠开放世界

1786790.name: Magical Girl Celesphonia
1786790.short_description: Amane has always lived for herself, choosing to focus on her studies and happiness. But what will she do when given magical powers beyond human comprehension to face a horde of terrible monsters? It's time for her to become Magical Girl Celesphonia!

1787090.name: MyDockFinder
1787090.short_description: MyDockFinder is a software for quick system startup and control viewing system functions. You can drag and drop to add your favorite programs or files, and drag and drop to directly use the program to open the file. Based on WinUI using GPU rendering, smooth animation effects.

1787480.name: Metro Simulator 2
1787480.short_description: Metro Simulator 2 is a unique game featuring recreated Moscow Metro and realistic train controls.

1814490.name: Scratch Girl
1814490.short_description: Control the spaceship to find the beauty! Start a journey of conversation with the beauty!

1814710.name: Cute Dogs
1814710.short_description: Is it possible to buy some happiness with money? Who knows, but you can buy yourself a dog! Look, how cute they are! Play with our fluffy little fellas, a «find-differences» game. These cute little puppies can help you relax and find some peace of mind.

1814770.name: Tall Poppy
1814770.short_description: Tall Poppy is a fun-house horror experience where you must find your wife's purse and a way off the church property before the prankster ghost gets you!

1815010.name: Maid Knight Alicia
1815010.short_description: Alicia is a female knight who has won many battles with her armor and sword. One day, a sorcerer she once let escape casts an curse of armor disablement on her. Now, only she can equip is a maid's uniform...

1815230.name: Summum Aeterna
1815230.short_description: Summum Aeterna is a fast-paced Roguelite inspired by the Metroidvania Aeterna Noctis. Create your own worlds, challenges, difficulty and influences in each new run. Die, learn, become stronger, and achieve victory. Death is inevitable, but glory is only for the chosen.

1815440.name: Chinese Driving Test Simulator
1815440.short_description: Are you ready to take on the challenge of the Chinese driving test? For which it will test your skill of driving, knowledge of vehicle and traffic rules. The Chinese Driving Test Simulator will show you a complete, realistic Chinese driving test experience.

1815530.name: Dungeon Defenders: Going Rogue
1815530.short_description: Combining Roguelite, Action RPG, and Tower Defense gameplay into a crazy free-for-all, where it’s you and up to three friends versus hordes of enemies. Select your hero, survive the waves of foes, unlock new weapons and runes, and take on the bosses that await you!

1815570.name: Aces and Adventures
1815570.short_description: Aces & Adventures is a deckbuilding RPG with poker-powered combat. Craft your deck, combining poker hands with powerful ability cards. Journey through 13 fully-voiced campaigns to save the Life Tree, or tackle procedurally-generated runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.

1826570.name: First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds
1826570.short_description: "First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds" is a co-operative atmospheric escape-room-style puzzle game, set in a beautiful luxury airship. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the challenges that await you on the airship?

1826860.name: Sewer Rave
1826860.short_description: Exactly what it says on the tin. Sewer Rave is a game about exploring a rat infested Rave in a Sewer. There are creatures to talk to, items to collect, fights to get into, and jams to listen to. Explore, discover secrets, and writhe.

1826910.name: Please Subscribe
1826910.short_description: Please Subscribe is the sequel to Gamer Career Tycoon from 2018. Develop your own livestream channel from the ground up. Manage and operate, overcome challenges, learn new tricks in order to rise in the charts, and possibly, become the next big internet superstar.

1838290.name: LOUD
1838290.short_description: A wholesome, music-filled arcade rhythm game in which a young, reclusive rocker goes on a journey of self-discovery. Once she begins to follow her dreams and finds her inner voice, she discovers that it is LOUD!

1838970.name: Crush the Castle Legacy Collection
1838970.short_description: Crush the Castle Legacy Collection is the triumphant return of the classic Armor Games physics destruction game! Let destruction reign by loading up your trusty trebuchet and showing the enemy castle who’s boss.

1839510.name: ＲＰＧタイム！～ライトの伝説～
1839510.short_description: It's time for an adventure! Once classes are over, RPG Time begins! Game master Kenta's notebook holds a handwritten RPG made just for you.
developers: 株式会社デスクワークス

1839820.name: Never Mourn
1839820.short_description: Explore the world of Never Mourn in this rogue-lite action adventure. Death is never the end, merely the beginning of your next adventure. Use ancient necromantic magics to raise an army of undead daemons and do battle to close the rifts of Never Mourn.

1839880.name: King Of The Castle
1839880.short_description: Take your rightful place on the throne in this political party game for 4+ players. Rule the kingdom with an iron fist or silver tongue as you steer through bloodshed, intrigue & madcap disaster! Can you keep your crown when others plot your downfall? More importantly, can you keep your head?

1839930.name: Lifecraft
1839930.short_description: Survive and evolve as an organism with this simulation game in which you will literally start as a single cell and manage and organize all its functions to a fully fledged system! Assemble, breathe, eat, fight threats, produce energy, grow, anything is possible!

1839940.name: Dakar Desert Rally
1839940.short_description: Dakar Desert Rally is the biggest off-road rally racing adventure ever developed. Experience the speed and excitement of the largest rally race on the planet, featuring a wide variety of licensed vehicles from motorcycles, cars, trucks, quads and SSVs.

2009350.name: Out of Ore
2009350.short_description: A casual heavy equipment experience. Mine ore, Move dirt, Build and repair.

2012190.name: Kaiserpunk
2012190.short_description: Build a city to rule the world in Kaiserpunk, a grand city builder blending production-focused city building with the world conquest of strategy games in an alternate 20th century world. Manage your city, grow industries, build a military, and defeat rivals to become the greatest empire.

2015240.name: Dwarven Realms
2015240.short_description: Face massive hordes of mobs and unleash chaotic abilities that paint the screen with mayhem. Dive into the largest mob density of any 3D ARPG and slay them all. Wield epic powers, create your build, and shape a world of endless possibilities in the action-packed ARPG experience.

2015270.name: Rotwood
2015270.short_description: The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the Rotwood. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

2019300.name: Dokimon
2019300.short_description: "Whoa, watch out!" That was close, didn't you know Dokimon are dangerous!?ーStep into Xelos region, where you'll set off on an adventure to uncover the mystery behind your missing childhood friend.

2020710.name: Havendock
2020710.short_description: Breathe easy and thrive in this cozy colony sim. Build a haven for castaways, manage resources, live your best life on the ocean. Lead your humble settlement into a high-tech society.

2025310.name: Sigh of the Abyss
2025310.short_description: Embrace the monster within in this dark fantasy visual novel with inclusive romances. Befriend charming allies, defy bitter rivals, fall in love. Your choices will save or condemn mortals, shaping the fate of a city as beautiful as it is cruel.

2026000.name: Our Adventurer Guild
2026000.short_description: Become the new Guild Master of the Adventurer Guild and lead your adventurers in explorations and turnbased tactical battles. Will the Guild thrive under your leadership? Or will it finally disband under it?

2026370.name: 体育館の天井に挟まったマッチョを助けるゲーム
2026370.short_description: This is a new type of shooting game in which the player rescues muscular trapped in the ceiling of a gymnasium by hitting them with a ball.

2026820.name: Die in the Dungeon
2026820.short_description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

2026870.name: Night At the Gates of Hell
2026870.short_description: From the sick mind behind Bloodwash, Jordan King, comes his latest experiment in terror. Inspired by the Italian zombie flicks from Lucio Fulci and Bruno Mattei, Night of the Gates of Hell promises to be a blood dripping, neon soaked, flesh rotting experience.

2026880.name: Deadly Night
2026880.short_description: Carol is down on her luck, hitchhiking across the country. She arrives at a small roadside motel but there's something strange about the owner. As the secrets unravel, she finds herself entangled in a long, DEADLY NIGHT! Can she escape from hellish nightmare or will she die trying?

2053940.name: Idol Hands 2
2053940.short_description: Experience two different stories with two different heroines in this love-filled idol management game! Complete with Live 2D-animated H-Scenes!

2054690.name: Captain Firehawk and the Laser Love Situation
2054690.short_description: A Shoot 'Em Up of macro proportions! When giant anime women invade the galaxy, only a team is able to stand against them and put things right: a pizza guy with a pilot's license, a lovely engineer and a tiny robot flying on a garbage truck spaceship!

2054740.name: Cozy Time
2054740.short_description: Cozy Time provides you with a cozy environment to focus, relax or rest without being disturbed.

2054970.name: Dragon's Dogma 2
2054970.short_description: Dragon’s Dogma 2 is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges the players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more - in a truly immersive fantasy world.

2055050.name: 铁骑少女（Cavalry Girls）
2055050.short_description: In this refreshing and exciting shooting game, lead the brave and fearless girl soldiers to fight with the enemy. Refit different types of machine armour, reasonably deploy machine soldiers with different skills, repel all kinds of enemies, and protect the Empire behind you in the gunfire.

2060480.name: PomoFarm
2060480.short_description: PomoFarm is half focus timer and half idle farming game! As Tomato the Duck, grow your farm as you focus on tasks in the real world!

2060590.name: Wilmot Works It Out
2060590.short_description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

2060750.name: Star Survivor
2060750.short_description: Star Survivor is a space-themed survival game that blends intense deckbuilding strategy. Pilot humanity's last spaceship through the vast galaxy, Unlock powerful weapon combos, collect card modules, and craft unique builds. As the enemy swarms grow denser, will you be the last one standing?

2060790.name: Hauntii
2060790.short_description: An action adventure about a ghost’s journey through the afterlife. Possess enemies and the environment and fend off hostile spirits in pursuit of starry fragments from a past life.

2060870.name: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve
2060870.short_description: Become Atom Eve and take control of your own path as one of the most powerful superheroes in the Invincible universe! Unravel a mystery and balance the dangers and responsibilities of being a superhero with the relatable challenges of everyday life.

2061150.name: Ikki Unite
2061150.short_description: SUNSOFT relapses... The legendary Bad Game Hall of Famer "Ikki" is back, and this time it's a multiplayer experience! You can't start a riot with just one or two people! Enlist up to 16 friends in this Roguelite madness... Ikki but united!

2061230.name: Chasm: The Rift
2061230.short_description: Prepare for terror in this ground-breaking classic old-school FPS. Following the destruction of Time you are left to battle in this horrific hellhole of multilevel interconnected missions populated by gruesome grotesque creatures.

2061250.name: クレヨンしんちゃん「オラと博士の夏休み」～おわらない七日間の旅～

2061430.name: Oxygen
2061430.short_description: Oxygen is a survival city builder. Build your city around the Oxygen Center and ensure your people's survival in a post-apocalyptic future, threatened by crack explosions, deadly winds, droughts and frosts. Lead your people and more importantly keep the Oxygen Center running!

2070850.name: Sakura Hime 4
2070850.short_description: Adorable nekomimi, enchanting sorceresses, and stunning girls from a different realm have enveloped you. Aim to be the most devoted caretaker and have a wonderful vacation with them!

2071200.name: 隐秘的角落
2071200.short_description: As an adaptation of the popular suspecse TV series, Cat's Cradle, this game combines investigation, solving puzzles and reasoning with original stories, which can build a more Immersive experience. Game will build new stories based on original setting and focus on the inner world of the character.

2071280.name: Ravenswatch
2071280.short_description: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods©, playable solo or in online co-op.

2071430.name: Roots of Yggdrasil
2071430.short_description: Build settlements, explore the Nine Realms, collect artifacts and upgrade your deck to reach the top of Yggdrasil in this post-Ragnarok roguelike city-builder! Can you survive the end of the world?

2071500.name: Islands of Insight
2071500.short_description: Seek out and solve 10,000+ puzzles at your own pace across this sublime puzzle game.

2071520.name: My Pleasure - Season 1
2071520.short_description: My Pleasure is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel, full of hot women, mystery, and sex! This VN is packed with high-quality graphics, a rich story, humor, and hot close-up animations!

2083210.name: Super Woden GP 2
2083210.short_description: Super Woden GP 2 is a love letter to the world of motor sports, offering a unique experience. Arcade-style isometric racing meets unrivaled campaign depth and a huge variety of vehicles to buy, sell and unlock.

2083840.name: Her Name Was Fire
2083840.short_description: Her Name Was Fire is a Tarotpunk twin stick roguelike where you progressively unlock spells and upgrades to defeat hordes of void creatures. Survive the 5 stages of grief and vanquish the Major Allegories.

2083900.name: FLERP
2083900.short_description: Fend off hordes of enemies in this arcade tower defense roguelite with autobattler elements. Build up a team of powerful synergies and become unstoppable.

2084000.name: Shogun Showdown
2084000.short_description: Shogun Showdown is a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. Position yourself and attack at the right time, upgrade your tiles and combo them to get ready to face the Shogun!

2084010.name: CosmoOdyssey:Trip to Mars
2084010.short_description: CosmoOdyssey: Trip to Mars is a first-person spaceship adventure with a special Ukrainian flavor.

2084450.name: DIRECT CONTACT
2084450.short_description: Direct Contact delivers an authentic and immersive first-person, Co-Op tactical experience, built for those who demand realism, strategy, and precision. Operate as Special Forces, utilizing a vast arsenal of real-world weapons and equipment. Engage in dynamic combat.

2084720.name: Home Run High
2084720.short_description: Train your baseball players and create a winning team!

2084930.name: Ever Seen A Cat? 3
2084930.short_description: A relaxing hidden object game. Find yet more cats in several new fairy tale themed environments! Every play through is different!

2085000.name: SaGa Emerald Beyond
2085000.short_description: FORGE YOUR OWN TALE The latest standalone entry in the SaGa franchise, SaGa Emerald Beyond, brings together the very best elements of the beloved series to offer each player their own unique gameplay experience.

2085040.name: ToriDori
2085040.short_description: ToriDori is a world at the intersection of time. Take on the role of a mystical ship captain and set out to search for differences and temporal paradoxes. A relaxing adventure suitable for all ages awaits you. Pet the cat and set sail!

2096030.name: Snow Plowing Simulator
2096030.short_description: Experience the serene joy of snow plowing in this relaxing simulation game! Drive powerful plows, clear roads, and keep your town safe. Uncover a surprising story, face survival challenges, and tackle advanced weather systems. Embrace winter's chill and become the ultimate snow-clearing hero!

2096080.name: Agent in Depth
2096080.short_description: Agent in Depth is a daring action-platformer featuring fast-paced action and instant-death combat. You’ll run, jump, aim, and deflect bullets with your katana to blow up your enemies. No checkpoints, no upgrades: just pure skills. Deflect, die, learn, repeat. Be better, be faster.

2096510.name: The Ouroboros King
2096510.short_description: The Ouroboros King combines the strategic depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Assemble a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the Coven.

2096570.name: A Fisherman's Tale 2
2096570.short_description: A Fisherman's Tale 2, sequel to the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, is a new mind-bending VR puzzle-adventure. A poetic story with unique VR puzzle mechanics. Detach, Replace and Control your hands, solve puzzles, explore new locations and discover the truth.

2096600.name: Crysis 2 Remastered
2096600.short_description: Relive the legendary single-player campaign from the classic first-person shooter, Crysis 2, optimized for today's hardware in Crysis 2 Remastered.

2096610.name: Crysis 3 Remastered
2096610.short_description: Experience the single-player experience from the iconic first-person shooter, Crysis 3, optimized to take advantage of today's hardware in Crysis 3 Remastered.

2097030.name: Union of Gnomes
2097030.short_description: Onwards to revolution in this challenging deck-building roguelite. Free your gnome comrades, assemble your squad, mind wieners (supplies), slay the slavers, and take down the fiercest of them all – Snow White! FREEDOM TO GNOMES!

2097180.name: OxU
2097180.short_description: Minimalistic 3d puzzle with portals, cubes and lasers.

2097230.name: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
2097230.short_description: Turnip Boy is back! This time he’s teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time. Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, battle the fuzz, and use wacky tools bought off the dark web to move further into the vaults of the Botanical Bank.

2108180.name: SWORDHAVEN
2108180.short_description: Swordhaven is a classic party-based RPG. Explore the land of Nova Drakonia, embark on quests unique to your character, discover mysterious artefacts of the ancients, and unravel a hidden conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the world.

2108290.name: 精靈之妊 -用懷孕征服所有傲慢的精靈-
2108290.short_description: "These arrogant Elves are capturing us Orcs as semen cows because they want to get pregnant?! Looks like I have to use the sword on my crotch to teach them a lesson, show these Elves the terror of Orcs!"

2108330.name: F1® 23
2108330.short_description: Be the last to brake in EA SPORTS™ F1® 23, the official video game of the 2023 FIA Formula One World Championship™. A new chapter in the thrilling "Braking Point" story mode delivers high-speed drama and heated rivalries.

2108600.name: Potato Survival
2108600.short_description: Potato Survival is a short story game about a character who lives alone on the open sea. Collect potatoes and try to survive for 21 days with the knowledge you gain daily. Unlock new skills to create a more meaningful day to day life!

2108950.name: Mice Tea
2108950.short_description: Mice Tea is a visual novel full of transformation, sex, and steamy, hot beverages. Take the role of twentysomething bookstore clerk Margaret de Campos as she finds a box of magical tea with transformative powers that turns the lives of her and her friends into an unforgettable, erotic adventure.

2109060.name: Magenta Horizon - Neverending Harvest
2109060.short_description: Magenta Horizon is a fast-paced 2D action platformer with challenging spectacle fighter inspired combat. Playing as a Reaper of the twisted purgatorial afterlife, push your skills to the limit to destroy the hordes of demons and epic bosses to reach your destination.

2109270.name: Preserve
2109270.short_description: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

2109370.name: The Great War: Western Front™
2109370.short_description: The Great War: Western Front is the definitive WW1 strategy game. Play a deciding role in history with this real-time tactical experience as you take charge in the iconic Western Front from 1914 to 1919. Pick your faction and lead your forces to victory.

2109430.name: Tron: Identity
2109430.short_description: Something has been taken. Enter a new Grid and forge alliances via visual novel gameplay, uncovering truths through Identity Disc puzzles. Make critical decisions and plot your own course in a world without a creator.

2109460.name: 乡村狂想曲
2109460.short_description: Farming, logging, fishing, farm role-playing games to help widows and wives improve their lives

2120070.name: Pro Philosopher 2
2120070.short_description: The "Debating Sim" returns! Engage famous philosophers of all stripes, challenge their ideas, and change the world— or just tell everyone they smell terrible. NONSENSE!

2120250.name: War Tortoise
2120250.short_description: War Tortoise is a new type of hybrid idle game, taking core incremental gameplay and adding new features, idle elements, and advanced graphics. Explore, command and upgrade, equip weapons and armor, level up, unlock abilities, recruit heroes and pilots, and more!

2120310.name: Sagres
2120310.short_description: Set sail for adventure in the Age of Discovery! Explore the seven seas as the fresh-faced ship captain Fernando. Customise your ship, battle against pirates and sea monsters, and assemble your crew to delve into the mysterious disappearance of the legendary explorer, Sir Antonio.

2120320.name: Wayhaven Chronicles: Book Three
2120320.short_description: Your decisions will shape who is friend or foe, who will share in your secrets, and just how your romance with a certain vampire will grow!

2120900.name: Fears to Fathom - Episode 3
2120900.short_description: Noah Baker, an 18 year old highschooler experiences unsettling occurrences while house-sitting for a media personality, little did he know what was about to unfold that night.

2121100.name: The Cabin - Summer Vacation
2121100.short_description: When your summer plans take a sharp detour, and you find yourself out in the middle of the wood, you'll soon learn this will be summer you'll never forget. Filled with adventure, love, fear and danger; your choices could be the difference between life and death out here, at The Cabin.

2121980.name: Void Stranger
2121980.short_description: Place your faith and embrace the Void.

2122070.name: Girl & Gem Magic
2122070.short_description: Gorgeous girls + Costume Break + Jewel Elimination, conquer the beauties you encounter by adequately utilizing your strategy and luck! Caution: Entering "TSS" does not make any change

2122090.name: Forgotten but Unbroken
2122090.short_description: A tactical turn-based strategy game inspired by events and stories of forgotten and unsung heroes of WW2. Unique and new-to-genre features offer immersion and deeper protagonists to lead and care for. Lead the resistance against the Axis Forces.

2134560.name: 9th Sentinel Sisters
2134560.short_description: The battle of the clone girls unfolds on a post-apocalyptic Earth, devastated by the alien life form known as "Bleed." Pilot the manned weapon "Father" to eliminate enemies. Upgrade weapons, create powerful builds, and strategize to successfully clear stages.

2139840.name: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona
2139840.short_description: Skelethrone is a challenging 2D action platformer with RPG elements inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls.

2140020.name: Stronghold: Definitive Edition
2140020.short_description: Greetings sire! Your stronghold awaits you. Build a castle economy, besiege unforgettable villains and return to the 'castle sim' that started it all. Experience this classic RTS with upgraded visuals, modernised gameplay, Steam multiplayer and a new campaign.

2140100.name: Whisker Squadron: Survivor
2140100.short_description: A smooth roguelite shooter from the creators of RACE THE SUN, featuring a voiced cast of feline pilots in a dramatic showdown against corporate-powered robots called The Swarm. Features a 3-act campaign with branching paths, epic bosses, and a wide arsenal of pilots, ships, and weapons.

2140330.name: Madden NFL 24
2140330.short_description: Experience the newest iteration of FieldSENSE™ in Madden NFL 24. More realistic character movement and smarter AI gives you control to play out your gameplay strategy with the confidence to dominate any opponent.

2140510.name: Town of Salem 2
2140510.short_description: Step into the Town of Salem, a realm of Mystery and Deceit awaits! Join us in this thrilling online strategy game. Experience paranoia, taste triumph, and confront Murder in every move!

2140570.name: Time Is Honey
2140570.short_description: Time Is Honey is a relaxing idle game where you manage bee hives. Collect unique bees by opening bee packs, take care of them in real-time and then turn it all into profit. Unlock, upgrade and customize your hives, and enjoy completing your collection of bees.

2146170.name: Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster
2146170.short_description: Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean and Baten Kaitos Origins are now on Steam with improved graphics and new features to aid game progression, making them even easier to play!

2146180.name: Cyclo Chambers
2146180.short_description: Collect synergizing items to create an overpowered character to fight hordes of cyclops monsters. Cyclo Chambers is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter with light rogue-like elements. 150 items to choose from to create frantic combinations. Different runs every time.

2151290.name: Football Coach: College Dynasty
2151290.short_description: A true college football management game. Play as a coach or a school, recruit players, develop your team, and compete for national championships. Build a college football dynasty and become a coaching legend!

2151580.name: Infinite Tao
2151580.short_description: 《Infinity Tao》is a Rogue Lite game set in the Ancient Chinese Immortal Cultivation setting. Raise your realm, build powerful Magic Treasures combinations and Synergies, kill thousands of monster and win the 30 minute game.

2156620.name: Future Radio
2156620.short_description: 2061, Japan. Mankind has lost the sky, and with it, its connections. All of it was taken away by birds... ...By countless artificial pigeons flying through the sky.

2157340.name: Meowjiro
2157340.short_description: Experience a part-time job at a convenience store, make money to buy more food for your cat. "Diz iz an honor te work fur meh~ Feed meh! Hooman! Bring meh home!"

2157560.name: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising
2157560.short_description: Rise to the challenge in Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising! This powered up, revamped sequel to GBVS is more enjoyable and accessible than ever before. With simplified input options, even newcomers can engage in thrilling and strategic matches!

2163060.name: Summer Crush
2163060.short_description: Summer Crush is a visual novel for adults where the plot develops from the decisions you make. Play as a young man who has already planned out his boring adult life, and is now waiting for summer to end. What could possibly go wrong?

2163330.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
2163330.short_description: The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

2163590.name: Hot Pussy College 🍓🔞
2163590.short_description: Hot Pussy College is a short adult Visual Novel focusing on the fun parts of college life. The game is packed with humor, romance, and lots of sex. Play as a young male attending college at B&R and guide him through the experience.

2164310.name: Escape From Lavender Island
2164310.short_description: Escape from Lavender Island is a 3rd person open world exploration game. Follow Zede Aksis as he wakes up from a dream about a city only to realize that what he saw in his sleep is a physical reality he cannot find a way out of.

2169120.name: Lords of Infinity
2169120.short_description: Lead an ancient and crumbling noble house in a rich gunpowder fantasy setting. Lie, bribe, and conspire to secure power and prestige – or to save a doomed kingdom from itself.

2169200.name: Sniper Elite: Resistance
2169200.short_description: Offering unparalleled sniping mechanics, stealth and tactical third-person combat, Sniper Elite: Resistance turns the attention of the award-winning series towards a hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

2169830.name: How a Retired Strategist Saved the Country
2169830.short_description: How a Retired Strategist Saved the Country is a real time strategy simulation game where you manage resources to develop your country. The player is asked by elves, beastmen... Etc. various heroines ask you for help, and then you take command of their country's army.

2178070.name: Towers of Aghasba
2178070.short_description: Explore a stunning open-world filled with majestic creatures and quirky characters. Nurture the barren land into vibrant ecosystems and flex your creativity as you build a thriving civilization in balance with nature. Visit other player’s worlds in an evolving online CO-OP experience.

2179630.name: OnlyFap Simulator 3 💦
2179630.short_description: Take control of sexy cam model, rake in stacks of filthy internet money and attract as many fans as you can in this fast paced, click happy and thoroughly perverted take on the business tycoon / management sim genre!

2179850.name: Cobalt Core
2179850.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder with a deep new single-axis spin on tactics games! Dodge missiles, line up your cannons, and blast 'em out of the sky... Then get to the bottom of these time loops, before it's too late!

2179860.name: Prison City
2179860.short_description: Prison City is a dystopian, action-packed side-scroller with tight mechanics and intricate level design. Battle Techno-Terrorists with your chakram and grenades, eat hot dogs for health, and locate contacts to help take down bosses.

2180000.name: Elemental Survivors
2180000.short_description: Grind, die, upgrade, repeat in this auto-attacking roguelite/RPG! Transform into an enemy-blender with your fave attacks made devastating with equipment, party members, and elemental evolutions. Survive to earn gems to unlock areas, permanent upgrades, characters, and god-like summons.

2180340.name: Mirror of Heaven
2180340.short_description: The Qi has awakened demons, they wreak havoc on our world. You traverse ancient realms with the aid of the "Kunlun Mirror," embarking on a journey of cultivation and acension to gods.

2180550.name: Dragon Princess is Hungry
2180550.short_description: Eva, the half-dragon, half-human princess. Pfel, the steward, who serves Eva. They visit a mysterious isolated island infested with monster girls, and Pfel collects food for Eva on the island. However, there is a secret hidden on the island.

2288630.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival
2288630.short_description: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival is a drum-based rhythm game featuring songs from genres such as Anime and VOCALOID™, and also a variety of game modes! Have fun playing solo or online!

2288660.name: Furry Reich 🐺
2288660.short_description: Furry Reich 🐺 is a heartwarming romance game with Anti-war love story at the front. Fall in love with your fellow officer and navigate the challenges of military life hand-in-hand. Relaxing gameplay and cute atmosphere. Everyone is worthy of love. Make love Not War

2289390.name: Crab God
2289390.short_description: Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game. Guide your Crabling colony through wild ocean depths, and defend the egg of the next Crab God.Restore and protect diverse coral reefs, making a difference in the real world as you progress in-game. Make waves, praise the claw!

2289650.name: Mini Airways
2289650.short_description: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!

2289720.name: Kaiju Princess 2
2289720.short_description: Journey across the galaxy with a cute kaiju and her ravenous appetite as you collect ingredients to cook up the ultimate feast!

2289960.name: My Neighbor's Lonely Wife
2289960.short_description: A married couple moved into the apartment next door. While the husband’s never home due to work, you start developing a crush on his wife, Niiyama Akiho. Spend time with Akiho, comfort her, and steal her affection! Once Akiho’s desire reaches its peak, she will allow you to take the next step…

2290000.name: TerraScape
2290000.short_description: Build gorgeous kingdoms on floating islands by strategically placing buildings in this cozy City-Puzzler. Discover secret combinations, take on weekly challenges and explore randomly generated maps in various single- and multiplayer game modes.

2290180.name: Riders Republic
2290180.short_description: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise.

2291060.name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 6
2291060.short_description: Live the future of despair.The year is 2024 AD. The survivors fought against the remaining threats while trying their best to continue their recovery.Three years passed in the year 2027. In a new world without hope, the time has come to once again resist the fate of the Earth.

2291340.name: The Baby in Yellow
2291340.short_description: You've got a new babysitting job, and things are taking a turn for the weird. Feed him, read him a bedtime story, and try not to fall into his dreams. How long can you stay in control?

2300160.name: Death From Above
2300160.short_description: You are a lone Ukrainian military drone operator battling Russian occupation forces. Hidden deep behind enemy lines, you operate your drone to seek and destroy tanks and armored vehicles, shatter communication lines, and recover stolen goods. Slava Ukraini!

2300230.name: Feather Party
2300230.short_description: Welcome to the fantastic party on the adorable planet of chicks! Feather Party is a multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Engage in a diverse array of fun mini-games with friends or against rivals to be the winner of this party!

2300300.name: Growth
2300300.short_description: Growth is a cozy, hexagonal-grid based soft-strategy game. Explore and populate a procedurally generated world by utilizing unique abilities of animals. Growth blends the beauty of cozy exploration with challenging navigation around obstacles.

2300320.name: Farming Simulator 25
2300320.short_description: Farming Simulator 25 invites you to join the rewarding farm life, single-handedly or cooperatively in multiplayer. This Farm is Your Farm!

2300340.name: Night Stones
2300340.short_description: You awake in Mythica, a cozy island where magical stones change day to night. Explore winding paths or venture into the wilds with your trusty glider and sailboat. To return home, you must befriend quirky townsfolk, discover hidden treasures, master magic, and face enemies in clever puzzle combat.

2300390.name: I commissioned some cats
2300390.short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

2300920.name: Succubus Prison
2300920.short_description: You've been dragged into robbing a house by a couple of thugs, but what you discover there is beyond anything you could have imagined.

2302140.name: q.u.q.
2302140.short_description: q.u.q. is a surreal visual novel about a somewhat crude girl that wanders a desert.

2302150.name: Against Great Darkness
2302150.short_description: Against Great Darkness is a brick-breaking, bullet hell, roguelite where you play as a pagan trying to escape Hell's maw. Trigger relics by keeping your disks bouncing, experience unique events where you can obtain incredible loot, and battle hellish bosses while always keeping an eye on your disks.

2302660.name: Homicipher
2302660.short_description: Homicipher is a language deciphering and exploration ADV based on the concept of "romance with horror men." The protagonist, who has wandered into another world, interacts with non-human beings to decipher their language while striving to escape.

2314160.name: Tactical Assault VR
2314160.short_description: Tactical Assault VR is an intense tactical shooter where you use real-world CQB (Close Quarters Battles) tactics to stack up, breach doors and eliminate threats. Play solo or join an online co-op special forces unit in missions around the world.

2314180.name: Silent Nights
2314180.short_description: Silent Nights - A short horror game with realistic graphics, touching storyline and scary moments.

2314650.name: Gray Haven
2314650.short_description: Gray Haven, a beautiful girl action RPG, invites you to explore dungeons, meet captivating characters, and uncover the truth behind the nightmares. Enjoy a rich array of interactive dialogues and cinematic cutscenes.

2314720.name: Parasocial | パラソーシャル
2314720.short_description: Parasocial | パラソーシャル is a Japanese horror game about a live streamer.

2314820.name: ヒラヒラヒヒル
2314820.short_description: "Hira Hira Hihiru" is a visual novel set in a fictional Taishō Era. It tells the story of its two protagonists' struggle against Aerodema, a terrifying disease which brings the dead back to life.

2315020.name: Froguelike
2315020.short_description: Your choices matter in Froguelike where you play as a frog on a mission to eat all the bugs. Level up, choose new tongues and upgrades, become unstoppable and run straight into the swarm! Unlock all frogs, tongues, items and chapters to become the most powerful frog in the pond.

2315400.name: Knights in Tight Spaces
2315400.short_description: Control your environment, gather your party, and build your best deck to overcome outlaws and supernatural forces, across a rich fantasy world. Watch as your tactical choices and deckbuilding prowess play out through stylish fight sequences.

2315430.name: The Executive - Movie Industry Tycoon
2315430.short_description: Shape the history of the Hollywood movie industry in this sandbox business simulation game. Create the movies you've always wanted to see, hire the best team, research cutting-edge technologies, and dominate the Box Office. Can you rise from a small studio to a Hollywood giant?

2315690.name: WWE 2K24
2315690.short_description: Experience a gripping retelling of WrestleMania’s greatest moments in 2K Showcase of the Immortals in WWE 2K24, where you can relive a collection of some of the most unforgettable, career-defining matches.

2326020.name: Save Room - The Merchant
2326020.short_description: Immerse yourself in the Save Room, a place of safety and respite. Master inventory management while interacting with the enigmatic merchant. Buy, sell, and acquire crucial items to conquer every challenge. Not only will you need cash, but you'll need GUTS to finish this game!

2326590.name: Kakuriyo Village ~Moratorium of Adolescence~
2326590.short_description: Ao & Hinori were both childhood sweethearts & accidentally went to a strange world called Kakuriyo Village. Because of her boyish appearance, the villagers mistakenly thought Hinori was a boy... Can they successfully hide Hinori's genders and escape from the village！？

2326780.name: Embarrassed Shina-chan~ the Naked Wandering College Girl
2326780.short_description: Get up in the morning and see a naked female college student lying on the shadow in front of the station closest to the university If you are discovered by the police, your life will become messy! The 3D invisible action game of betting on Shy's life began ...
developers: かわいそうなのは抜ける

2328310.name: CUSTOM MECH WARS
2328310.short_description: Take customization to the extreme with the Omega Customization System and battle with one-of-a-kind combat units in this all-new third-person shooter mecha game.

2328540.name: Incantation
2328540.short_description: A mother, searching for her lost daughter, stumbles into a strange cult village. "Incantation" is a first-person horror game. It reveals the chilling story behind the "Chen Family Village". What are the consequences of crossing dark boundaries?

2338770.name: NBA 2K24
2338770.short_description: Experience hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy loads of action and limitless personalized MyPLAYER options in MyCAREER. Build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Feel more responsive gameplay and polished visuals while playing with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams in PLAY NOW.

2339040.name: Landnama
2339040.short_description: Face the judgment of winter’s deadly toll as you lead the first Viking clans to settle Iceland in this non-violent, rogue-lite survival base builder.

2339690.name: Outpost
2339690.short_description: this is a tower defence game,we need upgrade our weapons to fight waves of enemies,robots can mining diamonds,and we need spent those in many aspect，features of this game: 1 return back before dager comes,2tempory upgrade are important but permanent upgrade are better

2340500.name: 创造三国志
2340500.short_description: This is a classic historical simulation + real-time strategy game, where you will go back to the era of the Three Kingdoms and play as various renowned sovereigns.

2340650.name: 古龙风云录
2340650.short_description: 《古龙风云录》是一款大型武侠RPG，拥有古龙作品授权，还原古龙笔下武侠世界。玩家在武侠世界里探索百态江湖，体验超百万字剧情，奇遇各路豪侠，选择并养成你的伙伴，最终一起解开当年回雁峰谜团……
