2340870.name: Rugby 25
2340870.short_description: Experience the Rugby 25 rush! From local club clashes to the grandest international championships, lifelike gameplay, strategic depth, and heart-stopping action ensure every match is a battle and every victory earned on the path to immortality.

2452920.name: Ouros
2452920.short_description: Ouros is a calming puzzle game about forming beautiful curves in a serene space. Find your flow as you nudge, bend, and stretch curves into pleasing shapes, and discover the inherent mathematical beauty of Ouros.

2453060.name: Dreamcore
2453060.short_description: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

2458830.name: Towerborne
2458830.short_description: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.

2458860.name: Summer Clover
2458860.short_description: Experience a summer like never before as you become a live-in housekeeper for three charming sisters (and your supportive supervisor).

2458940.name: Farm Keeper
2458940.short_description: A tile-based farming game where success means maximizing yields to survive the rent, expanding your farm through random tile choices.

2459350.name: Taboo University Book One
2459350.short_description: Set before all the events of Fetish Locator, something strange happened and three girls went missing! Now you must immerse yourself in a prestigious university's depths to learn more about it. Meet new people, meet new sexy girls, and discover all the secrets hidden in this big university!

2459490.name: This Grand Life 2
2459490.short_description: A money-focused life simulator. Create characters with allergies and addictions. Manage their lives through financial booms and busts. Advance their careers, start a small business, invest in real estate and stocks - or roleplay a penniless hobo.

2459550.name: Emberward
2459550.short_description: Build twisting mazes with tetromino blocks and deploy unique towers in this engaging roguelite tower defense game!

2459750.name: 幻日のヨハネ - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE -
2459750.short_description: Yohane the Parhelion is an official spin-off of "Love Live! Sunshine". 『Yohane the Parhelion - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE -』 is a deckbuilding roguelite set in that world! A mysterious mirror world that changes each time it's entered. After countless choices, Yohane chooses...

2464880.name: Terracards
2464880.short_description: Farm, sell, learn, repeat. Terracards is a tactical roguelike-deckbuilder where you manage your own farm, You'll utilize animals, crops, and structures through cards, transforming them into valuable resources and wealth with each turn. But beware - deplete your funds, and it's game over.

2477010.name: Ticket to Ride®
2477010.short_description: Discover a fresh adaptation of the iconic, multi-award-winning board game. Play against fellow fans around the world, or take on state-of-the-art AI opponents. Build a railway empire, claim routes and dominate your competitors on the leaderboards in this fan-favourite modern classic!

2477090.name: Mosa Lina
2477090.short_description: a hostile interpretation of the immersive sim, where nothing is planned, and everything works

2477140.name: Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk FPS
2477140.short_description: Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk FPS is a brutal, funny, bloody FPS game with an advanced gore system. Featuring 15 beautiful levels, a variety of weapons and a deeply engaging story that follows the journey of a young man and his friend tackling on a criminal underground to give his AI wife a real body.

2477340.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game
2477340.short_description: Embark on scientific expeditions with this new off-road adventure game. Lead research missions as you drive a variety of all-terrain vehicles, using high-tech tools and managing your camp and crew to ensure your success in the wild.

2483970.name: Honeymoon : Mystery Journey
2483970.short_description: Return to that fateful day to save your beloved wife in this time-hopping puzzle game!

2484130.name: Fruitbus
2484130.short_description: A journey of flavors and friendships awaits you in your cozy, customisable food truck! Forage for fresh ingredients to create your own menu, then feed tummies and souls with home-cooked meals. Change the world, one apple at a time.

2484160.name: It was a human.
2484160.short_description: A short SF psychedelic interrogation ADV game that focuses on the interrogation of a suspect in a dismemberment murder case. The protagonist is a lieutenant colonel, tasked with interrogating the suspect. The protagonist needs to find out why she killed the two men and how she committed the crime.

2489990.name: Jeepney Simulator
2489990.short_description: Embrace your inner jeepney driver! Pick up passengers, calculate change, and weave through traffic in this Filipino-made driving game. Feed your family, customize your jeepneys, and unlock more rides! Don't forget to bring your towel!

2496640.name: Futanari di Funghi
2496640.short_description: Satisfy your customers by enriching their food with your nutritious & delicious futanari sauce!

2497210.name: PUSHER - Drug Tycoon
2497210.short_description: Thrilling business tycoon sim where you step into the shoes of a drug dealer in 1980s USA. Your main goal is simple: BUY LOW and SELL HIGH. Get ready for a experience where you'll combine strategy, risk-taking, and decision-making to build your criminal empire.

2497280.name: Joy Life
2497280.short_description: In the game, you need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the flopped cards are inconsistent, there will be no change. The way to pass the level is to eliminate all the cards in the picture.

2503950.name: ION Shift
2503950.short_description: ION Shift offers fast-paced, precision combat with sleek visuals, designed for fans of Katana Zero. Play as a deadly creature and destroy everything in your path to escape.

2510130.name: Auto Sale Life
2510130.short_description: Build an automotive empire. Buy, sell, and customize cars to create your own brands and showrooms. Become a shrewd entrepreneur in this immersive car trading and customization game.

2510710.name: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
2510710.short_description: A new tale of the Kami awaits... Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is a unique Japanese-inspired, single player Kagura Action Strategy game.

2510770.name: Stella of The End
2510770.short_description: Jude Gray, a wandering Courier, receives a request to deliver some very special cargo. This cargo turns out to be Philia, an android girl who is unaffected by the enigmatic Singularity Machines.

2510850.name: Slay the Minotaur
2510850.short_description: Slay the Minotaur is a challenging roguelike dungeon crawler set in ancient Greece. Survive the onslaught of the labyrinth. Upgrade your skills, earn ranks, and face the Minotaur in the ultimate game of cat and mouse!

2510890.name: Pricolage -IDOLIZED-
2510890.short_description: “Just who are you…?” Uncover the truth behind K-pop idol Sena as you search through her social media accounts in Pricolage -IDOLIZED-. In order to locate K-pop idol Sena, pronounced missing, you must search for clues in the ocean of darkness and greed that is the internet.

2510960.name: Temtem: Swarm
2510960.short_description: Can you Survive the Swarm? Unlock mighty abilities and upgrades, find and collect Tems to evolve and become stronger, discover overpowered strategies, and battle massive bosses in this survivor-like bullet heaven! Play solo or online co-op with up to 3 players, building the wildest synergies.

2511030.name: Deep Secret
2511030.short_description: This is a casual puzzle match-3 game. Players need to use the mouse to select two unobstructed squares, and if they are the same, they will be eliminated. After success, you can advance the plot and story development of the two protagonists!

2511290.name: Two Cubes
2511290.short_description: Two Cubes is an Online Co-Op platformer where players can only touch their colour! The game requires 2 players who own the game to play!

2523310.name: Lingo 2
2523310.short_description: Lingo 2 blends word puzzles and impossible geometry, with brand new puzzle mechanics and a large, colorful world to discover. Welcome back!

2523910.name: The Entrepreneur
2523910.short_description: Become The Entrepreneur they need! In this choice-driven adventure, you will dive into a world filled with fun, drama, high stakes, sex, and much more. Build relationships, face immense challenges, and feel the consequences of your decisions affecting those around you! What lies ahead for you?

2524360.name: With My Past
2524360.short_description: "How should I face my past in my ever-changing life? "Collaborating with the shadow of the past to unravel allegorical puzzles, confront inner struggles, and explore the path of self-growth.

2524480.name: Cozy Space 物宅空间
2524480.short_description: "Cozy Space" is a relaxing home decoration game with true-to-life models and rooms. Enjoy a leisurely gaming experience and easily create cozy spaces. It cleverly blends music elements, allowing you to be a composer, interior designer, or simply relax without specific tasks!

2537590.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
2537590.short_description: Explore the world with our largest fleet of aircraft and take simulation to new heights while pursuing your aviation career within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

2537920.name: Just Crow Things
2537920.short_description: You're a little crow trying to prove herself to the world. Make new animal friends, poop on unsuspecting hoomans, and steal all the shiny trinkets! Each level is a little sandbox full of fun items to discover and puzzles to solve, while leaving a bit of chaos behind. Why? Just caws!

2538000.name: Dojo Masters
2538000.short_description: DOJO MASTERS is a 2-button martial arts indie fighting game. Battle against your friends or head online to challenge warriors from around the world!

2538370.name: Long Story Short
2538370.short_description: Long Story Short is a funny and erotic adult game about a young man who finally decides to explore life beyond his computer screen. Follow him as he retells his experiences to a mysterious girl. Choose what kind of sexual person he will become. A new world of sexual debauchery awaits you.

2538390.name: Angry Penguin
2538390.short_description: hard platformer with a penguin, and it's probably a good game for youtube and twitch (do not insult my mother while playing pls)

2544720.name: Workplace Fantasy
2544720.short_description: "Workplace Fantasy" is an action-adventure love story about a man's enchanting encounters with a gentle older sister, an adorable younger sister, an older university female, female colleagues, female supervisors, beautiful saleswomen, mysterious angels, and even a female succubus and a female ghost.

2544990.name: Hypnosis Card
2544990.short_description: Hypnosis Cards is a deck-building game that introduces a novel concept of parts. Players can use numerous cards to engage in card battles with five girls.

2550480.name: Skibidi Toilets: Invasion
2550480.short_description: A secret agent prevents an evil toilet uprising. Follow this path with brutal music and a killer attitude.

2553050.name: Estate Agent Simulator
2553050.short_description: Estate Agent Simulator lets you enter the exciting world of the real estate market. You can buy, decorate, advertise, rent or sell houses. You can buy vacant land and build houses. Environmental factors will affect the rental prices of houses.

2561270.name: Skibidi Toilet Hero
2561270.short_description: Fast-Paced ULTRAKILL and DOOM like game where you are playing as the last Cameraman, who has to fight off the army of Skibidi Toilets using various weapons and cheerful music 🚽 (And little bit of pure brainrot)

2561580.name: Horizon Zero Dawn™ Remastered
2561580.short_description: Experience the critically acclaimed Horizon Zero Dawn™ with stunning new visuals and upgraded features. In a far future where colossal machines roam the Earth, pockets of humanity survive in unique tribes among the lush, overgrown ruins of our long-lost civilization.

2562240.name: Only Up!
2562240.short_description: Get set to defy gravity, leap like never before, and experience the exhilarating world of parkour in a whole new light! This isn’t just your ordinary parkour jump simulator - it’s a dynamic ONLINE MULTIPLAYER adventure that transforms your every move into a gravity-defying spectacle.

2562460.name: そろそろ寿司を食べないと死ぬぜ！ユニバース
2562460.short_description: Multiverse sushi eating 3D action game! An epic love story with a sushi theme! ...sushi! very delicious! Apologize because it's too delicious!

2562730.name: Samawa Idle
2562730.short_description: Unleash the power of specialized towers to annihilate hordes of monsters in this idle game with roguelike elements. Collect gold, level up your towers, face powerful bosses, and refine your strategy with an evolving skill tree.

2574840.name: Go For A Punch! Saki Sanobashi
2574840.short_description: Four students find themselves trapped in the restroom of an abandoned school; the door is locked. Without a way of escaping, they can only cling to their remaining shreds of hope or come face to face with their inevitable ruin.

2575900.name: Corn Kidz 64
2575900.short_description: The unauthorized, kid-friendly version of the classic Stephen King thriller (or maybe not, maybe it's just a game about one-horned goatbabies)

2576040.name: Goblin Gangbang 🧟🍆👩
2576040.short_description: The story of how silly Emilia met a gangbang of Goblins in the cave.

2588590.name: Fleshlight Squad - Fleshlightize -
2588590.short_description: Rei, the agent, must infiltrate the factory to rescue those missing women! Once defeated, everyone knows the fate of female agents, right?

2588610.name: Last Lesson
2588610.short_description: It's your first night as the caretaker of a scary quest. The last visitors have gone home. You need to turn off the lights, check the equipment and not die of horror, because someone or something suddenly starts a nightmarish game. With you in the lead.

2599270.name: Gem Defender: Soyjak Survivors
2599270.short_description: Follow Chud on his fight against Dr Soystein's 'jak army in this spine-tingling survival shooter. NOW FEATURING BADLANDSCHUGS

2599300.name: Dead Signal
2599300.short_description: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

2599370.name: DEATHWATCHERS
2599370.short_description: Use the specialized equipment at your disposal to locate & log as many paranormal events as possible. Decipher the ingredients needed for your ritual and try to exorcise any demons within, but be warned. Any incorrect ingredients and you may never leave! Can be played solo or with up to 3 friends.

2599950.name: Backwoods Town
2599950.short_description: Backwoods town is an atmospheric forest survival simulator. Build your base, grow crops, fight bosses and rebuild the destroyed settlement, finding all its inhabitants along the way.

2600180.name: Night Grove
2600180.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. A young deliveryman took an unusual order that led him to Night Grove. This place has a dubious reputation among the townspeople, because for many years it has been sent to live with people that society has long since abandoned.

2600570.name: 纸嫁衣5来生戏
2600570.short_description: "Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes" is the 5th work in the "Paper Bride' series. Our cast from Zangling Village return to the stage to welcome players back to the world of paper bride...

2600600.name: Internet Cafe Evolution
2600600.short_description: This is a business simulation + construction game. It tells the evolution history of Internet cafes that began in the 1990s, and imagines the future of internet cafes. There are also some small emotional stories.

2631880.name: Don't Be Afraid 2
2631880.short_description: Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

2631960.name: 14 Minesweeper Variants 2
2631960.short_description: Minesweeper but the rules are changing, again.

2632930.name: Life Eater
2632930.short_description: If you don't sacrifice your neighbors, the world ends. Life Eater is a horror fantasy kidnapping simulator where you must become intimately familiar with your targets' lives one intrusive action at a time... and hope that the dark god you serve is even real.

2633080.name: Struggle F.O
2633080.short_description: What the newly awakened girl saw was an unfamiliar world and unfamiliar creatures. And on her arm, there was a mysterious gadget that could speak. Somehow, the girl who could now communicate with all living creatures, starts to struggle with her allies to survive in this world!

2633170.name: Front Office Football Nine
2633170.short_description: Put yourself in the Front Office with Front Office Football, the professional football simulation from Solecismic Software. Manage your roster through trading, free agency and the amateur draft. Create game plans, organize depth charts and watch your franchise thrive for decades.

2633500.name: Dragon Throne: Battle of Red Cliffs
2633500.short_description: An epic real-time strategy game set in chaotic Ancient China. Control the kingdoms of Liu Bei, Sun Quan, or Cao Cao, warlords who played a pivotal role in Ancient China. Lead your kingdom, innovate tech, forge alliances, build a formidable army to unite the nation.

2633640.name: Eyes: The Horror Game
2633640.short_description: You break into the mansion at night. It’s huge and built like a maze. You're trying to escape, but the monster is after you! The chase begins. RUN!!

2633890.name: Orgasm Simulator 3 💦
2633890.short_description: Welcome to the world of Orgasm Simulator 3 💦 – an engaging real-time visual novel where romance and detective work intertwine in a three-dimensional virtual space.

2645490.name: Ghostbane
2645490.short_description: Ghostbane, is a Co-Op horror game for 1-4 players. Detect paranormal activity, collect evidence of ghosts, hunt ghosts by rituals, and conduct detailed investigations about ghosts in your main base.

2646460.name: Soulmask
2646460.short_description: Escaping a deadly sacrificial ritual, you find an ancient mystical mask on your journey. This mask holds potent knowledge, changing the world you knew. Face the harsh challenges of nature, survive, rally followers, and build your own tribe. Explore and unveil the truths behind the enigmatic mask.

2647060.name: LoveXLust
2647060.short_description: A world where your every desire can be shaped, molded, and brought to life. LoveXLust invites you to Create & Control Your Fantasies, giving you the power to design your dreams, explore seductive environments, and indulge in fully interactive intimate encounters—all at your own pace.

2647230.name: HoloParade
2647230.short_description: Collect your favorite characters, nurture them, and have fun just watching in this hololive fan game! It's a 2D tower defense game that offers depth for dedicated players, strategic elements, and easy enjoyment for casual players.

2657850.name: Cozy Space Survivors
2657850.short_description: A cozy time survival roguelite in space. You steer the shippy while the shooting happens automatically. Meet cute NPCs, solve small quests, and fight quirky enemies with satisfying weapons. A shorter experience for people who don't have much time but love playing (and finishing) games.

2657900.name: For Sale
2657900.short_description: The year is 1998. Step into the shoes of a real estate agent, tasked with photographing a seemingly ordinary house for an upcoming sale. Explore the environment, use your camera to take pictur-- wait, what’s that in the last photo?

2658080.name: METAL BREAKER
2658080.short_description: A fast-paced, adult side scrolling shooter inspired by classic shoot-em-up games.

2658450.name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP
2658450.short_description: The chainsaw-wielding cheerleader Juliet Starling returns in Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP!

2658470.name: Is This Game Trying To Kill Me?
2658470.short_description: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!

2658720.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York
2658720.short_description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York is a narrative game set in the World of Darkness Universe. Play as one of the members of the Vampire Clans in a shifting political landscape between the Camarilla and the Anarchs while trying your best to survive.

2658920.name: 스테퍼 리본
2658920.short_description: Staffer Reborn is a game of supernatural abilities and logical deduction set in 1960s America. It tells the story of a man trapped in a cycle of death and resurrection caused by his supernatural ability and the investigator who was recruited to help.

2659050.name: Movies Tycoon
2659050.short_description: Movies Tycoon is a simulation game where you dive into the world of film-making. Start with a humble studio, scout and manage top talent, customize unique characters, and direct blockbuster films.

2668510.name: Red Dead Redemption
2668510.short_description: Experience the story of former outlaw John Marston as he tracks down the last remaining members of the notorious Van der Linde Gang in the PC debut of the critically acclaimed predecessor to Red Dead Redemption 2.

2670630.name: Supermarket Simulator
2670630.short_description: Run your own supermarket. Stock shelves, set prices as you'd like, take payments, hire staff, expand and design your store. Online orders & delivery, shoplifters, security, local market are upcoming.

2671320.name: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
2671320.short_description: Hidden Cats in Tokyo is a hidden object adventure game where you must vaccinate all the cats in Tokyo before they turn into dangerous monsters. Collect cards of heroes, monsters, and cat things. Join the adventure and fight the huge monster with your giant robot in this fun hidden object game!

2677660.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
2677660.short_description: Uncover one of history’s greatest mysteries in a first-person, single-player adventure. The year is 1937, sinister forces are scouring the globe for the secret to an ancient power connected to the Great Circle, and only one person can stop them - Indiana Jones™.

2686900.name: Churn Vector
2686900.short_description: Churn Vector is a single-player stealth action game, where instead of eliminating targets with a gun, you eliminate them with your cock!

2693530.name: Witching Stone
2693530.short_description: Witching Stone is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

2694490.name: Path of Exile 2
2694490.short_description: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

2698780.name: ContractVille
2698780.short_description: Plan, design, build, and decorate your dream house in an open-world. Smash walls, sketch your layout, then build and decorate every inch—inside and garden. In an open world, tackle each renovation solo or with up to 4 friends. Pick up that hammer and start creating - Your dream house is waiting!

2824310.name: Lucky Hunter
2824310.short_description: Lucky Hunter is a deck-building auto battler Roguelike game. Your pieces are automatically played on the board, and players will focus on building unique decks and relics, making the best of the synergies between pieces to defeat increasingly powerful prey.

2824660.name: Old School Rally
2824660.short_description: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

2825110.name: Technotopia
2825110.short_description: Welcome to Technotopia, a city-builder card game. Take on the role of an AI designed to build a perfect city. Build districts, meet the needs of diverse communities and maintain the delicate balance between factions vying for control over you!

2825300.name: AMANATSU ~Perfect Edition~
2825300.short_description: Japanese coming-of-age VN from hit developer AZARASHI SOFTWARE. After moving to a sleepy seaside town, Haruto befriends three unforgettable heroines, each with unique traits—and a surprise confession. Navigate your own summer of love on this sugar-sweet journey of romance and discovery.

2826180.name: ChillPulse
2826180.short_description: Chill Pulse combines productivity tools with serene environments. Use a Pomodoro timer and to-do lists to boost focus, while ambient sounds in settings from cyberpunk cities to ancient landscapes enhance relaxation.

2826800.name: Amanda the Adventurer 2
2826800.short_description: In Amanda the Adventurer 2, the story continues as Riley encounters a mysterious masked figure after destroying the TV in the attic. Travel to the Kensdale Public Library and dig deeper into the mystery of Amanda the Adventurer.

2837600.name: The Alto Collection
2837600.short_description: Across the endless desert and atop an alpine expanse two journeys full of wonder await. Choose your path and set off on a thrilling snowboarding or sandboarding adventure with Alto & friends in both critically acclaimed titles: Alto’s Adventure and Alto’s Odyssey.

2839280.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid
2839280.short_description: A circus troupe comes to Yomogi Town, a rural town in Japan situated between mountains and the ocean. As the son of the circus ringmaster, enjoy a special summer filled with wholesome adventures!

2839450.name: Turkish Throne
2839450.short_description: Lead your political party in a fierce competition to seize power against major rivals. Invest strategically, secure votes, and navigate crucial decisions to claim the presidential seat. Will you shape the destiny of Turkish politics?

2840190.name: Great God Grove
2840190.short_description: THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch dialogue in a world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!

2840210.name: Bureau of Contacts
2840210.short_description: "Bureau of Contacts" - ghost-hunting game for 1-4 players, in which you'll encounter 2 enemies at once - location itself and the ghosts with most human-like intelligence ever. So...look around and watch what you say!

2840250.name: ZERO PROTOCOL
2840250.short_description: In this immersive sci-fi thriller, you will experience the atmosphere of classic 3D games as you solve puzzles, follow an intriguing non-linear storyline, and engage in battles with monsters.

2840480.name: FLATHEAD
2840480.short_description: Over or Under? A simple game of gambling with your life.

2851150.name: Tomba! Special Edition
2851150.short_description: In Tomba! Special Edition, leap, bite, and throw your way across stunning 2.5D landscapes in this vastly-enhanced update to a platforming classic!

2851700.name: Nasty Zombies
2851700.short_description: Blast through hordes of Nasty Zombies solo or with up to 3 friends! Face dynamic map layouts, ensuring every run is unique. Unlock perks and power-ups with your hard-earned cash in this wave-based, retro-inspired shooter.

2852770.name: Placid Plastic Desktop
2852770.short_description: Bring your favorite ducks directly to your desktop! Choose from a vibrant selection of rubber ducks and let them help you stay focused at your desk. Whether you're working, studying, or playing, these are the ducks that will always be by your side.

2852930.name: Ethel
2852930.short_description: Welcome to my first game! Where you'll Immerse yourself in a unbelievable, story-rich mystery, packed with jaw-dropping plot twist, horror, and multiple endings.

2852980.name: Necroking
2852980.short_description: Necroking is a turn-based tactics roguelite with vast deckbuilding. You play as a Master of Necromancy. Build your skulls deck, raise skeletons and other scum to defeat settlements desecrated by life.

2853130.name: Astrodle
2853130.short_description: Ready for some chill time in space? Astrodle has you covered. Watch the numbers soar as you upgrade your ship and travel the stars. Oh, and you might just become a god.

2882440.name: DEVIL BLADE REBOOT
2882440.short_description: An immersive pseudo-3D shoot 'em up experience that pushes the limits of pixel art. Push your score higher with the innovative Berserk System: the closer they are, the more points you get!

2882870.name: Doll Impostor
2882870.short_description: Doll Impostor is a horror game where 1-4 players take on the role of guardians of possessed dolls. Work together to identify the impostor doll before 9 a.m, or face dire consequences. Every hour counts in this tense, fear-filled race against time.

2883280.name: Dog Brew
2883280.short_description: Dog Brew - a light indie adventure where the main character, burdened by debts, decides to settle them through the art of brewing beer.

2884190.name: Fight School Simulator
2884190.short_description: Are you ready to become a legendary martial arts master? Build your own school, train your students, and battle rival schools to become the strongest. Join tournaments, raise your grasshoppers, and most importantly, collect tuition from your students!

2884650.name: STRETCHER MEN
2884650.short_description: "STRETCHER MEN" is an action game where you transport a patient on a stretcher. Control characters at the front and back, avoiding obstacles to safely reach the clinic. Simple yet deep gameplay tests your attention and coordination.

2908950.name: Tunnel Escape
2908950.short_description: Embark on a daring journey with Beatrice as you kick, shoot, and loot through a secret underground lab. In this rogue-lite RPG/ADV, engage in strategic combat and face intense encounters that may strip her bare... of her defenses and expose her to unspeakable dangers!

2909110.name: Nuclear Nightmare
2909110.short_description: Venture forth as part of a specialized team of fellow players tasked with retrieving classified materials, evading the black goo virus, and the nightmarish entities it has spawned. With time running out before the US government initiates a devastating nuclear strike to contain the spreading menace.

2909170.name: Body Pay
2909170.short_description: Body Pay is a game that combines puzzles, story, and adult animation.

2909250.name: Extreme Climbing
2909250.short_description: Unarmed climbing of world famous buildings: Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Tokyo Sky Tree Tower, Dubai Tower, Pyramid, Guangzhou Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, CCTV Tower, etc.

2909400.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
2909400.short_description: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping from the dystopian city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant and vast world in this standalone entry to the FFVII remake trilogy!

2915460.name: OneShot: World Machine Edition
2915460.short_description: A completely self-contained portable version of one of the highest user-rated games. Built on an entirely new engine with new UI, support for Steam Deck, & more. Features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story about the truth of the game's reality.

2922410.name: Achilles: Survivor
2922410.short_description: Thousands of enemies. One survivor. Fight like a demigod, build deadly defenses, and grow stronger after every run in this fast-paced bullet hell set in mythic Greece.

2928520.name: Recycling Center Simulator
2928520.short_description: Recycling Center Simulator is a business simulator game with a first person view. Make money from garbage, collect raw materials for your recycling center from different locations, recycle them, make money by producing new products and improve your factory.

2928650.name: Only Up: SKIBIDI TOGETHER
2928650.short_description: Only Up: SKIBIDI TOGETHER is an incredible multiplayer parkour game where precision and speed are important. Jump and climb over various obstacles. The slightest mistake can result in a fall to the starting location.

2928660.name: BACKROOMS INVASION
2928660.short_description: BACKROOMS INVASION is an exciting horror game that will give you a unique experience. Prepare for a challenge that will test your teamwork, wits and endurance! Multiplayer for up to 8 people!

2928700.name: 三日危情，独家的记忆
2928700.short_description: Exclusive Memories "is a first person immersive suspense love full dynamic live action interactive video game. A sudden accident caused you to lose your memory. Can you retrieve your memories and everything that belongs to you in the turbulent undercurrents?

2929170.name: MONOPOLY 2024
2929170.short_description: MONOPOLY® is back with a fresh look and an improved game experience. Buy, sell, trade properties, and grow your empire in a fully animated 3D city that transforms from sunlit days to stormy nights as you play.

2929540.name: Dragon Ruins
2929540.short_description: A dungeon crawling microgame for tired people.

2929730.name: Cat Bait
2929730.short_description: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.

2935400.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2025
2935400.short_description: Suit up and become the manager of a basketball team. You’ll have all the managerial tools you’ve come to expect in a manager game, scouting, facilities, training and more. Will you put emphasis on coaching or player development? Success is only the result of your decisions both on and off the court.

2935700.name: Cowgirl's Café
2935700.short_description: Welcome to Cow's Girl Café, an engaging incremental game that will transport you to a one-of-a-kind coffee shop. Your mission? Running a coffee shop where fresh milk is the secret ingredient to success, coming directly from two special girls.

2935840.name: POOOOL
2935840.short_description: POOOOL is a small, pool-inspired physics puzzler where you combine balls of similar sizes to create even bigger ones, all while trying to save room for more. Chase your hi-score, share scores with friends, and master your flinging skills!

2936030.name: Botworld Odyssey
2936030.short_description: Venture out into a huge open world to discover new bots and collect rare scrap to build them. Deploy your bots in tactical auto-battles on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster.

2941350.name: Doll Grabber
2941350.short_description: "Doll Grabber" is a casual puzzle game that simulates a claw machine. Players need to grab a specified number of dolls in each level. Come and challenge yourself!

2941660.name: Archean
2941660.short_description: Archean is a realistic, immersive multiplayer engineering sandbox and space sim. Featuring one of the best in-game programming system. Learn to code while having fun!

2950340.name: LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection
2950340.short_description: The LEGO® Harry Potter™: Collection brings LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 1-4 and LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 5-7 together in one game, now remastered with enhanced graphics.

2954260.name: FINAL SPIN
2954260.short_description: A 2-4 player online party game about risking your life for the thrill of high-stakes gambling. Use your items wisely to gain an edge over chance and play until you are the last person standing.

2963230.name: Joyville 2
2963230.short_description: Joyville 2 is a first-person horror puzzle-adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Explore two parallel worlds where the joy of the past meets present horrors. Uncover the camp's dark secrets, face magical yet dangerous creatures, and discover the truth behind events from decades ago.

2963510.name: In Search Of You
2963510.short_description: This game is to rekindle the exhilarating sensation of youthful passion—to perfectly capture the essence of romantic endeavors, making the experience of falling in love both sweet and meaningful, and to inspire players with the beauty of love within the nightlife entertainment industry.

2963550.name: 命运游戏：逆时寻凶
2963550.short_description: Immerse yourself in the first-person perspective, cross time and space, solve bizarre cases, save innocent victims, and catch a mysterious killer! You will solve murders, uphold justice, and also gain love. Are you ready? Play the "Game of Fate" that crosses time and space, life and death!

2963880.name: Murky Divers
2963880.short_description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

2967320.name: Grandpa High On Retro
2967320.short_description: Grandpa goes on a third person, action adventure killing rampage, with his grandson after his smoking session was interrupted by a phone call.

2967990.name: Train Sim World® 5
2967990.short_description: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.

2971610.name: HOLE
2971610.short_description: Casual & Hard FPS. Be careful with jam.

2981590.name: Factory Outlet Simulator
2981590.short_description: Factory Outlet Simulator is a very comprehensive product manufacturing and selling game. You can produce the products of world famous brands in your factory and sell them. Or you can expand your business and create your own brand. Use your business acumen to lead the market from zero to the top!

2986260.name: Dreamlike Love with Seira
2986260.short_description: Enjoy the memories with a beautiful maid in your dreams and heal your fatigue in reality.

2986370.name: Food Delivery Simulator
2986370.short_description: Live the life of a food delivery driver. Deliver orders, earn money, upgrade your vehicle, explore a vast city, and make way to your success. Dive into a realistic daily adventure and level up to become the best delivery driver.

2995920.name: It Takes Two - Friend's Pass
2995920.short_description: Download Friend's Pass* and play It Takes Two with a friend for free. Just grab a friend who owns the full game, download Friend's Pass for free, and play together!

2996040.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
2996040.short_description: TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a rogue-like quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

3001330.name: Forest Heroes
3001330.short_description: Forest Heroes combines tower defense with roguelike deck building. Enjoy intense battles and diverse strategies with simple controls!

3001560.name: Japan Trip
3001560.short_description: Prepare to be swept away by the enchanting allure of Tokyo's nightlife, where neon lights illuminate the path to unexpected encounters and unforgettable experiences.

3001730.name: [Bober Bros] It's Just A Prank
3001730.short_description: It's Just A Prank is a first-person horror game about kids playing pranks on each other until a PRANK GOES WRONG. Experience suspense, fear, and unexpected twists as a simple joke becomes a nightmare.

3002570.name: Nymphomaniac - Sex Addict
3002570.short_description: A visually stunning story about a nymphomaniac who loves her body, sex and adrenaline. All this presented in a photorealistic audiovisual setting.

3002620.name: Football Referee Simulator
3002620.short_description: Football Referee Simulator—the groundbreaking game that puts you in the referee's shoes! Are you ready to kickstart your career in the lower divisions and ascend to legendary status by overseeing thrilling finals?

3002850.name: FAIRY TAIL 2
3002850.short_description: The final battle of FAIRY TAIL is about to begin

3013550.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION
3013550.short_description: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION is packed with classic Yu-Gi-Oh! games from the very early days of Dueling — bursting with retro RPGs and strategic card games with beloved anime characters!

3013700.name: Candy & Toys Store Simulator
3013700.short_description: Run your own candy and toys store. Place online orders for supplies, receive them via delivery truck, stock shelves, hire employees, set prices, take payments, expand, and design your store. Many things are waiting for you.

3014520.name: BrokenLore: LOW
3014520.short_description: BrokenLore: LOW is a psychological horror game set in a mist-covered, beautiful Japanese village, blending hyper-realistic graphics with low-poly elements. The main enemy is the Gashadokuro, a yokai from Japanese folklore.

3014600.name: SEX Airlines 🔞✈️
3014600.short_description: Welcome aboard SEX Airlines 🔞✈️ - an adult visual novel where you shape the story of professional pilot Arthur and people around him!

3015100.name: Apocalyptic cat
3015100.short_description: Apocalyptic Cat is an atmospheric hardcore platformer about a little black cat's journey in a post-apocalyptic world. Overcome toxic clouds, spikes, and obstacles, striving to fulfill his last dream of reaching paradise.

3015110.name: Backrooms Cats and Lava
3015110.short_description: Backrooms Cats and Lava is an action-platformer with puzzle elements. Help a small cave dweller escape rising lava by moving boxes to create safe paths. Remember, the floor is lava—don't step on it!

3015120.name: Cyber Assasin
3015120.short_description: Cyber Assassin is a fast-paced arena shooter where you control a robot annihilating waves of enemies. Survive, upgrade your character after each wave, and become more powerful to dominate the arena!

3015130.name: Digital Meow
3015130.short_description: Digital Meow is a vaporwave platformer where a little cat journeys through a digital world to find a new home. Overcome lasers, spikes, and cannons in this nostalgic and challenging adventure!

3015140.name: Dungeon Digger
3015140.short_description: Dungeon Digger is a roguelike game about a brave dwarf seeking legendary treasures. Descend deep underground, mine valuable minerals, craft upgraded gear, and battle spiders, golems, worms, and ghosts to become a cave hero!

3015190.name: Rap Pop Jump Core
3015190.short_description: Rap Pop Jump Core is a hardcore action platformer demanding constant movement, quick decisions, and combat. Navigate a vibrant city by leaping between platforms. One mistake, and you fall to your fate. Escape swiftly!

3015620.name: Welcome Back Commander
3015620.short_description: Commander, your strike team is to dive deep into the contaminated city of Sun Stone and get some answers before the mysterious deadly plague spreads . Good luck Commander!

3027260.name: BEHEMOTH
3027260.short_description: Dodge ‘n flap your wings in this new arcade extravaganza from The Behemoth! In BEHEMOTH™, you become one with the chicken to secure your flock in the nest and collect as much candy corn as possible!

3027620.name: Kakenuke★Forward to Our Sparking Youth!
3027620.short_description: What does "youth" mean to you? Is it a time in your life meant for having fun? For devoting yourself to a cause? For Yuu Tono, it's meant earning money and studying to build a brighter future for him and his family. But maybe the new (or maybe old?) friend who's come into his life will change that.

3027930.name: Karate Survivor
3027930.short_description: Become a martial arts master in this survivor-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use your fists, feet, and the environment to fight off relentless thugs. Master powerful combos, enhance your skills, and remember: everything around you is a weapon!

3028280.name: Drag and Drop Medieval
3028280.short_description: Drag and Drop Medieval is a medieval-themed puzzle game where you move characters with your mouse through over 20 challenging levels featuring unique mechanics and pixel art graphics.

3028290.name: F*ck the HELL out
3028290.short_description: Fuck the Hell Out is a top-down action shooter where you purge the vast cosmos of hellish pests. Crush their skulls, shatter their spirits, and dominate with your arsenal in endless space battles.

3028730.name: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic
3028730.short_description: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

3048140.name: Daemonologie
3048140.short_description: A short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials. You play the role of a witch finder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.

3048280.name: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
3048280.short_description: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox is an immersive game that stands out for its realistic ragdoll physics, which together with various creation and damage tools, provides the player with a mix of realism and fun.

3049460.name: Milking Mira!
3049460.short_description: Are you thirsty? A prime hucow has arrived at your farm and it's time to collect that creamy goodness in this fun and addictive dairy clicker game! The more you milk, the more you unlock, so grab those udders and get to work!

3050220.name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH
3050220.short_description: Relive the pinnacle of 2D sprite-based fighting! Enhanced for online play! Complete with rollback netcode and overhauled online functionality!

3050530.name: Shokudo Underworld
3050530.short_description: Run your own sushi shokudo in a mysterious underworld. Satisfy the appetite of your customers, collect suspicious ingredients from bizarre fantastical creatures, and realize your dream of creating ... the legendary Chawanmushi!

3064410.short_description: You wake up with a bad hangover and don’t recognize your home. You see a boy and you understand... that something is wrong with him. Someone's presence causes anxiety, fear and is about to plunge you into the realm of horror. But you don’t lose hope and try to get out of this nightmare.

3064420.name: Innocence Or Money | Season 2 | Episode 1
3064420.short_description: Jennifer's adventures continue in Season 2. You will remain at the helm of her life and you will be able to set her on a good path or definitely lead her into a world of unparalleled corruption...

3064670.name: Mushroom Season
3064670.short_description: Dive into Mushroom Season! Customize your character, explore lush forests, and compete in thrilling mushroom picking contest. Identify mushrooms, avoid the poisonous ones, and aim for the top trophy. Are you the ultimate forager?

3064750.name: Wrong Bullet
3064750.short_description: Wrong Bullet is a captivating chill shooter that unveils an ever-changing world with random weapons scattered everywhere, accompanying your bloody campaign against enemy heads. Collect golden shards from them to unlock characters, discovering even more facets of gameplay.

3077020.name: DOKAPON! Sword of Fury
3077020.short_description: Whosoever winds up wealthiest in the end (meaning, the bearer of the most assets) shall be deemed the winner! How do you achieve that? Well, by fighting monsters, plundering, pillaging, and betraying your best buds; that's how! All the rules are made to be broken in this board game!

3077670.name: Water Delivery
3077670.short_description: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

3091390.name: Ashes of the Union
3091390.short_description: A vehicular shooter with roguelike elements, offering a wild take on an alternate future of the Soviet Union. Build your combat vehicle and show nature who's boss!

3103330.name: WebCum Secrets 🔞💦
3103330.short_description: Ever wondered what it’s like to manage a webcam business? Find out in WebCum Secrets 🔞💦 - a hot visual novel about a model manager. Save your career, build relationships and shape everyone’s future with your decisions!

3147900.name: Meddl Dash
3147900.short_description: In this unique adventure you have to drive Ford Blu as far as possible on the highway without getting caught by the haters. Visit exciting places such as zoos, motel ones and motorway service stations on your tour of Germany. Meddl.

3161850.name: Boosted Survivors
3161850.short_description: Survive waves! Choose new abilities! Modify your hero in any way you like! Craft a powerful masterpiece, or a horrible concoction of awful ideas! Discover secrets! Sandbox your way to victory! Boost! Survive! Boosted Survivors!

3162110.name: Space Cycle
3162110.short_description: Space resources are the battleground for warring factions. As a Space Defense Officer, protect your faction's assets in a vast, hostile universe. Allocate resources, upgrade defenses, and repel relentless enemy attacks! With over 50 unique units and deep strategy, experience real-time tower defense!

3173890.name: 开局五个亿
3173890.short_description: "Half Billion" is a surreal simulation business interactive game, where you will complete the entrepreneurial journey with a start-up capital of half billion. Six beauty enter your life. How will you balance the relationship? Note that "wealth" and "likability" will jointly determine the your story.
developers: 东阳开局互动影视有限公司
上海哈昔互联网科技有限公司

3175720.name: BM Love Cafe
3175720.short_description: This is an 18+banned maid cafe simulation management game. The game controls the protagonist's movements through the directional keys on the keyboard or the left mouse button, and interacts with the scene through the space bar. You will play the role of a maid cafe manager, managing a cafe.

3175860.name: Driving Is Hard
3175860.short_description: Prove your skills by driving the Bathtub on Wheels! Solve puzzles, collect soap, and dive into Jeff's family drama. Drive, Fall, Learn, Repeat.

3188550.name: Trainee Death Simulator
3188550.short_description: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.

3204250.name: Lost But Found
3204250.short_description: Organize and give out lost items! Lost But Found is a job simulator game where you are an officer who oversees the lost items in an airport. Organize those items and distribute them to people who lost their belongings. Upgrade your office, manage requests, collect stickers, and more.

3215170.name: NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD: Typing of The Net
3215170.short_description: "NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD: Typing of The Net" is a typing game in which you enter internet lingo in a call-and-response format with a girl (OMGkawaiiAngel) who has a strong need for approval.

3215660.name: Late Homework | 遅れた宿題
3215660.short_description: Highschool student Haneko has forgotten her class assignments and must retrieve them by traversing a world of haunted horrors. Explore the dilapidated halls, find your missing homework, and avoid whatever's lurking around the corner in this bite-sized, retro survival horror experience.

3229140.name: Echoes Of The House
3229140.short_description: Christopher arrives at his grandmother's countryside home late at night for a seemingly ordinary visit. But soon after reuniting, he begins to notice something isn't right. The familiar setting warps into a place of unease, and the mystery that unravels is far more complex than anyone could expect.

3229170.name: Egg Squeeze
3229170.short_description: Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.

3231900.name: Go Babies
3231900.short_description: Welcome to *Go Babies*, the ultimate baby racing extravaganza!

3231910.name: Underwater Cycling
3231910.short_description: **Underwater Cycling** takes you on an exhilarating underwater adventure where you as main character race on high-tech bicycles that glide through the ocean's depths.

3244210.name: Chonkers
3244210.short_description: Chonkers is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Adopt the cutest fur balls and watch them ramp up the chonk scale as you play with them. Find them a new family. They’ll pay A LOT for your hefty chonker! Complete your collection by finding all the breeds and the rarest space cats!

3244220.name: A Game About Digging A Hole
3244220.short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

3244640.name: SEXDIVERS 🔞
3244640.short_description: SEXDIVERS 🔞 is a survival shooter where you protect a scientific team on a dangerous alien planet. Fight fierce creatures, complete risky missions, and grow your fame! Unlock steamy rewards, level up your skills, and dive into a world of danger, passion, and adrenaline!

3399950.name: 你的老母
3399950.short_description: 《Your Mother》is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from mothers.

3408110.name: Cafemart Simulator
3408110.short_description: Create and decorate your cozy cafe, where guests can enjoy delicious food and drinks. Expand your service with a supermarket offering a wide selection of fresh products, so visitors can not only have a tasty meal but also do some shopping. Play solo or with friends in cooperative mode!

3410310.name: Make Good Choices
3410310.short_description: You’re just trying to get home. It’s only a quarter mile. One street. What could go wrong.

3416070.name: Ropuka's Idle Island
3416070.short_description: A cozy idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the frog cut grass, upgrade his tools, and decorate the island while you work or relax.

3438990.name: Cheaters Cheetah
3438990.short_description: Everyone will be given ACTUAL CHEATS in this multiplayer shooter. Use wallhacks and aimbots to your advantage and dominate the other cheetahs. The winner will get to BAN all losers!

3444480.name: Nebulock
3444480.short_description: Nebulock is a short bullet-hell game with intense gameplay, where the player must destroy bosses made of blocks, collect resources and upgrade his spaceship.
